Zo bouw je ervaring op bij verschillende organisaties, met de zekerheid van een vast contract en een bedrijfswagen.

jobs.title: Projectmanager Process Safety Geel
jobs.description:
Projectmanager Process Safety

Voor veiligheids- en risicoreductieprojecten binnen een industriële productieomgeving zoeken we een Projectmanager Veiligheidsprojecten. jobs.title: Infrastructure & IT Support Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Infrastructure & Support Engineer to provide both local IT support and "hands & eyes" services for remote infrastructure teams at Zedelgem site.

This is a broad and challenging role for a strong IT generalist who enjoys variety and impact, a role that requires a strong sense of ownership and responsibility, a talent for prioritization, documentation, vendor coordination, and high-stake production impacting problem-solving.

The role combines end-user support (1st to 3rd line), infrastructure management, networking -and server support, and on-site technical assistance for corporate IT, OT environments, IoT devices, scanners, and meeting room technologies.

The ideal candidate is a versatile IT generalist with strong troubleshooting skills, networking knowledge, and the ability to effectively bridge local business operations with remote technical teams. This is a full-time onsite contract opportunity.

Responsibilities

  • Act as local “hands & eyes” for remote infrastructure teams, including network, server, security, and application support activities;
  • Assist central teams with networking and infrastructure issues involving IP, DNS, Wi-Fi, VLANs/trunks, Cisco switching concepts, firewalls, RDP, SMB, ICMP, and local/remote access paths;
  • Provide hands-on support to the local IT support team in Zedelgem, for Problem and incident management;
  • Support OT/shopfloor-related environments such as PLC/HMI connectivity, scanners, IoT devices, and plant applications where business, supplier, network, firewall, and server teams may all be involved;
  • Support meeting room technologies such as Poly, Logitech, Barco, Teams Rooms, Poly Lens, firmware updates, network checks, and vendor coordination;
  • Maintain and improve documentation, including IP documentation, troubleshooting procedures, disaster recovery/backup restore notes, and ServiceNow/KB/SharePoint/Confluence knowledge where applicable;
  • Coordinate with business stakeholders, vendors, central IT teams, NPO/service providers, and local plant teams to drive issues to resolution, especially when responsibility is unclear or split across teams.

Required experience

  • Broad hands-on IT infrastructure and support experience, preferably covering both end-user support and infrastructure troubleshooting;
  • Strong networking fundamentals: IP, DNS, Wi-Fi, VLAN, Cisco switching concepts, firewall troubleshooting, and structured OSI-style analysis;
  • Practical Windows/Microsoft knowledge, including Active Directory/ENTRAID, domain concepts, Microsoft 365, SSO/MFA/Conditional Access concepts, and endpoint troubleshooting;
  • Documentation and knowledge-management skills;
  • Excellent communication skills English and Dutch with the ability to work effectively across both remote technical teams and local business operations staff, including calm prioritization during production-impacting incidents.

Preferred experience

  • Zebra MC9190 scanner setup/configuration;
  • Experience with meeting room technology such as Poly, Logitech, Yealink, Barco, Teams Rooms, and cloud MDM tools such as Poly Lens;
  • Experience with ServiceNow is a plus;
  • Other networking knowledge including SDWAN & SASE is preferred.

jobs.title: Logistics Specialist
jobs.description:
RESPONSIBILITIES:

Planning Management:

  • Process and monitor information related to incoming goods received via email; manage the inbound mailbox.
  • Schedule truck deliveries via email and telephone.
  • Enter all announced shipments into planning files/Excel.
  • Prepare and monitor mid- to long-term planning and forecasts (FCST).
  • Maintain oversight of delivery schedules, slot bookings, and warehouse capacity utilization.
  • Proactively solve problems and provide recommendations to Planning, Operations, Carriers, and Transport Management.

Receiving Operations:

  • Create ASNs (Advance Shipping Notices) and Inbound Deliveries.
  • Enter Purchase Orders (POs) into SAP, manage the Delivery Due List, and create inbound deliveries.
  • Verify shipment labels and ensure control over the origin of goods and batches.
  • Maintain, update, and analyze master data.
  • Communicate with customs brokers regarding import and export customs clearance procedures.
  • Initiate packaging adjustments to optimize logistics processes.

Continuous Improvement:

Driver Reception Desk:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for truck drivers; assign gates and manage check-in/check-out through the slot booking system.

  • Arrange and track transportation for DACH, Nordic, Benelux, and other markets.
  • Resolve issues related to transportation, goods, and materials.
  • Act as the communication link between Customer Service, Operations, and Carriers.

  • Knowledge of warehouse processes, inbound operations, and picking techniques
  • Good command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Proficiency in SAP, Microsoft Office, and slot booking systems.
  • Able to work independently, in a structured manner, and under pressure.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Customer-oriented mindset.
  • Continuous improvement mentality.
  • Team player.
  • Strong focus on safety and compliance with regulations.
  • Preferred: Experience in spare parts inventory management.

jobs.description:

Vi jobber aktivt for å skape en inkluderende arbeidsplass der alle blir hørt, respektert og verdsatt. Vi er opptatt av tilrettelegging og tilgjengelighet, og gjør gjerne nødvendige tilpasninger for kandidater som har behov for det - både i rekrutteringsprosessen og gjennom hele ansettelsesforholdet.

• Opprettholde teamets motivasjon og resultater

• Oppfølging av resultater og budsjett i samarbeid med prosjektkoordinator

• Daglig rapportering til prosjektkoordinator

• Støtte administrative oppgaver ved behov

• Evne til å formidle informasjon på en pedagogisk måte

• Empati og forståelse overfor teammedlemmer

• Trives med å jobbe utendørs

• Positiv, løsningsorientert og resultatorientert

• Førerkort er en fordel

Vi kan tilby

• Lønn etter Leger Uten Grensers lønnspolicy, tilsvarende 257 kr per time (lønnsnivå 11)

• Fast 60 % stilling med ønsket oppstart i slutten av september

• Verdifull leder- og arbeidserfaring i verdens største medisinske nødhjelpsorganisasjon

• Tett oppfølging og støtte fra prosjektkoordinator

• Et internasjonalt, idealistisk og engasjerende arbeidsmiljø

Ikke nøl med å ta kontakt med prosjektkoordinator Ruben Torp dersom du har spørsmål!

Hos Leger Uten Grenser verdsetter vi mangfold og tilstreber et inkluderende og tilrettelagt arbeidsmiljø. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss, uavhengig av etnisk, nasjonal eller kulturell bakgrunn, alder, kjønn, seksuell legning, religiøs tilhørighet, funksjonshemming, eller andre identitetsaspekter.

//

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is looking for an experienced and motivated Team Leader to join our door-to-door fundraising project in Oslo. In this permanent 60% position, you will play a key role in recruiting new regular donors and helping secure the funding that makes our independent medical humanitarian work possible around the world.

About the role

As Team Leader, you will be responsible for the daily management, development, and motivation of a team of door-to-door fundraisers. You will work closely with the Project Coordinator to build a strong team culture, support individual development, and ensure the team achieves its fundraising goals. The work primarily takes place in the afternoons and evenings, when the team is out engaging with potential donors.

The role combines operational leadership with hands-on fundraising and offers valuable leadership experience within one of the world's leading humanitarian organizations. You will have direct responsibility for training, follow-up, and team building, while contributing to the success of one of MSF's most important fundraising channels. This is a job with a focus on personal growth, which contributes to invaluable experience for a further career, also in MSF.

We are actively working to create an inclusive workplace where all voices are heard, respected, and valued. We are committed to accessibility and are happy to make reasonable adjustments for candidates who may need them during the recruitment process and throughout employment.

Tasks:

• Training and follow-up of team members

• Maintain the team's motivation and results

• Plan, organize and participate in team activities

• Follow up of results and budget in cooperation with the coordinator

• Daily reporting to the project coordinator

• Supporting administrative tasks when needed

Qualifications:

• Experience as a Team Leader and/or Fundraiser in fundraising. Experience from Médecins Sans Frontières is an advantage

• Good team player, leader, and motivator

• Ability to convey information in an educational way

• Ability to show empathy and understanding towards team members

• Enjoy working outdoors

• Positive, solution-oriented and result-driven

• English or Norwegian language skills at B2 level

• Driver's license is an advantage

We can offer:

• Salary according to MSF`s policy, 257kr per hour (MSF salary level 11)

• 60% position with preferred start date in late September

• Valuable leadership and work experience in the world's largest medical aid organization

• Close follow-up and support by the coordinator

• An international, idealistic, and engaging work environment

Don't hesitate to contact Project Coordinator Ruben Torp if you have any questions!

At MSF, we value diversity and seek to have an inclusive and accessible work environment. We encourage all individuals who have the required qualifications to apply, independently of their ethnic, national, or cultural background, age, gender, sexual orientation, religious belief, disabilities, or other aspects of their identity.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Leger Uten Grenser er en nøytral og uavhengig medisinsk nødshjelpeorganisasjon som redder liv og lindrer nød. Vi hjelper de som trenger det mest - uansett hvem, uansett hvor, uansett hvorfor. Leger Uten Grenser har prosjekter i flere enn 75 land og sender feltarbeidere fra Norge på rundt 100 oppdrag hvert år. Leger Uten Grenser gir nødhjelp til mennesker i krig, kriser og katastrofer og andre som ikke har tilgang til grunnleggende helsetjenester. Vi varsler om overgrep og glemte kriser - fordi færre dør når flere vet.

jobs.title: Behandlingssekreterare vikariat
jobs.description:
Statens institutionsstyrelse, SiS, är en myndighet som ansvarar för individuellt anpassad tvångsvård för ungdomar med komplex psykosocial problematik och för vuxna med missbruk. SiS verkställer även sluten ungdomsvård. Det gör vi på ungdomshem och hem för vuxna med missbruk, över hela landet. Hos oss på SiS blir ditt arbetsliv en spännande utmaning. Oavsett var i vår organisation du arbetar, eller vilken tjänst du har, hjälper du till att skapa livsviktig förändring.



SiS LVM-hem Hornö tar emot män med alkohol-, narkotika- eller blandmissbruk. Vi tar emot män med psykisk ohälsa och män med utagerande beteende. Vi har i uppdrag att bedriva vård för klienter med särskilda vårdbehov.





Arbetsbeskrivning

I arbetet som behandlingssekreterare kommer du i första hand att ansvara för ett 10-tal klienters behandlingsplanering under LVM-tiden och dokumentation kring detta. I nära samarbete med klienterna, socialtjänsten och personalen på Hornö bevakar du att klienten får så relevanta behandlingsinsatser som möjligt. I förekommande fall kommer du även att skriva SiS LVM utredningar gällande "dina" klienter. I viss mån ingår även att åka på resor, se till att regler efterföljs samt vara behjälplig med avdelningsarbete vid behov.



Kvalifikationer

Relevant akademisk utbildning såsom socionom, beteendevetare eller annan akademisk utbildning om minst 180 hp som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig, är ett krav. Det är även ett krav att ha B-körkort samt tillgång till bil. Det är meriterande om du arbetat med behandling inom missbruksvård, psykiatri eller liknande.



Vi söker dig som är en god förebild för våra vuxna klienter, vi lägger därför stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Du kan arbeta medodinriktat och har förmågan att utifrån klientens beskrivna situation kunna analysera och förstå sammanhang och utifrån detta arbeta fram lämpliga behandlingsinsatser. Du förstår vikten av ett trevligt bemötande och att bygga en professionell relation med klienter. God samarbetsförmåga med klienter, medarbetare och samarbetspartner är av yttersta vikt. Du uttrycker dig väl i tal och skrift samt kommunicerar på ett tydligt sätt. Det är även viktigt att du som person kan agera gränssättande och arbeta strukturerat. Vidare är det viktigt att kunna arbeta självständigt och engagerat samt bidra till vår gemensamma arbetsglädje.



På SiS månar vi om ett gott medarbetarskap. Det innebär att du som medarbetare tar ansvar för ditt arbete, bidrar till utveckling och medverkar till ett gott samarbete. Läs mer om https://www.stat-inst.se/jobba-hos-oss/medarbetarskap-och-ledarskap/.



Anställning:

Tjänsten är en visstidsanställning till och med 2027-12-31



Ansökan:

Välkommen att registrera din ansökan i vårt rekryteringsverktyg senast den 2026-09-21



Tester och arbetsprover kan komma att ingå i rekryteringsprocessen.





SiS arbetar aktivt mot all form av diskriminering och välkomnar alla sökande.



För arbete på våra institutioner gör SiS registerkontroll innan anställning.



Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Statens institutionsstyrelse tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.





OBS! Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte söka via rekryteringssystemet. Kontakta i stället den som står som kontaktperson i annonsen.

jobs.title: Vil du bli min motivator og støttespille i hverdagen? 29-årig mann i Oslo søker BPA
jobs.employer: MIO BPA AS AVD KONTOR OSLO
jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest
📌 Stillingstype: Fast - 10t i uken
⏰ Arbeidstid: Dag, kveld, helg


Hei!

Jeg er en 29 år gammel mann som bor i Oslo, i området Alna bydel, med enkel fremkommelighet med både buss og t-bane. Jeg er en rolig og hyggelig fyr som er åpen for å prøve ulike aktiviteter. Tidligere har jeg blant annet likt bordtennis, fiske, sjakk, klatring og trening, og jeg har også gamingutstyr som jeg gjerne skulle brukt mer. Jeg er glad i musikk, og spiller tidvis gitar, og det hadde vært moro om du delte denne interessen. Nå ser jeg etter en assistent som kan motivere meg til å komme meg mer ut, prøve nye ting og bidra til en mer aktiv og sosial hverdag.

På grunn av angst og epilepsi har det blitt mer utfordrende for meg å delta i aktiviteter og sosiale arenaer slik jeg ønsker. Derfor ser jeg etter en trygg og tålmodig assistent som kan være en støttespiller i hverdagen og bidra til økt mestring, aktivitet og sosial deltakelse.

Stilling omfang og arbeidstider

Jeg søker nå én fast BPA-assistent til en stilling på omtrent 10 timer per uke, fordelt på to dager. Vaktene vil normalt være rundt 5 timer lange. Det er ønskelig at du kan jobbe både noe dagtid, kvelder og enkelte helger, men hvilke dager og tider vi avtaler kan tilpasses etter hva som passer for deg. Det kan også bli mulighet for ekstra timer ved behov.

Oppgi gjerne i din søknad når du har mulighet til å jobbe. Kandidater vurderes fortløpende.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Motivere og delta i aktiviteter både hjemme og utenfor hjemmet

  • Bidra til en aktiv, meningsfull og sosial hverdag

  • Være en trygg støtte i sosiale situasjoner

  • Fremme mestring, selvstendighet og utvikling

  • Bygge en god relasjon basert på tillit og respekt

  • Tilpasse støtten etter dagsform og behov

Personlige egenskaper

  • Tålmodig og trygg

  • Lyttende og omsorgsfull

  • Positiv, inkluderende og relasjonssterk

  • Utadvendt, initiativrik og motiverende

  • Fleksibel og tilpasningsdyktig

  • Har godt humør og evner å skape en hyggelig atmosfære

Kvalifikasjoner

· Det er til fordel at du har litt livserfaring, samt er tygg og stødig

  • Gode norskkunnskaper (B1 norsk kurs)

  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt

  • Fordel med førerkort, men ikke et krav

  • Interesse for diverse aktiviteter og gaming er en fordel

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper jeg du sender inn en søknad som forteller litt om deg og dine interesser. Jeg ser frem til å høre fra deg og finne en assistent som kan bli en viktig støttespiller i hverdagen min! 😊

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Hanna Brurås på epost: hanna.bruras@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: Chief Compliance Officer  AI SaaS, GDPR & EU AI Act  Göteborg
jobs.description:
myflow gives solopreneurs and small teams an AI-powered business platform — CRM, marketing, sales, e-signing and automation, run either by the customer or by AI teammates working on their behalf. We launched in Sweden in 2024 and are now expanding internationally.

Shipping autonomous AI agents that handle customer data, send marketing, and find leads across multiple jurisdictions puts us in the middle of the fastest-moving area of tech regulation there is. We're hiring our first Chief Compliance Officer to own it.

About the role

You report to the CEO and you're building this function from nothing. There is no team beneath you on day one and no playbook to inherit — you will write the policies, run the assessments, sit in the customer calls, and decide what we can and cannot offer. If you want a large department and an established framework, this isn't it. If you want to define how an AI-native product company handles compliance while the rules are still being written, it is.

What you will do

    Own our EU AI Act position: classify our AI systems, meet Article 50 transparency obligations, and manage our exposure downstream of the foundation models we build on.
    Own our ISO 42001 practices ensuring we are a proven leader in demonstrating mature AI governance.
    Own GDPR across the platform, with particular focus on our lead generation and outbound marketing features — lawful basis, notification duties, and the ePrivacy rules governing automated outreach.
    Build our US privacy posture as we expand: HIPAA Business Associate obligations where healthcare practitioners use our platform, CAN-SPAM and TCPA for agent-driven outreach, and state privacy law compliance.
    Take us through SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701 and stand behind them in customer security reviews.
    Support our entry into US public-sector and Tribal markets — contracting with sovereign entities, sovereign immunity and limited waiver provisions, tribal business licensing, and where relevant federal procurement requirements.
    Be the compliance voice in product decisions early, not the person who blocks a launch the week before it’s live.

We require

    Senior compliance, privacy or regulatory experience at a SaaS or technology company, ideally one that has expanded across jurisdictions.
    Deep working knowledge of GDPR in a product context — not policy administration, but decisions about what a feature is allowed to do.
    Proven history with the EU AI Act and ISO 42001 guidelines, with direct experience in how it applies to agentic AI products.
    Experience running or supporting a SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701 programme end to end.
    Senior level experience in navigating Indigenous markets with a portfolio of successful implementation around sovereign immunity data laws, federal level tribal business licensing agreements, and cultural sensitivities.
    HIPAA experience on the vendor or Business Associate side, including BAA.
    Comfort operating alone, at pace, with incomplete information and unsettled law.
    Fluent professional English.
    CIPP/E, CIPP/US or CIPM certification.
    

    Experience with US federal procurement, including FedRAMP.
    

    Swedish language skills.

What we offer

Standard Swedish employment agreement. Hybrid arrangement. Negotiable salary.

Practical details

Location: Gothenburg, hybrid arrangement. Start: by agreement. We review applications 10 days after the listed date of the ad.

Questions: Oliver Hertzman Kraft Email: Oliver@myflow.io

jobs.title: 🌟 Blid og aktiv dame på 37 år søker tilkallingsassistent 🌟
jobs.description:
Er du en omsorgsfull, fleksibel og positiv person som ønsker en meningsfull jobb? Da kan dette være stillingen for deg! 💛

Jeg er en kvinne på 37 år med fysisk funksjonsnedsettelse som søker en fleksibel assistent til å bistå meg i hverdagen. Jeg er ryggmargskadet og bruker rullestol. Jeg bor i Eigersund kommune sammen med min datter på 9 år, våre tre katter 🐱🐱🐱 og en servicehund 🐕.

På fritiden liker jeg å være sammen med familien min, stelle i hagen 🌱, reise ✈️ og strikke 🧶. Jeg er også opptatt av å gjøre en forskjell i samfunnet og er engasjert i likestilling for personer med funksjonsnedsettelse.

For meg er personlig egnethet og god kjemi svært viktig. Jeg ser etter deg som er fleksibel, selvstendig og som av og til kan stille opp på kort varsel 😊.

📌 Stilling

Tilkallingsassistent ved sykdom. Trenger også noen til å jobbe søndager.

💼 Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Personlig hygiene
  • Husarbeid (rydding, støvsuging og vask)
  • Handling av dagligvarer 🛒
  • Aktiviteter sammen med min datter 🎨⚽
  • Trening 💪
  • Hagearbeid 🌷
  • Reise og følge til ulike aktiviteter

✅ Kvalifikasjoner

  • Førerkort klasse B 🚗
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Plettfri vandel
  • Fleksibel og ansvarsbevisst

🎁 Vi tilbyr

  • En meningsfull jobb som bidrar til likestilling og selvstendighet 💙
  • Tariffavtale med gode arbeids- og lønnsvilkår
  • Grundig opplæring og tett oppfølging fra lokalkontoret 🤝
  • En variert og selvstendig arbeidshverdag

Jeg gleder meg til å høre fra deg! 🌸😊

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Financial Reporting Lead - 19031
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.

Assignment Description

We are looking for a senior Financial Controlling Lead

What You Will Work On

    Lead and support consolidated financial reporting
    Work with IFRS accounting and reporting requirements
    Analyze financial results and identify deviations
    Investigate the underlying drivers behind financial outcomes
    Work with group reporting and consolidation
    Analyze intercompany transactions and differences
    Manage opening and closing balance differences
    Support cash flow analysis and financial development
    Analyze investments, CAPEX and financial impacts
    Perform quality assurance of financial reporting
    Drive financial issues from analysis to resolution
    Work closely with auditors, management and senior stakeholders
    Support reporting processes in larger and international organizations
    Work with ERP and financial reporting systems
    Create structure and improve financial processes and routines
    Translate complex financial information into clear conclusions and actions

What You Bring

    Strong experience with consolidated financial statements
    Strong knowledge of IFRS
    Very good understanding of accounting and bookkeeping
    Strong analytical skills and ability to identify financial deviations
    Experience with group reporting and consolidation
    Understanding of intercompany accounting
    Understanding of opening and closing differences
    Good knowledge of cash flow and financial development
    Experience working independently and handling new issues proactively
    Experience from large or international organizations
    Strong stakeholder management skills with auditors and management
    Good understanding of ERP and financial reporting systems
    Ability to work both at detailed accounting level and at a strategic level
    Strong communication and problem-solving skills

jobs.title: Nattevakter søkes til Moxy Tromsø!
jobs.description:
🎉 Bli en del av Moxy Crew på Moxy Tromsø🎉 Er du på utkikk etter en morsom og energisk arbeidsplass? Har du lyst til å bli en del av et fantastisk team? 🤩 Da trenger du ikke lete lenger! Moxy Tromsø utvider staben og søker nå etter flere hotellmedarbeidere.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har en genuint positiv innstilling og et ønske om å lære

  • Er en god lagspiller som verdsetter samarbeid og styrken i teamet

  • Trives med å jobbe i et flerkulturelt og hektisk miljø

  • Er i stand til å multitaske effektivt og opprettholde fokus

  • Har kunnskap om grunnleggende databruk (for eks. Microsoft Office, Excel og Outlook).

  • Er over 20 år

  • Det er ikke obligatorisk, men ferdigheter i minst ett skandinavisk språk foretrekkes. Engelsk muntlig og skriftlig er påkrevd.

  • Tidligere erfaring innen hotell eller kundeservice vil bli ansett som en betydelig fordel. Har du ikke dette, vil du selvsagt få grundig opplæring.

Hvis du vil jobbe i et miljø med personlighet, tempo og flinke folk, og være med på å skape minnerike opplevelser for gjester fra hele verden -- da håper vi du søker.

👉 Join the Moxy Crew -- og gjør hver dag litt mer awesome.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Nattevakt søkes til Moxy Tromsø

Er du oppe mens resten av byen sover?

På Moxy Tromsø gjør vi hotell litt annerledes. Vi elsker energi, personlighet og mennesker som tør å by på seg selv. Nå ser vi etter en nattevakt som kan holde fortet gjennom de små nattetimer og sørge for at våre gjester får en trygg, hyggelig og sømløs opplevelse.

Dette er ikke en jobb for deg som bare vil sitte bak en resepsjonsdisk. Hos oss er du vert, problemløser og trygghetsskaper i én og samme rolle.

Hvem er du?

Du trives når ting skjer, men klarer også å holde hodet kaldt når det er stille.

Vi ønsker deg som:

  • Er selvstendig og tar ansvar

  • Har gode kommunikasjonsevner på engelsk både skriftlig og muntlig, og et skandinavisk språk er ønskelig!

  • Har evne til å se løsninger fremfor problemer

  • Er komfortabel med å jobbe alene om natten

  • Har erfaring fra hotell, service eller resepsjon, men riktig personlighet er viktigst


Hva går jobben ut på?

Hos oss er ingen dag lik - og det liker vi. Du får en variert rolle der du er med og skaper gode opplevelser for gjestene våre, fra de sjekker inn til de sjekker ut (og alt imellom).

Du vil blant annet:

  • Ta imot gjester med et smil og stå for inn- og utsjekk i resepsjonen

  • Servere drikke i skybaren (ja, utsikten er like bra som stemningen)

  • Sette frem frokost til våre gjester og ønske alle morgenfugler "god morgen" i samme slengen

  • Sørge for at gjestene våre føler seg sett, velkommen og ivaretatt

  • Samarbeide tett med resten av crewet for at hotellet skal flyte smooth

Vi tilbyr Hva får du hos oss?

  • En arbeidsplass med internasjonal puls og lokal sjarm

  • Et internasjonalt miljø hvor du møter gjester fra hele verden

  • Et inkluderende team som heier på hverandre

  • En uformell tone i et effektivt arbeidsmiljø, hvor godt humør og positiv energi verdsettes i hverdagen

  • Ordnede forhold og et engasjert, inkluderende team

  • Mulighet til å utvikle deg innen Marriott International

  • En hverdag der ingen netter er helt like

  • Gode ansattfordeler gjennom Marriott-nettverket


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hos Moxy Hotels tar vi ikke oss selv så høytidelig - men vi tar gjesteopplevelsen på alvor! Vi tilbyr god service, smarte rom, stilige fellesområder og en top floor bar med den beste utsikten.

Moxy Hotel Tromsø åpnet i juni 2023 og er det eneste Marriott hotellet i Nord-Norge. Hotellet har 208 moderne rom med totalt 416 sengeplasser. Hotellet eies av den danske hotellkjeden Core Hospitality, som driver 21 hoteller i Norden.

jobs.title: Clinical Specialist - Physiotherapist
jobs.description:
About us

Trexo Robotics is enabling mobility by building powered wearable robots. Our first product is a robot for children with movement disorders such as Cerebral Palsy, and it allows kids to walk, in many cases, for the first time in their lives. The device is currently being used by hundreds of families and the best hospitals across North America.

We are constantly working towards building mobility solutions for all. At Trexo Robotics, you will find a flat organization where you can work with highly optimistic, low ego, and exceptionally talented individuals who look forward to solving hard problems.

About the job

We are growing our presence in the UK and are looking for a Clinical Specialist to join our team as our second UK-based hire. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for a clinician who is passionate about paediatric rehabilitation, technology and making a meaningful difference for children and their families.

As a Clinical Specialist, you will be a key point of contact for families, clinicians and healthcare partners using Trexo. You will lead customer onboarding and training, provide ongoing clinical and technical support, and deliver hands-on device trials at roadshows, conferences and other events.

The role involves significant travel, primarily across the UK and occasionally elsewhere in Europe. We expect travel to account for approx. 75% of your working time. Occasional weekend work may be required for customer trials, roadshows or events. We will provide reasonable notice wherever possible.

What you'll do

  • Lead onboarding and hands-on training for new families and clinical partners receiving their Trexo devices.

  • Provide ongoing support to customers through regular check-ins, helping them use the device effectively and work towards meaningful goals.

  • Conduct hands-on Trexo trials with children and families at roadshows, conferences and other events across the UK and Europe.

  • Address daily customer queries via dedicated chat groups and manage support tickets.

  • Independently set up, adjust, and troubleshoot the Trexo device, including basic technical, mechanical, and software checks.

  • Work with families and clinicians to establish meaningful goals and monitor relevant measures and progress.

  • Gather customer feedback to share with engineering and product teams to drive continuous product improvement.

  • Work closely with our global Customer Success and Sales teams to ensure a consistent customer experience.

  • Represent Trexo Robotics at clinical events, conferences and community-based activities.

About you

We are looking for a tech-savvy Physiotherapist who is comfortable working independently with advanced robotic equipment. You bring clinical credibility, strong emotional intelligence, and a practical approach to hands-on problem-solving. You thrive in community-based environments and enjoy traveling to work directly with children and their families.

You are practical and curious. You love asking 'why' multiple times until you understand something from first principles, and you thrive in unknown situations where you can apply logical reasoning, find solutions, and lead.

Most importantly, you are motivated by the opportunity to use technology to improve mobility and quality of life for children.

Required Skills and Experience

  • At least 3 years' post-qualification experience working as a Physiotherapist or in a closely related clinical role.

  • Qualification as a Physiotherapist with current HCPC registration (or eligible to practice as a UK-licensed PT).

  • Clinical experience at a level broadly equivalent to NHS Band 6, or equivalent experience in private or independent practice.

  • Experience working in paediatric physiotherapy, ideally in a community-based setting.

  • Tech-savvy with the confidence to independently set up, adjust, and troubleshoot technical equipment.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with excellent empathy and patience.

  • Willingness and ability to travel extensively, with approximately 75% travel across the UK and occasional travel elsewhere in Europe.

  • Ability to safely lift and handle equipment weighing up to 27 kg (60 lb).

  • Hold a valid UK driving licence.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience working within the NHS.

  • Membership of the Chartered Society of Physiotherapy (CSP).

  • Experience providing virtual care, telehealth or remote clinical support.

  • Familiarity with UK paediatric funding pathways, such as NHS Continuing Healthcare, Personal Health Budgets, Education, Health and Care Plans (EHCPs) or charitable funding.

  • Experience working with children with complex mobility needs, neurological conditions or physical disabilities.

  • Experience with assistive technology, rehabilitation technology, robotics, orthotics or other mobility devices.

  • Fluency in an additional European language, particularly German or French.

  • Experience using tools such as Salesforce or Airtable.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Employee stock options

  • Home Office Setup allowance

  • Car allowance

  • Private health insurance

Interview process

  • Screening (30 mins)

  • Hiring Manager conversation (60 mins)

  • Team and founder conversations (30 mins each)

  • Reference and background check

  • Offer

Work Authorization: Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support work authorization applications. We can only consider candidates who already have the legal right to work in the location they are applying for.

AI in Recruitment: At Trexo Robotics, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support our recruitment process. AI helps with tasks like resume screening, drafting job descriptions, creating interview questions, and occasionally sourcing candidates. Final hiring decisions are always made by our team. Our goal is to use AI responsibly to streamline administrative tasks, improve candidate experience, and maintain fair, unbiased hiring practices aligned with industry standards.

Compensation: £43K – £55K • Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges

  • Manchester Area Tier • £43K – £50K • Offers Equity
  • London Area Tier • £48K – £55K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Dossierbeheerder Travel - Back Office
jobs.description:
Het departement Back-Office maakt deel uit van de divisie Finance & Administration. Het bestaat uit twee gespecialiseerde teams, Claims en Travel, die verantwoordelijk zijn voor de verwerking van de terugbetalingsaanvragen van onze klanten.

  • Valideer je de door de klant aangeleverde bewijsstukken.

  • Sta je in voor de opvolging van klantcontacten en beantwoord je hun vragen per telefoon en e-mail.

  • Informeer je de klant over een eventuele weigering of over het bedrag van de terugbetaling.

  • Toon je een luisterend oor en begeleid je klanten met professionaliteit en empathie gedurende het gehele verwerkingsproces van hun dossier.

  • Is in het bezit van een bachelordiploma (bij voorkeur in toerisme) OF beschikt over relevante ervaring en een goede kennis van de gangbare procedures in de reissector.

  • Beschikt over een uitstekend analytisch vermogen en werkt nauwkeurig.

  • Beheert dossiers zelfstandig en proactief: neemt initiatief, detecteert onregelmatigheden en communiceert efficiënt.

  • Is gemotiveerd om een kwalitatieve dienstverlening te bieden binnen de gestelde termijnen.

  • Werkt graag in teamverband.

  • Belichaamt dagelijks de waarden van Touring: Menselijkheid, Vertrouwen, Innovatie en Positiviteit.

jobs.description:

Dans ce rôle, tu es responsable de la fabrication et de la mise en place de coffrages selon les plans, afin que chaque construction en béton repose sur une base solide et durable. jobs.title: Klinkerleggers
jobs.description:
Steek jij graag de handen uit de mouwen en zie je graag meteen resultaat van je werk? Dan is deze job misschien wel iets voor jou!

Wij zijn een vakbedrijf uit Oud-Turnhout dat gespecialiseerd is in kwalitatieve en duurzame bestratingswerken. Van opritten en terrassen tot volledige buitenaanleg: met sterke materialen, oog voor detail en een nette afwerking zorgen zij voor een resultaat dat jarenlang meegaat.

Als bestrater werk je samen met een klein en gemotiveerd team aan verschillende projecten in de regio. Je krijgt een gevarieerd takenpakket en werkt mee aan het volledige proces, van de voorbereiding van de ondergrond tot de laatste klinker.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je helpt mee met rioleringswerken en het plaatsen van PVC-buizen.
  • Je zorgt samen met je collega's voor een verzorgde en kwalitatieve afwerking van iedere werf.

Waar kom je terecht?
Je werkt voornamelijk op werven in de regio en vertrekt vanuit Oud-Turnhout. Je komt terecht in een praktische en professionele omgeving waar kwaliteit en vakmanschap centraal staan.

  • Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring in bestratingswerken, grondwerken of wegenbouw. Geen ervaring? Een goede werkmentaliteit en motivatie zijn minstens zo belangrijk!
  • Je werkt graag buiten, bent fysiek in orde en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen.

jobs.title: Biträdande universitetslektor i geologi
jobs.description:
Göteborgs universitet erbjuder en forskningsmiljö där internationellt erkänd forskning i världsklass förenas med en öppen och samarbetsdriven akademisk kultur. Här får forskare i början av karriären möjlighet att utvecklas, bygga internationella nätverk och bidra till forskning med global betydelse. Denna anställning är en del av universitetets satsning University of Gothenburg Global Scholars Initiative. Läs mer om satsningen och Göteborgs universitet här: https://www.gu.se/node/190161/

Institutionen för geovetenskaper är verksamma inom geologi, naturgeografi och ekosystemvetenskap. Våra tre prioriterade forskningsteman är ”Geosfären”, ”Processer vid jordytan” och ”Klimat och klimatförändringar”. Inom geologi, som ingår i forskningstemat ”Geosfären”, har vi etablerade styrkeområden inom hydrogeologi, geokemi, geofysik och strukturgeologi. Mer information finns på vår webbplats:

https://www.gu.se/geovetenskaper

https://www.gu.se/jobba-hos-goteborgs-universitet/anstallningsformaner

Ämne

Geologi

Ämnesbeskrivning

Geologi vid Institutionen för geovetenskaper omfattar studier av dagens geodynamiska processer i den fasta jorden samt av jordens och andra terrestra planeters utveckling genom hela solsystemets historia.

Den aktuella forskningen omfattar bland annat mineralresurser för den gröna omställningen, isdynamik, utveckling av nya geokemiska och petrofysiska metoder, grundvattenresurser, mark- och grundvattenföroreningar, processer i subduktionszoner och deras koppling till naturkatastrofer, klimatförändringar i jordens geologiska historia samt geotermisk energi.

Geologigruppen vid Institutionen för geovetenskaper erbjuder en utmärkt forskningsinfrastruktur med moderna analysfaciliteter, såsom ett mikrogeokemiskt laboratorium, ett laboratorium för stabila isotoper, vattenanalyslaboratorium, mikro-Ramanlaboratorium samt ett laboratorium för is- och mikroplastanalyser. Dessa kompletteras av avancerade faciliteter för fjärranalys och visualisering.

Arbetsuppgifter

Anställningen som biträdande universitetslektor är en meriteringsanställning med huvudsaklig inriktning mot forskning (upp till 80 procent av anställningen omfattas av forskning). En av institutionen fullt finansierad doktorandanställning är knuten till tjänsten.

Som biträdande universitetslektor förväntas du etablera och leda ett självständigt forskningsprogram. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår att publicera i internationellt ledande, sakkunniggranskade tidskrifter samt att aktivt söka och erhålla extern forskningsfinansiering.

Undervisning omfattar upp till 20 procent av anställningen.

Behörighet

Behörig att anställas som biträdande universitetslektor är den som har avlagt doktorsexamen i geologi eller närliggande ämnesområden, eller har motsvarande vetenskaplig kompetens. Främst bör den komma i fråga som har avlagt doktorsexamen eller har nått motsvarande kompetens högst sju år innan tiden för ansökan av anställningen som biträdande lektor har gått ut. Även den som har avlagt doktorsexamen eller har uppnått motsvarande kompetens tidigare kan dock komma i fråga om det finns särskilda skäl, t ex ledighet på grund av sjukdom, föräldraledighet eller andra liknande omständigheter.

Förmåga att kunna undervisa på engelska är ett krav.

Bedömningsgrunder

Bedömningen utgår i första hand från den vetenskapliga skickligheten, i andra hand från den pedagogiska skickligheten. I tredje hand viktas förmåga till samverkan och administrativ skicklighet.

För mer information se annonsen i sin helhet på Göteborgs Universitets hemsida.

Anställning

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad under 5 år

Omfattning: 100 %  

Placering: Institutionen för geovetenskaper, Göteborg.

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Befordran till universitetslektor

En biträdande universitetslektor har rätt att prövas för befordran till en tillsvidareanställning som universitetslektor i geologi om personen har behörighet för sådan anställning (GU 2025/1411).

Övriga upplysningar

Vid Göteborgs universitet har du rätt att som universitetslektor bli prövad för en tillsvidareanställning som professor.

Har du inte formell högskolepedagogisk utbildning kommer du få möjlighet att gå högskolepedagogisk utbildning.

Har du inte kunskaper i svenska kommer du erbjudas språkkurser inom ramen för anställningen.

Internationellt rekryterad personal erbjuds relocationpaket och skattemöte/Global Mobility.

Kontaktuppgifter för anställningen

Har du frågor om anställningen är du välkommen att kontakta Hans Linderholm, prefekt vid Institutionen för geovetenskaper, professor i naturgeografi, +46 70-858-9504 alt HansL@gvc.gu.se

Ansökan

Annonsen finns i sin helhet på Göteborgs universitets hemsida. Du söker anställningen via Göteborgs universitets rekryteringsportal ansöker via https://www.gu.se/om-universitetet/jobba-hos-oss/lediga-anstallningar  

Intervjuer planeras den 16 december.

Ansökan ska vara inkommen senast: 30 oktober 2026



Universitetet arbetar aktivt för en arbetsmiljö med jämställda förhållanden och sätter värde på de kvalitéer mångfald tillför verksamheten. Universitetet tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Enligt Riksarkivets föreskrifter är universitetet skyldigt att förvara ansökningshandlingar i två år efter tillsättningsbeslutet. Om du som sökande till en anställning särskilt begär tillbaka dina handlingar återsänds de när de två åren har förflutit, i annat fall kommer de att gallras ut. Till bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som är försäljare: Göteborgs universitet anlitar upphandlad annonsbyrå i samband med rekrytering av personal. Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av jobbannonser.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

More in Common is looking for a Chief of Staff.  This is a new role and a rare opportunity to help shape the next phase of a fast-growing global organisation working on some of the most urgent issues of our time, working at the CEO's side with a unique vantage point across our country teams, strategy and network of funders and partners worldwide.
(Please note that the preferred London location is for ease of communication with Tim Dixon, who is based in the UK. The postholder will not be involved in the day-to-day polling and research activities of More in Common UK, and will not report or routinely provide support to our Executive Director in the UK, Luke Tryl.)


ABOUT MORE IN COMMON

More in Common is a nonprofit dedicated to understanding the dynamics of polarisation, and identifying solutions that can strengthen social cohesion and confidence in democracy. We help leaders navigate the dynamics of polarisation more effectively, find common ground and bring people together to address shared challenges. More in Common's work is frequently featured in media and used by leaders in government, nonprofits, philanthropy, education, the arts and business. 
 
We have a country-led model, with work deeply rooted in national contexts and led by country directors in each of our seven countries, with a total headcount approaching 100. Our teams generate research insights, translate them into thought leadership, and disseminate and implement them across a wide ecosystem of partners and stakeholders. We hold relationships with leaders in many sectors of society, across politics, media, business, civil society, philanthropy, culture and faith, and from national leaders to local community groups. Recent work has produced fresh insights into public attitudes on immigration, online safety, nature and the energy transition, Ukraine, and democracy.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

This is a rare opportunity to help shape the next phase of a fast-growing global organisation working on some of the most urgent issues of our time, working at the CEO's side with a unique vantage point across our country teams, strategy and network of funders and partners worldwide. 
 
The Chief of Staff is a new role, created as More in Common transitions from its founding phase, when the organisation was led by its co-founders, to sole CEO leadership. It incorporates a senior adviser role, in which the Chief of Staff will be the principal aide, advisor and coordinator to the global CEO Tim Dixon, ensuring priorities advance, decisions move efficiently and commitments are executed. The Chief of Staff will also act as organisational glue: working closely with More in Common’s team of country leaders and directors, ensuring alignment between country executive directors, the global team and the CEO around More in Common's strategy, programmes and operations, and helping spot and resolve problems before they escalate.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategy

  • Strategic counsel: Trusted thought partner to the CEO on strategy and major decisions, drawing on visibility across the whole organisation and ensuring alignment within its country-led model. 
  • CEO communications: Shapes the CEO’s internal and external communications, and absorbs the coordination, communication, and follow-through work that would otherwise pull the CEO away from key public-facing responsibilities.
 
Organisational coordination
  • CEO workflow: Manages the CEO's priorities, time and decision pipeline with the Senior Executive Coordinator, so the right issues get attention and decisions don't stall. 
  • Team alignment and delivery: Keeps global and country teams aligned on shared priorities, facilitates decision-making across the organisation, and leads special projects requiring senior-level attention.
 
Leadership 
  • Country ED support: Liaises with country Executive Directors on the CEO's behalf, identifying where teams need more support and providing assistance in crises. 
  • Talent and succession: Supports leadership succession planning and mentors emerging leaders across country teams.


QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

We are looking for a candidate with:

  • Commitment to More in Common’s mission and values.
  • Experience working closely with, or in direct support of, a senior executive, founder or CEO.
  • Exceptional organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders and time-sensitive decisions simultaneously. 
  • Sound judgement and discretion, including experience handling sensitive or confidential matters. 
  • Comfortable operating with incomplete information, and confident making calls on when to resolve issues independently versus escalate. 
  • The ability to lead through influence rather than authority, working effectively with peers and country teams who have their own mandates and priorities.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to synthesise complex information for diverse audiences.
  • Inter-disciplinary interests and experience, such as having worked in different sectors (business, government, nonprofit), countries and roles. 
  • Fluency in English and at least one of French, German, Spanish, Polish or Portuguese languages.
  • At least six years’ working experience in such fields as public opinion research, public policy, political science, and international relations.


OTHER INFORMATION

More in Common intentionally invests time, energy, and resources in nurturing a distinctive values-driven culture. This culture defines how we work together as a team and with others:

  • Humble, ambitious and generous
  • Rigour and excellence in everything we do
  • Driven by the common good, not by ideology or partisanship
  • Deep curiosity about people, and a commitment to elevating others’ views, particularly those whose voices are largely unheard
  • Firmly rooted in each of our national contexts but curious about the world beyond
  • Valuing diversity of thought, allowing our own beliefs to be challenged and embracing healthy disagreement
  • Embracing a dual role as both sense-makers and change-makers
  • Valuing courage and risk-taking
  • Embracing learning and innovation, and always looking for new paths to make a difference
  • Engaging others from a starting point of trust
  • Drawing from a wide range of backgrounds, worldviews, identities and life experiences
  • Believing in the power of a good laugh and being a great place to work.


COMPENSATION AND CONDITIONS

  • Competitive salary related to location, and excellent benefits along with generous leave and family policy 
  • Some regular international travel
  • Personal learning budget
  • Working in one of our country offices, with a preference for London as our CEO is most often there


DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

We believe our impact can be greater if our team reflects a broad range of social and cultural backgrounds, beliefs, political persuasions and life experiences. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive team.


DEADLINES AND HOW TO APPLY

The deadline to apply is August 31, 2026. Interested candidates should include a CV and a cover letter explaining your personal reasons for wanting to work at More in Common, in this role. A strong cover letter reflects the kind of attention we try to bring to our work - original, insightful and personalised. We want to hear something that only you could tell us, without AI assistance.

Greetings, fellow seeker of sustainable futures! We're thrilled to present a pivotal role that connects cutting-edge technology with the operational excellence of renewable energy assets across Europe, the Senior O&M Asset Manager. Curious what this quest entails? Let's dive right in:

  • Hold senior accountability for the asset management of PV and ESS portfolios across Europe, ensuring compliance with LTSAs, SLAs, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Asset Managers, setting objectives, reviewing performance, and building capability.
  • Act as the senior escalation point and primary customer interface for complex technical, contractual, warranty, and corrective service issues.
  • Perform and oversee advanced contract analysis, identifying risks, obligations, and value optimization opportunities, and actively support LTSA negotiations.
  • Provide senior technical oversight by reviewing and validating Root Cause Analyses (RCAs), interpreting SCADA data, and assessing equipment logs.
  • Lead service partner performance management in collaboration with procurement and O&M teams, focusing on cost control, service quality, and contractual compliance.
  • Drive a data-driven asset management approach, including availability and performance analysis, spare parts strategy, and lifecycle cost optimization.
  • Ensure strong cross-functional coordination with Projects, Sales, Engineering, and HQ to support asset handover and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Contribute directly to the profitability and long-term value of the O&M business through cost optimization, risk management, and performance-driven decision-making.
  • Champion continuous improvement in processes, reporting, asset performance, reliability, and team ways of working across the European asset management function.


Your profile

All right, all right, that was intriguing, wasn't it? Now, in order to fit in this role and be happy for a long time, your ideal background should look a lot like this:

  • A degree in engineering, business, contracting, or a related technical field is essential.
  • You possess a strong technical background in PV and Energy Storage (BESS) technologies.
  • Extensive experience in O&M asset management, handling complex asset portfolios and long-term service agreements is required.
  • Advanced expertise in contract analysis, including warranties, SLAs, penalties, liabilities, and risk allocation, is crucial.
  • You have a proven ability to review and validate RCAs, and to analyze SCADA data and equipment logs at a senior decision-making level.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams, with the ability to set priorities, coach performance, and drive accountability is expected.
  • You exhibit strong stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills with customers, internal teams, and service partners.
  • You are highly analytical, structured, and commercially minded, with a strong focus on profitability and value creation.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory, and proficiency in other languages is a plus.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word) is necessary, with advanced data analysis skills being an advantage.
  • You can operate effectively within a multicultural, matrix organization, with regular interaction with HQ and senior leadership.

, PRIČAKUJEMO:  Prednost imajo kandidati z izkušnjami na področju medicine oziroma s prodajo medicinske opreme. Zaželeno je dobro poznavanje računalniških orodij (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, e-pošta, internet), dobre komunikacijske in pogajalske sposobnosti ter pripravljenost na terensko, timsko in projektno delo. Pričakujemo samostojnost, organiziranost, odgovornost, usmerjenost k rezultatom in rešitvam ter veselje do dela s strankami. Pomembna je tudi pripravljenost na stalno strokovno izobraževanje in spoznavanje novih medicinskih produktov. PONUJAMO. Zaposlitev v stabilnem in urejenem podjetju AFIRIS d.o.o., dinamično in samostojno delo (2–3 dni na teden na terenu, preostalo delo v pisarni), delo z različnimi poslovnimi partnerji in zanimiv prodajni program medicinske opreme. Nudimo službeno vozilo in potrebno opremo, uvajanje in podporo pri spoznavanju prodajnega programa, strokovno izobraževanje ter možnost pridobivanja dodatnega znanja in dolgoročnega sodelovanja.  
Če ste izkušen prodajnik, ki zna prepoznati potrebe strank, predstaviti ustrezno rešitev, vzpostaviti zaupanje in uspešno zaključiti prodajo, vas vabimo, da se nam predstavite. Še posebej bomo veseli kandidatov, ki lahko združijo prodajne izkušnje in medicinsko znanje ter želijo poslovnim partnerjem ponuditi več kot le prodajo – kakovostno in strokovno svetovanje.,

Delo z namenom in občutkom, da prispevate nekaj pomembnega, podpora sodelavcev in prijetno delovno okolje, mentorstvo in pomoč pri uvajanju, možnosti dodatnih izobraževanj in strokovne rasti, stabilna zaposlitev in koriščenje bogatih ugodnosti za zaposlene družbe Thermane.,

jobs.title: Social Media Manager Freelance -  % Télétravail (H/F)
jobs.description: À propos de la mission Nous recherchons un(e) Freelance Social Media Manager expérimenté(e) pour développer et piloter la présence de nos clients, principalement des TPE et PME, sur les réseaux sociaux. La mission couvre l'ensemble du cycle Social Media : de la définition de la stratégie éditoriale à la création et publication des contenus, en passant par l'animation des communautés et l'analyse des performances. Nous recherchons un profil capable de travailler de manier/ière autonome sur plusieurs clients et d'adapter la stratégie, le ton et les contenus aux objectifs de chaque entreprise. Vos responsabilités Stratégie Social Media Définir des stratégies Social Media adaptées aux objectifs, à la cible et au positionnement de chaque client. Identifier les plateformes les plus pertinentes : LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, etc. Définir les lignes éditoriales, piliers de contenu, formats et fréquences de publication. Construire et gérer les calendriers éditoriaux. Réaliser une veille régulier/ière sur les tendances, formats et évolutions des différentes plateformes. Création & Rédaction de Contenu Concevoir les sujets et angles éditoriaux adaptés à chaque marque. Rédiger les publications en respectant le ton et l'identité de chaque client. Créer des contenus engageants adaptés aux spécificités de chaque plateforme. Rédiger des accroches, captions et appels à l'action efficaces. Adapter et décliner les contenus entre les différentes plateformes. Utiliser les outils d'IA de manier/ière pertinente pour accélérer la recherche, l'idéation et la production de contenu. Création & Coordination Visuelle Définir les besoins en visuels, vidéos, carrousels, infographies et autres formats. Être capable de produire des contenus visuels simples à l'aide d'outils tels que Canva. Préparer des briefs clairs pour les graphistes, vidéastes ou motion designers lorsque des créations plus avancées sont nécessaires. Garantir la cohérence entre les contenus publiés et l'identité visuelle de chaque marque. Publication & Community Management Planifier et publier les contenus sur les différentes plateformes. Assurer la cohérence et la régularité des publications. Suivre les commentaires, messages et interactions. Animer les communautés et favoriser l'engagement. Identifier les opportunités permettant de développer organiquement les audiences. Performance & Reporting Suivre les principaux KPI : portée, impressions, engagement, croissance de l'audience, clics, trafic et conversions. Analyser les performances des publications et identifier les formats et sujets les plus efficaces. Adapter les stratégies éditoriales en fonction des résultats. Produire des reportings clairs accompagnés de recommandations concrètes. Piloter la stratégie avec une approche orientée visibilité, engagement et génération d'opportunités commerciales. Profil recherché Expérience : expérience solide et démontrable en Social Media Management, idéalement acquise en agence ou avec la gestion simultanée de plusieurs clients. Réseaux sociaux : excellente maîtrise de LinkedIn, Instagram et Facebook. La connaissance de TikTok est un plus. Content & Copywriting : excellente capacité rédactionnelle et capacité à adapter le ton, les messages et les formats selon les marques et leurs audiences. Création : bonne maîtrise de Canva ou d'outils similaires pour la production de contenus simples et capacité à travailler avec des créatifs sur des productions plus avancées. Stratégie : capacité à construire une véritable stratégie éditoriale au-delà de la simple publication de contenus. Analytics : capacité à analyser les performances Social Media et à transformer les résultats en recommandations concrètes. IA : bonne maîtrise des outils d'IA appliqués à la recherche, l'idéation et la création de contenu. TPE/PME : bonne compréhension des enjeux et contraintes des petites et moyennes entreprises. Organisation : excellente capacité à gérer plusieurs clients et calendriers éditoriaux simultanément. Qualités : autonomie, créativité, rigueur, proactivité et capacité à proposer régulier/ièrement de nouvelles idées. Portfolio : la capacité à présenter des comptes gérés, exemples de contenus réalisés et résultats obtenus sera particulier/ièrement appréciée. jobs.title: DEEP - Cloud Systems Architect - Cloud Souverain (H/F)

Analyser les besoins métiers et techniques des clients, définir les trajectoires de transformation et élaborer les architectures et services cibles adaptées aux contraintes d'exploitation, de sécurité, de souveraineté et de time-to-market. Accompagner les projets de migration et de modernisation d'infrastructures et de plateformes applicatives vers OVH Public Cloud, Clever Cloud et des approches cloud native basées sur Kubernetes et services managés. Diriger ou encadrer l'intégration des composants techniques nécessaires aux solutions retenues : réseau, sécurité, IAM, observabilité, sauvegarde, CI/CD, registry, plateformes Kubernetes, services de données et composants d'automatisation. Garantir l'intégration de la sécurité dès la conception (security by design), ainsi que l'application des bonnes pratiques de résilience, de continuité, de sauvegarde, de conformité et de gouvernance. Piloter la standardisation et l'industrialisation des plateformes via l'Infrastructure as Code, l'automatisation, les pratiques DevOps/GitOps et les pipelines de déploiement. Définir et faire appliquer les architectures de référence pour les environnements cloud native, incluant les aspects de déploiement, d'observabilité, de logging, de gestion des secrets, de sécurité et de cycle de vie des plateformes. Apporter une expertise d'architecture sur les sujets PaaS, plateformes conteneurisées, intégration applicative, services managés et écosystèmes open source liés au cloud native. Jouer un rôle de référent technique auprès des équipes d'ingénierie, d'exploitation, de delivery, d'avant-vente et des clients, afin de sécuriser les choix techniques et de favoriser l'adoption des solutions définies. Assurer une veille technologique active et proposer des évolutions pertinentes sur les services OVH, Clever Cloud, les technologies cloud native et les approches d'automatisation afin d'enrichir les offres et les plateformes de DEEP. Réaliser des missions de consultance en architecture auprès des clients, afin de les accompagner dans la définition de leurs trajectoires cloud, l'évaluation des choix techniques et la conception de solutions adaptées à leurs enjeux métier et techniques. Supporter, concevoir et faire émerger de nouveaux services autour de ses domaines de compétence (cloud public, cloud native, architecture, automatisation, plateforme), en participant à la définition des standards, des briques techniques, de la documentation et du positionnement de ces services dans le catalogue de l'entreprise. Disposer d'une expérience significative dans la conception, l'intégration ou l'évolution d'architectures cloud pour des clients, avec une capacité démontrée à cadrer des solutions complexes. Maîtriser les concepts et architectures IaaS, PaaS, KaaS, cloud public, cloud souverain et services managés. Avoir une connaissance d'OVH Public Cloud et/ou de Clever Cloud. Maîtriser les principes d'architecture cloud native et les plateformes conteneurisées, en particulier Kubernetes et l'écosystème associé. Connaître plusieurs technologies cloud native et DevOps parmi les suivant/antes : GitLab, Keycloak, Nexus, SonarQube, FluxCD, Crossplane, Velero, Kasten, RabbitMQ, Kafka, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, AKS, EKS ou équivalents. Selon sa spécialisation, il peut exercer: En Role 1 : prise en charge visant à garantir la survie du patient dans des conditions dégradées, selon le principe du damage control resuscitation; En Role 2 : prise en charge incluant une capacité chirurgicale d'urgence, reposant sur le damage control surgery, privilégiant la rapidité et le contrôle des lésions vitales plutôt que leur réparation définitive immédiate; Pour entretenir ses compétences cliniques, le médecin militaire exerce également dans le domaine clinique civil. Conditions d'admission Diplômes Vous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu par l'État du siège de l'établissement et sanctionnant l'accomplissement avec succès d'un master en Médecin spécialiste en traumatologie et médecine d'urgence ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 7 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Vous disposez de l'autorisation d'exercer la profession. Langues Vous répondez aux exigences de connaissances des 3 langues administratives pour le groupe de traitement A1.  Vous avez la  luxembourgeoise. Être reconnu ement et psychologiquement apte pour le service militaire. Avoir une présentation compatible avec l'exercice de la fonction et le port d'uniforme.   Examen-concours: Examen-concours au Centre militaire du  au  octobre  Épreuve sportive, épreuves de langues, tests psychotechniques, épreuve de connaissances générales, évaluation psychologique et entretien de motivation. jobs.title: Concepteur d'offres de formation (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Institut de formation de l'Education nationale (IFEN) Missions Contribuer à la conception de nouvelles offres de formation dans le domaine du développement scolaire: Analyser les enjeux et besoins des établissements scolaires en matier/ière de développement organisationnel, pédagogique et de leadership; Proposer des axes de développement et des pistes de réflexion de nouvelles offres de formation; Contribuer à la conception pédagogique et didactique de contenus et de format de formations qui respectent les attentes et besoins des publics cibles; Concevoir des dispositifs intégrés combinant formation, accompagnement, coaching, communautés d'apprentissage et travail collaboratif; Veiller à l'articulation entre développement des compétences individuelles et développement des organisations scolaires; Favoriser le transfert des apprentissages dans les pratiques professionnelles et institutionnelles; Concevoir des formats favorisant l'intelligence collective, la participation et la mobilisation des acteurs; Intégrer les principes de la conduite du changement dans les dispositifs proposés; Soutenir le développement de cultures collaboratives et réflexives au sein des établissements; Actualiser les offres de formation et assurer l'innovation dans le domaine pédagogique et didactique. Effectuer des études et analyses comparatives: Étudier et comprendre les enjeux des offres de formation à sa charge; Réaliser une veille des tendances et bonnes pratiques concernant les offres de formation à sa charge. Recenser et analyser les besoins de formation: Contribuer au recensement des besoins de formation (identifier et collaborer avec les partenaires nécessaires au recensement des besoins de formation); Analyser les besoins de formation recensés et proposer des pistes de formation et de développement des compétences. Développer et cultiver un concept d'ingénierie de formation: Mettre en place, le cas échéant avec des experts externes, un concept d'ingénierie de formation décrivant l'implémentation et le suivi des offres de formation; Tenir à jour et adapter régulier/ièrement le concept d'ingénierie de formation; Présenter et promouvoir de façon systématique le concept de l'ingénierie de formation et des offres de formation et en assurer l'adhésion auprès des publics cibles. Transformer les demandes de formation en actions de formation: Définir les caractéristiques des actions de formation à entreprendre (public cible, contexte, objectifs visés, contenu, compétences à développer, etc.); Rechercher les formateurs compétents pour intervenir dans la formation et fixer avec eux les modalités de déroulement de la formation à mettre en place; Identifier et collaborer avec les partenaires nécessaires à la bonne réalisation des offres de formation; Communiquer les offres de formation auprès des groupes cibles. Suivre et contribuer à l'adaptation pédagogique des offres de formation: Assurer une veille permanente des offres de formation en place et veiller à son adaptation régulier/ière; Proposer des lignes de conduite en matier/ière pédagogique et didactique aux formateurs et en assurer l'implémentation par le biais de formations de formateurs. Accompagner les établissements dans la mise en place des offres de formation interne: Être à l'écoute des établissements et susciter leur intérêt dans la mise en place d'offres de formation répondant à des besoins spécifiques; Assister les établissements dans la mise en place d'offres de formation (projet spécifique pour chaque établissement avec suivi rapproché, conseil, support et aide à la mise en place); Veiller avec les établissements à la mise en œuvre et au bon déroulement des offres de formation. Évaluer les offres de formation: Procéder avec les publics cibles et les établissements concernés à l'évaluation des offres de formation; Mesurer les résultats obtenus surtout dans le domaine de l'amélioration des compétences des agents ayant suivi des actions de formation. Assurer un accueil auprès des participants et des formateurs: Renseigner, conseiller, orienter et clarifier selon les besoins exprimés. Contribuer à l'évolution du dispositif et à la gestion de la qualité: Veiller au respect des procédures liées à l'exercice de la fonction; Contribuer à l'évolution des procédures liées à l'exercice de la fonction. Profil Compétences techniques Connaître les théories et modèles du développement scolaire; Connaître les approches systémiques appliquées aux organisations éducatives; Connaître les principes du leadership pédagogique et du leadership distribué; Connaître les processus de conduite du changement; Connaître les principes de l'apprentissage organisationnel; Connaître les démarches d'évaluation et d'amélioration continue des établissements scolaires; Connaître les politiques éducatives...

jobs.description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? La Bibliothèque nationale du Luxembourg (BnL) s'engage dans un nouveau programme visant à améliorer l'accessibilité de ses collections, en particulier celles des Fonds spéciaux, qui abritent des trésors patrimoniaux uniques : cartes historiques, plans, atlas, vues topographiques et documents cartographiques rares. Avec cartes et plans couvrant des représentations du monde, du Luxembourg et de ses territoires, cette collection se distingue comme l'une des plus remarquables du pays. Pourtant, cette collection reste non cataloguée, donc inaccessible en ligne. La BnL cherche à renforcer l'équipe patrimoniale avec un expert polyvalent, capable de gérer des tâches complexes liées à la préservation et à l'accessibilité du patrimoine. Missions Catalogage et valorisation des collections: Enrichir les métadonnées, référencer, cataloguer, indexer et exemplariser les documents des Fonds spéciaux, surtout les cartes, plans, atlas, vues, selon les normes en vigueur (SIGB Alma, RDA, Rameau, DDC); Structurer les critères de collection pour les documents cartographiques, en collaboration avec l'équipe patrimoniale; Établir une charte d'acquisition et une politique de conservation adaptées aux spécificités des fonds cartographiques; Contrôler la cohérence du développement du Fonds des cartes, plans et atlas, en veillant à son alignement avec les objectifs stratégiques de la BnL. Gestion et accessibilité numérique: Piloter la numérisation des collections cartographiques; Valoriser les collections à l'aide des nouvelles technologies (humanités numériques, outils de recherche scientifique) pour en faciliter l'accès au public et aux chercheurs; Collaborer avec les services IT pour intégrer les données cartographiques dans les plateformes numériques de la BnL (eluxemburgensia). Profil Compétences techniques Expérience avérée en: Catalogage de documents patrimoniaux (normes RDA, Rameau, DDC); Gestion de SIGB (idéalement Alma); Numérisation et valorisation de collections spéciales; Maîtrise des outils de traitement d'images, de métadonnées et de bases de données bibliographiques; Connaissances en conservation préventive des documents anciens et fragiles; Rigueur et précision : capacité à travailler avec des documents uniques et parfois fragiles; Esprit d'initiative : proposition de solutions innovant/antes pour améliorer l'accessibilité des collections; Collaboration : travail en équipe avec les autres services de la BnL (patrimoine, IT, communication); Sens de la médiation : aptitude à rendre les collections compréhensibles et attractives pour le public. jobs.description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Administration de la navigation aérien/ienne (ANA), rattachée au ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics, est le fournisseur de services de navigation aérien/ienne du Luxembourg, basée à Findel. Notre mission est de garantir un trafic aérien sûr, efficace et respectueux de l'environnement dans les espaces aériens nationaux et délégués ainsi qu'à l'aérodrome. Missions Afin de renforcer notre département Météorologie, nous recrutons un(e) Prévisionniste en météorologie. En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez directement à une mission d'intérêt public essentielle : assurer la sécurité des opérations aérien/iennes grâce à une expertise météorologique de haut niveau, tout en contribuant aux missions météorologiques nationales. La météorologie aéronautique est une discipline scientifique exigeant/ante qui repose sur l'analyse de phénomènes s complexes, l'interprétation de modèles numériques et la prise de décisions en temps réel. Pour réussir dans cette fonction ainsi que dans la formation spécialisée dispensée par nos partenaires internationaux, un intérêt marqué pour les sciences ainsi que de solides bases en mathématiques, et sciences de la nature constituent de véritables atouts. Vous serez notamment chargé(e) de : Analyser et interpréter les observations et données météorologiques (satellites, radars, réseaux de détection de la foudre, modèles numériques, etc.) ; Élaborer, actualiser et diffuser les prévisions météorologiques nationales et aéronautiques ; Produire les messages météorologiques destinés aux usagers de l'aviation conformément aux normes internationales ; Assurer une veille météorologique permanente et diffuser les alertes en cas de phénomènes dangereux ; Fournir une assistance météorologique aux pilotes, aux services de la navigation aérien/ienne et aux autres partenaires opérationnels ; Collaborer avec les organismes météorologiques nationaux et internationaux ; Contribuer au maintien et à l'amélioration continue du système de management de la qualité, de la sécurité et de l'environnement du département ; Promouvoir et appliquer les principes de la Just Culture au sein de l'ANA. Le poste s'exerce dans le cadre d'un service continu heures sur et 7 jours sur 7, selon un système de travail en équipes comprenant les soirées, les nuits, les week-ends et les jours fériés. Ce que l'ANA a à vous offrir : L'ANA investit pleinement dans votre développement professionnel. Vous bénéficierez d'une formation spécialisée en météorologie entier/ièrement financée par l'ANA, d'une durée de à mois, auprès d'institutions européennes de référence telles que : Le Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD) à Langen (Allemagne) ; L'École Nationale de la Météorologie de Météo-France à Toulouse (France). Cette formation couvre notamment : La de l'atmosphère ; La thermodynamique ; La dynamique des fluides ; Les mathématiques appliquées ; Les modèles numériques de prévision ; La météorologie aéronautique ; L'analyse scientifique des phénomènes météorologiques. La réussite de cette formation nécessite une réelle appétence pour les disciplines scientifiques ainsi qu'une forte capacité d'apprentissage et d'analyse. Le recrutement des prévisionnistes en météorologie est particulier/ièrement exigeant afin de garantir la réussite de la formation spécialisée et l'exercice d'une fonction essentielle à la sécurité aérien/ienne. Le processus de sélection comprend plusieurs étapes : Analyse des candidatures et vérification des conditions d'admission; Test d'anglais; Épreuves écrites visant notamment à évaluer : Les capacités de raisonnement scientifique et logique ; Les connaissances générales en mathématiques, et sciences ; Les aptitudes analytiques. Entretien devant une commission de sélection, permettant d'apprécier la motivation, les compétences comportementales, la capacité d'apprentissage et l'adéquation du candidat avec les exigences de la fonction. Compte tenu du niveau d'exigence de la formation et des responsabilités confiées aux prévisionnistes, seuls les candidats démontrant de solides aptitudes scientifiques, analytiques et comportementales pourront poursuivre le processus de sélection. Exercer une profession scientifique passionnant/ante ayant un impact direct sur la sécurité aérien/ienne ; Intégrer une administration moderne, dynamique et tournée vers l'innovation ; Évoluer aux côtés de spécialistes reconnus dans leur domaine ; Bénéficier d'un parcours de formation de très haut niveau reconnu à l'échelle européenne ; Développer continuellement vos compétences dans un environnement international ; Partager les valeurs de l'ANA : Intégrité, Respect, Innovation, Engagement et Excellence. Vous êtes prêt(e) à relever ce défi ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui et devenez acteur...
