jobs.title: DEEP -  Technical Account Manager - Cloud Souverain (H/F)
jobs.description: Afin de renforcer les équipes de DEEP au sein de la Business Line Cloud, nous recherchons actuellement un(e)  Technical Account Manager - Cloud Souverain (m/f/n) à temps plein.Vos missions Être le point de contact technique privilégié du client, en coordination avec le SDM. Développer et maintenir une compréhension approfondie de l'environnement IT du client, de ses architectures, contraintes, priorités et trajectoires d'évolution. Accompagner le client dans la compréhension, l'adoption et l'évolution des services Sovereign Cloud proposés par DEEP, OVHcloud et Clever Cloud, en agissant comme trusted technical advisor. Assurer l'interface quotidien/ienne entre le client et les architectes, experts, équipes Engineering, Product et partenaires technologiques, et faciliter la collaboration entre l'ensemble des parties prenant/antes. Comprendre et qualifier les besoins techniques du client, mobiliser les bonnes compétences afin d'identifier les solutions appropriées et accompagner l'introduction de nouvelles capacités et de nouveaux services. Identifier de manier/ière proactive les besoins futurs, risques techniques, dépendances, limitations et opportunités d'amélioration. Contribuer à la construction et au maintien de la roadmap technique du compte, sous l'accountability du SDM, et assurer son alignement avec les roadmaps DEEP, OVHcloud et Clever Cloud. Organiser et animer les Technical Reviews, workshops techniques et sessions de roadmap avec le client et les différentes parties prenant/antes. Accompagner les discussions techniques avec DIGIT et les institutions européennes et assurer la continuité de la relation technique avec leurs équipes. Identifier les écarts entre les besoins du client et les capacités disponibles, les formaliser auprès des équipes Architecture, Engineering et Product Management, et assurer le suivi des sujets techniques nécessitant une attention particulier/ière. Apporter au client une communication claire sur la progression et les impacts des sujets techniques, ainsi qu'au SDM les éléments nécessaires à la gouvernance du compte : risques, dépendances, évolutions, décisions attendues et opportunités. Contribuer également aux Service Reviews et Steering Committees. Capitaliser sur les retours et besoins du client afin de contribuer à l'amélioration continue des offres Sovereign Cloud de DEEP, tout en identifiant les opportunités de développement du compte à partager avec le SDM et les équipes commerciales. Votre profil Diplôme universitaire en informatique, ingénierie ou domaine connexe (Bac +5), ou expérience professionnelle équivalente. Expérience confirmée dans une fonction de Technical Account Manager, Technical Customer Success Manager, Cloud Advisor, Solution Architect orienté client ou fonction équivalente. Bonne compréhension des environnements Cloud, Private Cloud, Hybrid Cloud et Sovereign Cloud, ainsi que des principaux composants d'une plateforme cloud (compute, storage, network, security, IAM, backup, connectivity, resilience et capacity). Une connaissance de l'écosystème OVHcloud, notamment de son approche On-Prem Cloud Platform (OPCP), ainsi que de Clever Cloud et de son positionnement dans un écosystème Sovereign Cloud, constitue un atout. Capacité à comprendre des architectures et problématiques techniques complexes et à les traduire en recommandations claires et pertinentes pour les clients. Expérience dans des environnements complexes et multi-fournisseurs nécessitant une coordination entre plusieurs organisations ; une expérience avec les institutions européennes, la Commission européenne ou DIGIT constitue un avantage important. Bonne compréhension des principes de Service Management, des SLA et d'ITIL, ainsi qu'excellentes compétences en communication, présentation, coordination et gestion des parties prenant/antes. Capacité à développer des relations de confiance durables avec les clients, combinée à une vision stratégique, une forte curiosité technique, de l'autonomie, de la proactivité et une orientation résultats  Bonne maitrise du français et de l'anglais  Intéressé(e) ? jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Solutions Engineer — EMEA

At Phrase, we help open the door to global business by providing the world's leading Language Intelligence Platform.

The Phrase Platform combines AI, agentic orchestration, and a headless, API-first architecture in one composable system. Beyond translation, it orchestrates and adapts content to culture, audience, channel, brand voice, and intended outcome in any language, for every audience. It applies the context that makes content perform in every market: quality standards, glossaries, prior translations, and cultural nuance. Every team, in every region, can ship content that is on-brand, on-point, and ready for any audience.

Phrase gives enterprises the intelligence to automate workflows, the freedom to connect their own tools and engines, and the control to govern global content at scale.

With a global team based in our offices, and remote colleagues across Europe, the UK, the US, and the APAC region, Phrase offers an international environment built on collaboration, innovation, and shared purpose.

This is a senior individual contributor role, reporting to the VP of Solutions Engineering. You will be working hand in hand with Enterprise AEs across EMEA, running discovery, building the business case and delivering demos and Proof of Value workshops that actually connect to what's keeping a customer's business up at night.

We're building an AI-first pre-sales organisation where continuous improvement is part of everyone's role. You'll be encouraged to challenge how things are done, use AI and automation to remove repetitive work and help create smarter ways of working for the whole team. If your instinct is to ask "there must be a better way" and then go and build it, you'll thrive here.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Run technical discovery across a portfolio of EMEA enterprise opportunities and find the business impact that sits beyond the localization workflow

  • Build demos tailored to the prospect, their industry and the people in the room, not a generic script

  • Translate what the platform does into outcomes a VP or C-level buyer actually cares about

  • Partner with AEs on deal strategy, RFP/RFI responses and competitive positioning

  • Own POCs and POVs end to end: scope them properly, run them and prove the value, not just the functionality

  • Continuously improve how we work by using AI, automation and new technologies to remove repetitive tasks and create better ways of working.

  • Challenge existing processes, experiment with new ideas and help shape the tools and practices the whole team uses.

  • Feed competitive intel and win/loss insight back to Product and Sales leadership.

  • Work closely with our Product team to influence and set the direction of the platform

  • Be in front of customers and represent Phrase at events across EMEA

  • Share what you know. We run an SE culture where the ability to work as a team and support others is a requirement

  • Help mentor other SEs and the rest of the GTM team as we grow the enterprise motion

What you'll need

  • Solid experience (at least 5 years) in pre-sales, solutions engineering or solutions consulting, ideally in language, localization or content tech

  • A real understanding of how localization teams operate, what pressure they're under commercially and who signs off the budget

  • The range to run a discovery call with a CMO as comfortably as with a localization lead

  • Good commercial instinct. Reading the room, adapting your message and knowing when to push and when to sit back

  • Experience selling into or supporting enterprise accounts in EMEA. APAC exposure is a bonus, not a requirement

  • The ability to use AI tools extensively, as part of how you work, not just to chat

  • Fluent German strongly preferred, other European languages welcome

  • A team-first mindset. We operate a team culture that is incredibly open and supportive. There are no individual heroes here.

  • Time at an LSP, localization tech vendor or enterprise software company in a commercial-facing role is a plus

  • CS or implementation background with strong commercial exposure also considered

 

What you'll get:

• Work at a successful and growing global SaaS company

• Be part of an international team in Europe, APAC and the Americas

• Expert colleagues in their field who are determined to build the best localization platform in the market, creating a world where language never limits opportunity

• An agile work environment, where it is encouraged to take smart risks

• Take part in a culture full of trust, support and loyalty, where respectful and open feedback is valued and diversity is fully embraced

• A positive, open-minded, and innovative atmosphere

• Support in your professional development and personal career goals

 

What's on top:

• 4 Company holidays additional to your regular holidays (1 day per quarter where the entire company is off to celebrate our achievements).

• In addition, the company also provides employees with a Christmas break to allow you to spend time with family and friends without use of your vacation allocation.

• Your birthday is off because it is important to celebrate you as well.

• 2 Giveback days where you can support the local community, volunteer, and/or participate in charity events and activities.

• Professional and extensive onboarding.

• Enterprise Claude Licence

• Additional local benefits depending on the entity in which you are hired, just ask your Talent Acquisition Partner

• Uncapped performance bonus based on a percentage of revenue closed with individual and team components

 

Phrase is committed to ensuring equal pay for equal work and work of equal value between women and men. Our aim is that our workforce will be truly representative of all sections of society and that each worker feels respected and able to give their best. The job requirements and salary range for this job have been established through a gender-neutral job evaluation and classification process. This process objectively assesses the skills, responsibility, effort and working conditions required for each job. This systematic approach ensures fair pay regardless of who performs the work. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of their sex, race or ethnicity, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation, gender identity or age. We value and welcome different perspectives, experiences and backgrounds as we believe that these differences make our team even stronger on our mission of opening the door to global business by giving everybody access to the content they need in the language they speak.

jobs.title: Language Lead - French (Contract)
jobs.description:
About Cartesia

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

Overview

We are seeking native-level French speakers with a linguistics background to serve as the primary language resource for voice AI in their language. You will be the trusted point of contact for all questions, quality decisions, and language-specific work related to French.

This is not a standard annotation engagement. You will own your language end to end, which includes managing annotation quality, auditing data, monitoring product performance, investigating customer-reported issues, and executing projects that require deep linguistic expertise and attention to detail. You will operate independently across these workstreams and serve as the team's go-to resource for anything related to your language.

This is an ongoing contractor engagement. Availability during some US Pacific business hours is preferred to allow for team syncs and real-time support.

 

About the Engagement

You will coordinate with the Human Evals Manager on project deliverables and timelines. Some examples of what your day-to-day work may include:

  • Answer questions from annotators about guidelines, edge cases, or language-specific issues via an agreed project communication channel.

  • Cascade new feedback, instructions, or rubric updates to annotators working on your projects.

  • Listen to annotator-rated audio files and check whether their ratings and written feedback align with the rubric.

  • Prepare written quality assessments for annotators with specific examples and recommendations.

  • Listen to TTS output and provide ground truth assessments of pronunciation, prosody, and naturalness in your language.

  • Update or expand sections of the annotation guidelines when you find gaps or edge cases.

  • Prep and run calibration meetings with annotators.

  • Hold office hours on a mutually agreed schedule during active studies so annotators can ask questions in real time.

  • Develop onboarding materials and resources for new annotators.

  • Write QA reports on annotation quality and calibration outcomes.

  • Review production audio in your language and flag quality issues to the team.

  • Investigate language-specific issues reported by customers and identify root causes.

  • Audit datasets for linguistic accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

     

Commitment

Roughly 40 hours per week with flexibility in scheduling. Project hours may vary depending on active studies, data projects, and product needs. Participation in periodic coordination meetings during US Pacific hours is expected.

 

Requirements

  • Native-level proficiency in French as spoken in France.

  • Experience with data annotation, transcription, or language quality assurance.

  • Strong foundation in linguistics or a related field, with the ability to apply concepts like phonetics, prosody, and intonation when evaluating speech and writing annotation guidelines.

  • Strong written English proficiency. All guidelines, feedback, reports, and team communication are in English.

  • Ability to write clear, structured instructions and deliver specific, actionable feedback to annotators.

  • Comfortable working with data and metrics such as inter-rater agreement scores, audit spreadsheets, and structured feedback templates.

  • Self-directed and able to manage feedback cycles, QA reviews, and data projects without close oversight.

Preferred

  • Experience writing or maintaining annotation guidelines or rubrics.

  • Experience training, mentoring, or managing other annotators.

  • Experience with audio evaluation, TTS, or STT.

  • Conversational spoken English proficiency for meetings and calibration syncs.

  • Experience working with distributed, remote teams.

jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer
jobs.description:
About iSpeedToLead

iSpeedToLead is the leading pay-per-lead marketplace for real estate wholesalers, investors, and agents in the US. We sell motivated seller leads with no subscriptions and no contracts. Bootstrapped, profitable, $15M+ ARR, ~50 people across Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and the US. We move fast, we measure everything, and we are building for a much bigger outcome.

Why this role exists

The CEO is doing two jobs: setting strategy and running day-to-day operations. Your job is to take the second one and run it better than he does. You own execution across the whole company so the CEO can focus on product vision, new verticals, and growth bets.

What you will own

• The operating system of the company: department goals, KPIs, weekly scoreboards, and accountability across Supply, Demand, and Marketplace teams

• Department heads: run their cadence, remove blockers, make sure every leader hits their two core KPIs with hard guardrails against metric gaming

• P&L discipline: unit economics per department, cost caps, and a clear path to our monthly net profit target

• Cross-team execution: when a launch needs Supply, Demand, and Product working together, you make it happen on time

• Hiring and org design as we scale into new lead verticals (insurance, loans)

What success looks like in 12 months

• Every department runs on 2 KPIs with guardrails, reviewed weekly

• Net profit target hit and holding

• CEO is out of day-to-day operations completely

• At least one new vertical launched without breaking the core business

Who you are

• You have run operations at a proptech or marketplace company doing $10M+ in annual revenue. This is a hard requirement

• You know CPL, EPL, funnel math, and refund economics cold

• You have managed remote teams across time zones

• You are a scoreboard person, not a whitepaper person. You simplify, you do not add process for its own sake

• You are direct. You tell the CEO when he is wrong

• Bonus: you have taken a company through a major scale-up or exit

What this is not

• Not a strategy-deck job. You ship outcomes, not documents

• Not a caretaker role. If nothing changes in 90 days, it did not work

Comp

Competitive base plus performance bonus tied to net profit. Details discussed in the process.

To apply, send a short note on the hardest operational problem you have solved and what the numbers were before and after.

The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Dizajnéri a správcovia databáz
jobs.description:
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards translating complex operational data into actionable insights for business operations stakeholders; ensure models are performant, scalable, and governed.

Build and maintain automated workflows and business applications using Power Automate and Power Apps, reducing manual effort across core operations processes (approvals, data collection, escalation routing).

Own the data layer: write and optimize DAX measures and Power Query transformations; connect to sources including SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and Snowflake where applicable.

Collaborate with business operations teams to gather, challenge, and translate requirements into technical solutions — including scope control and managing change requests.

Administer production and distribution of internal financial reports, compile various cross functional reports. Drive the reporting simplification and efficiency.

Prepare, clean, and analyze large datasets from various sources (ERP, operational, and financial systems).

Maintain solution documentation, workspace governance, and RLS (row-level security) configurations in line with organizational data access policies.

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the Power Platform environment; support end-user adoption through training and hands-on guidance.

Contribute to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) standards for naming conventions, deployment pipelines, version control, and template reuse across the team.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

jobs.title: Správcovia objektov
jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

jobs.title: Správcovia systémov

Poskytovanie technickej podpory používateľom pri riešení bežných problémov s hardvérom, softvérom a podnikovými aplikáciami. Evidencia, klasifikácia a riešenie používateľských požiadaviek a incidentov prostredníctvom tiketovacieho systému HALO. Inštalácia, konfigurácia a príprava pracovných staníc, notebookov, tlačiarní, mobilných telefónov a ďalších koncových zariadení. Podpora používateľov pri práci s Microsoft 365 a štandardnými kancelárskymi aplikáciami. Správa používateľských účtov, hesiel a prístupových oprávnení podľa interných postupov. Evidencia a aktualizácia inventára IT hardvéru a softvéru. Spolupráca pri nákupe, príprave a vydávaní IT techniky novým zamestnancom. Základná správa tlačového prostredia vrátane riešenia bežných problémov s tlačiarňami a skenermi. Podpora výrobných pracovísk pri riešení základných IT problémov ovplyvňujúcich výrobnú prevádzku. Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. Dodržiavanie pravidiel informačnej bezpečnosti a podieľanie sa na ochrane firemných dát a IT prostriedkov. Plnenie ďalších úloh v oblasti IT podpory podľa pokynov nadriadeného alebo potrieb spoločnosti.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

jobs.title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
jobs.description:
Ak Ti nie je ľahostajný život ľudí ohrozených stratou bývania a s nepriaznivým zdravotným stavom, príď do Útulku a zariadenia opatrovateľskej služby sv. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Ak chceš vidieť ako to vyzerá za dverami útulku, pozri si videjko: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWIuYGiNTqE

jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

jobs.title: Wegenbouwer
jobs.description:
Deze vacature als wegenbouwer in Averbode is bij een klasse 8 bouwbedrijf dat meer dan 520 mensen tewerkstelt. Het bedrijf voert infrastructuurprojecten uit, met een focus op wegenbouw, nutsvoorzieningen en leidingenaanleg, en werkt voor onder andere overheden, luchthavens en nutsbedrijven. Je komt terecht in vaste ploegen, zodat je op de werf samenwerkt met vertrouwde collega’s. Nieuwe medewerkers krijgen een degelijke opstart, opleiding op maat en begeleiding. Op de werf is er een duidelijke structuur, er wordt gewerkt met degelijk materiaal en veiligheid krijgt aandacht vanaf dag één. Samenwerking staat centraal: van wegenwerker tot kraanmachinist tot werfleider, iedereen draagt bij aan een vlotte en veilige werksfeer. Het bedrijf investeert in lange-termijnrelaties met medewerkers en klanten, met als doel een stabiele werkomgeving en een collegiale sfeer op de werf.


Jobomschrijving

Deze functie van wegenbouwer in regio Averbode is er eentje voor wie geen dag graag twee keer beleeft. Van sleuven graven tot kabels leggen: jij vormt letterlijk de basis van de nutsvoorzieningen van morgen.

  • Je voert wegenwerken uit: sleuven, kuilen en putten graven en dichten voor het leggen van kabels, buizen en leidingen (o.a. voor elektriciteit en water).
  • Je ondersteunt bij het plaatsen van putten, betonstructuren en funderingen voor nutsleidingen, in samenwerking met kraanmachinisten en techniekers.
  • Je plaatst signalisatie en houdt het terrein proper en veilig, zodat de werken vlot kunnen doorgaan.
  • Je neemt werffoto’s via een app en communiceert met je team over de voortgang op de werf.
  • Bij onverwachte problemen (zoals bijvoorbeeld een gesprongen buis) ben je flexibel om overuren te presteren indien nodig.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Deze job als wegenbouwer in Averbode is er voor mensen die graag hun handen uit de mouwen steken, houden van werken in de buitenlucht, én voldoening halen uit zichtbare resultaten.

  • Je hebt ervaring in de grondwerken/wegenwerken of in de bouw.
  • Je kan fysiek werk aan en werkt graag buiten, ook bij wisselende weersomstandigheden.
  • Je hebt geen hoogtevrees.
  • Je kan vlot samenwerken en communiceren in een ploeg en volgt instructies correct op.
  • Je begrijpt het belang van nauwkeurig werken en volgt de veiligheidsinstructies stipt op.
  • Je toont initiatief op de werf.
  • Je bent bereid om in een 3-koppige ploeg te werken en flexibel in te springen waar nodig.
  • Je houdt ervan om actief te zijn, vooruitgang te zien en bij te dragen aan essentiële infrastructuur.
De ideale collega is...
  • Iemand die graag buiten werkt en energie haalt uit fysiek werk met de voeten in de aarde.
  • Iemand die vlot samenwerkt, duidelijk communiceert en collega’s actief helpt waar nodig.
  • Iemand die veiligheid belangrijk vindt en afspraken en instructies op de werf consequent volgt.
  • Iemand die stipt is en zich goed kan aanpassen aan een vroeg werkritme.
  • Iemand die initiatief durft nemen wanneer de situatie dat vraagt, zonder de teamafspraken uit het oog te verliezen.
  • Iemand die leergierig is en openstaat voor opleiding en bijscholing om te groeien in de wegenbouw.

jobs.title: Director of Revenue Operations (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Be bold, think big and grow with us!

As a Director of Revenue Operations, you'll play a pivotal role in driving revenue growth through process optimization, cross-functional alignment, data-driven decision-making, and strategic planning. Your efforts will contribute to the overall success and profitability of the organization. 

You are the trusted partner with global and regional GTM leaders to help identify and execute improvements to internal processes across all customer-facing roles. As a Director of RevOps, you will need to have strategic thinking coupled with effective execution. You'll cultivate relationships within the sales, marketing, customer operations, and finance divisions to pinpoint areas for improvement, and facilitate the provision of resources, tools, and support essential for success.

The ideal candidate is disciplined, structured, and detail-oriented, all while offering a customer-centric approach. You are a fast learner and can work independently and have a strong sense of ownership and possess the self-confidence to further develop this role at MARKT-PILOT. 

This role will report to our CO-CEO.  


Your Mission
  • Process Optimization: Identify inefficiencies in revenue-generating processes and implement improvements to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness. 
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Foster collaboration and alignment between sales, marketing, and finance teams to ensure coordinated efforts toward revenue goals. 
  • Data Analysis and Reporting: Analyze sales data, customer insights, and market trends to provide actionable recommendations for revenue enhancement strategies. Prepare and present comprehensive reports to stakeholders. 
  • Sales Enablement: Develop and implement sales enablement programs, including training, tools, and resources, to empower the sales team and improve their performance. 
  • Forecasting and Planning: Work closely with GTM leadership to develop accurate revenue forecasts and strategic plans to achieve revenue targets. 
  • Technology Management: Oversee the implementation and management of sales and revenue-related technologies, such as CRM systems and sales automation tools, to support operational efficiency and effectiveness. 
  • Performance Measurement: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to track and measure revenue performance, providing insights for continuous improvement. 
  • Revenue Growth Strategies: Collaborate with senior leadership to develop and execute revenue growth strategies, including pricing optimization, market expansion, and customer segmentation. 
  • Customer Experience Optimization: Identify opportunities to improve the customer experience throughout the revenue cycle, from lead generation to post-sale support, to drive repeat business and customer loyalty.
  • Compliance and Risk Management: Ensure compliance with relevant regulations and industry standards related to revenue operations, minimizing risk and maintaining business integrity

Your Skills
  • 5+ years of Sales Operations or Revenue Operations experience 
  • Deep understanding of SaaS business models, including subscription metrics (ARR, churn, ....), preferably experience in a SaaS company during periods of rapid growth
  • Excellent Analytical skills – experience in data modeling and dashboarding. Ability to deeply interrogate and manipulate data. Confidence and curiosity to understand the implications of the results, and the ability to recommend and present solutions to senior stakeholders. 
  • Excellent understanding of standard business practices related to Sales Operations processes (sales cycle, sales processes, forecasting and pipeline management, renewals, reporting and analysis, and territory management).
  • Say it, own it, deliver it! Is one of our core values and you having a track record of really getting things done and love to create impact  
  • Good knowledge of CRM (Hubspot (currently used), Salesforce, etc…) and other sales and marketing automation tools. 

Your Benefits
  • Our modern and open scale-up culture gives you the freedom to unleash your creativity within a dynamic and agile team. 💡 
  • Fail Fast, Learn Faster: Feedback here is exactly what it should be - an essential part of your work. 📈 
  • We invest in your growth: Discover our Learning & Development programs - including an L&D budget! 🌱 
  • Flexible working hours and the option to work hybrid. 
  • Rest is important too - 30 days of vacation 🏖️ 
  • Travel by Train: Even MARKT-PILOTS take the train! We subsidize your monthly Deutschland-Ticket! 🚆 
  • Job bikes for those who prefer to travel on two wheels! 🚴‍♀️ 
  • Crew-Love: Look forward to regular team events, exciting gaming sessions, and much more. 🎮️ 
  • Stay Healthy: With a discounted WELLPASS membership and healthy snacks, you can always recharge your batteries. 🍏 
  • Corporate Benefits: Discover a variety of attractive offers from top brands with exclusive discounts. 🛒

jobs.title: Publishing Product Director
jobs.description:
As Publishing Product Director, you are the creative custodian of one of Crytek’s games, embedded inside the game team, accountable for protecting the creative vision and translating the promise of the game into work that the publishing team can execute with conviction. The success of a great game depends on the work that surrounds it landing as truthfully as the game itself, and closing that gap is what this role exists to do. You make sure that what reaches players is authentic, aspirational, tells the story the game deserves, and delights the players who play it. 

The game in your remit is an unannounced project in the Crytek portfolio. The work focuses on shaping the project’s player promise from the inside out, defining the publishing narrative for its eventual reveal, and carrying its creative vision through to launch and into ongoing releases. 

You sit inside the game team, working shoulder-to-shoulder with game leadership every day. You partner directly with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to support both the game and the business as one connected effort. You are the direct line between the game team and the publishing organization, the person who protects the north star on both ends, and the person both sides trust to tell them the truth. 

This role demands creative conviction, drive, and the kind of experience that only comes from working shoulder-to-shoulder with game teams. You will protect the team from noise so they can build the game, and you will give the publishing team the clarity, player insight, and creative truth they need to land it well. It is one of the most consequential seats at Crytek, and one of the most rewarding. 


What You'll Do
  • Be the custodian of the game’s creative vision, tone, and player promise, and translate it into work that publishing can execute with conviction
  • Sit embedded inside the game team and act as the daily bridge between game leadership and the publishing organisation  
  • Serve as the source of truth on what the game is, what is coming next, and what it means for players, across Marketing, Comms, Community, and Commercial  
  • Brief and review every major marketing, comms, and community output for creative authenticity, ensuring it tells the right player story  
  • Partner with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to shape go-to-market plans that serve the game and the business in equal measure  
  • Drive franchise narrative, player promise, and creative direction across reveals, beats, and post-launch moments  
  • Protect the game team from operational noise so they can focus on building, while translating publishing priorities into work the team can act on  
  • Keep the north star intact on both ends, keeping publishing grounded in the game’s vision, and the game team grounded in player and market reality  

    • What You Bring
  • 8+ years working at the seam between game development and publishing or marketing, with significant time embedded inside game teams
  • Proven ability to translate creative vision into commercial activation without compromising either side, with strong creative judgement and editorial instinct you can defend under pressure  
  • Fluency across business models (premium, live service, DLC, F2P) and multi-year roadmap strategy, and how the two shape the player promise  
  • Cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence without authority across game and publishing teams  
  • Strong player insight, audience segmentation, and community fluency  
  • Drive and operating range, comfortable moving from creative critique in the morning to commercial trade-offs in the afternoon  
  • Experience supporting or launching at least one major game or live-service title from inside the game team  
  • Track record of being trusted by both game leadership and publishing leadership  

    • What you can expect from us

    Career Path 
    Your professional development is important to us, so we have laid out a career plan to help you progress towards your goals and objectives. 
     
    Relocation Support 
    We offer a relocation budget and full coverage of flights to Frankfurt for you and your family. 
    You can expect extensive assistance with visa, work permits, and communication with authorities during the relocation process, as well as help settling into Germany (e.g. setting up appointments with banks, government agencies, schools, landlords, finding apartments etc.).
     
    Company Apartment 
    To help you get settled, we provide you with a fully furnished company apartment during your first three months in Frankfurt.
     
    Public Transport Pass 
    Discover Frankfurt by bus, tram and metro – free of charge.
     
    Gym Card 
    A healthy body is a healthy mind. We offer a membership at the premium gym chain Fitness First in Germany. Work out, join group fitness classes, or relax in the wellness facilities.
     
    State-of-the-art Office
    We’ve recently moved into a brand-new, modern office located in the heart of Frankfurt. Our new workspace is designed to inspire creativity and collaboration, with open areas, quiet zones, and top-tier facilities — all just steps away from public transport, restaurants, bars and cultural hotspots.
     
    Hybrid Working
    We believe in the value of in-person collaboration while also supporting flexibility. Our hybrid working model includes three days per week in the office and the option to work remotely up to two days per week, unless role-specific requirements or business needs require you to be on site.
     
    Equal Opportunity & Inclusion
    We’re building a workplace where everyone belongs. We welcome people of all backgrounds and identities and are proud to be a truly global team, with employees from over 42 countries contributing their ideas, cultures, and perspectives every day.
     
    German Classes 
    Understanding the local culture will make your stay abroad more enjoyable, and Crytek supports that by offering German language courses for you and your family. 
      
    Events
    Join us on our exciting company events, including new starter breakfasts, summer and winter parties, our annual trip to Gamescom in Cologne, and many more!
     
    Vacation Days 
    At our Frankfurt office you can enjoy 24 days of vacation per year, and every 2 years you get 1 more (up to a maximum of 28 days). You will also have on average 10 public holidays on top of the days you take off.

jobs.title: Outdoor Activity Worker, Lapland Safaris Saariselkä
jobs.description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Outdoor Activity Workers for Lapland Safaris Saariselkä and Hetta for the Christmas season 2026.**

A workday of an Outdoor Activity Worker consists of various tasks including overseeing outdoor activities in a Christmas themed activity area surrounded by Lapland's beautiful nature. You will be working with international groups of guests, consisting of families with children. Your job is to make sure that all guests, children, and grown-ups are having a day full of joy and fun. The work is mostly independent, but at the same time you are a part of a big team which works in the same area.

Outdoor Activity Workers work during the busiest Christmas season, which means that working days are hectic and sometimes can be long. The length of the days varies according to the group and the program. The work includes preparation of the activity area and different kinds of maintenance work, as well as cleaning the area after the end of the day. The important task of providing clothing for our guests can also be your responsibility, as well as clothing maintenance.

Communication with guests is conducted mainly in English. Your English language skills do not have to be excellent, but you need to be able to give instructions to our guests in English and at least briefly answer their questions or direct the questions to another colleague. Other language skills, especially Spanish is very useful in Saariselkä. **In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement**

**In Saariselkä** you will introduce tobogganing, mini-skidoo, kick-sledding or tandem skiing to our guests. You can also be working at the reindeer info, pancake-hut or at the warmup cabin. You might also work as a road crosser, when you make sure that the guests are crossing the road safely, either by snowmobile or by walking. In addition, your work tasks may include clothing and equipment maintenance.

**In Hetta** your workplace can be the toboggan slide or bobsleigh hill, you might be teaching the guests to drive the snowmobile, or you might be serving ginger breads in the snow castle and telling stories about the castle itself. You might also be part of the very important team that organizes the visits to Santa Claus himself. In Hetta, providing clothing to the guests and clothing maintenance plays a big role in the Outdoor Activity workers daily routines and work tasks.

**What we expect from you:**

- Energetic and outgoing character

- Flexibility and ability to handle pressure

- Good group management skills

- Christmas spirit and willingness to work with families, especially children


**What we offer you:**

- Great team and beautiful working surroundings

- Versatile and variable working days

- Easy way to experience arctic nature

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides new employees with paid, role-specific training at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will begin in mid-November or at the end of November and will last approximately until the Christmas holidays in Hetta, and until the end of December 2026 in Saariselkä. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A, hourly wage starting from 10,10 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

For further information, please contact info@laplandstaff.fi

**In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required.**

If you need a work permit or visa for Finland, **we must be able to process your application in time** due to the length of the permit process. You can check your work permit requirements here: https://migri.fi/en/home

The employee pays and applies for the work permit themselves, with the assistance of Lapland Staff. Please submit your job application to us before the following dates:

Work permit for seasonal work (whole winter season, over 3 months in Finland): **10.8.**

Visa: **10.8.**

Certificate for seasonal work (Christmas season, less than 3 months in Finland): **10.9.**

jobs.title: Opérateur de production électronique
jobs.description:
À propos de notre client
Notre client transforme la manière dont les flottes ferroviaires sont gérées. Il conçoit et développe ses propres solutions matérielles et logicielles afin de connecter les flottes de trains et de surveiller tous les paramètres essentiels à l’activité. Grâce à ses technologies innovantes, ses clients du secteur ferroviaire peuvent anticiper les pannes, passer d’une maintenance préventive basée sur le calendrier à une maintenance conditionnelle, et identifier les meilleures pratiques de conduite pour réduire la consommation d’énergie.

Notre client réunit une équipe technique et entrepreneuriale composée de spécialistes en électronique, développement logiciel, supply chain et vente. Son leadership dans le secteur repose sur une innovation continue, une grande réactivité et une attention particulière portée à la satisfaction de ses clients.

Dans le cadre du renforcement de ses opérations hardware, notre client recherche un collaborateur pour rejoindre une équipe de production dynamique. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs et développeurs afin de fabriquer des produits innovants, notamment des cartes électroniques (PCB), des faisceaux de câbles et des dispositifs assemblés. Vous participerez à l’ensemble des étapes de production, de la préparation du matériel aux activités pratiques telles que le câblage, l’assemblage et la production de cartes électroniques, au sein d’un environnement multidisciplinaire.

Si vous vous reconnaissez dans cette description, rejoignez une équipe passionnée et contribuez à façonner l’avenir du secteur ferroviaire.

Principales responsabilités

jobs.title: Supervisor
jobs.description:
Independently manage our beautiful construction projects, celebrate successes with colleagues and ensure a satisfied client. This is what your job as a supervisor looks like with us.
Vacancy
Supervisor
What will you do?
When the plans for a construction project are finely honed, your work begins. You are the connecting factor between stakeholders (architects, structural engineers, government, clients) on one side, and the construction site (contractors and builders) on the other. You pull, push, massage, steer, and ensure that everything is completed within the given time, quality, and budget. Additionally, you work closely with the supervisor: your eyes and ears on the site. If things don't go as planned, you provide clear, practical advice to get all parties back on track without hesitation. If necessary, you're not afraid to assertively demand compliance. Ensuring the correct execution of the construction contract by the contracting parties is indeed your responsibility, and you take it very seriously. All to successfully conclude the complex, diverse construction projects entrusted to us.
What do you bring?
You're of the type: less talk, more action. Roll up your sleeves and get it done. Through your proactive, well-thought-out initiatives, you effortlessly rally others. In construction projects, the UAV is your bible, and the construction ethos is your natural habitat. You adhere to processes and frameworks when possible, and you're flexible and pragmatic when necessary. Your construction-related education at HBO/WO level provides the right foundation for this. Develop full visual identity packages, brand guidelines, and high-impact design assets.

Collaborate with account managers, production teams, and external suppliers to maintain visual quality across physical products.

Upforce history
Founded: 1997
Employees: 10
Temporary workers: 500
SEP Peeters Oirlo
The employment agency SEP Peeters Oirlo was founded in 1997 when it started sending out Polish temporary workers, but the name SEP Peeters was already active in the poultry industry in the early 1980s. The need for additional labour was so great that in 1997 it was decided to move over as a temporary employment agency alongside services in the poultry industry. From 2000, the service provision within the poultry industry was stopped and SEP Peeters switched completely to the temping of labour.
SEP Peeters was based in Oirlo and from here around 600 temporary workers were put to work. Before 1997, only in the poultry industry, but this quickly changed to various sectors such as logistics, production, distribution and construction. SEP Peeters, besides posting temporary workers, also arranged accommodation, transport, insurance and necessary documentation.
In addition to completely unburdening its customers as well as staff, SEP Peeters' strength was communication, openness and listening to the wants and needs. This is why SEP Peeters was good at retaining both its customers and staff and many of these customers still work with Upforce.
Verbeek employment agency
Verbeek temporary employment agency was founded by Jac Verbeek in 1998. The origin of the agency was in Jac Verbeek's horticulture company, where he offered seasonal work to Eastern European employees. From his own experience in horticulture, the idea arose to offer these workers to other companies in the region.
In the early years, Eastern European workers were mainly used for seasonal work. Over time, Verbeek Temporary Employment Agency evolved and the model was expanded to fully staffing. The agency grew steadily and employed about 10 workers during that period.

jobs.description:
Postdoctoral Researcher - Molecular Drivers of BRCA1-Related Precancer - - Amsterdam
Job details Application Job description
We are recruiting a postdoctoral researcher to join a newly funded Gray Foundation Team Science project tackling one of the most important unsolved problems in cancer prevention: what drives the very first steps of breast cancer initiation in BRCA1 mutation carriers. Working at the interface of human tissue biology, single-cell genomics, spatial imaging, and functional mouse modeling, you will help map the genetic and phenotypic landscape of BRCA1-deficient precancerous cells in prophylactic mastectomy specimens and translate those discoveries into functionally validated driver candidates - a unique opportunity to do science that directly connects to clinical cancer interception.
The Jonkers laboratory at the Netherlands Cancer Institute has built a world-leading platform for functional breast cancer modeling, combining germline genetics, intraductal somatic engineering, and quantitative in vivo imaging. We are now applying that platform to study the biology of BRCA1-associated precancer and are looking for an exceptional postdoctoral researcher to lead this work.
You will work with a novel mouse model that combines germline heterozygous Brca1 deficiency with a dual-color fluorescent reporter that marks cells undergoing Cre-mediated loss of heterozygosity (LOH) in real time. Our preliminary data show that Brca1 LOH cells are actively cleared from the ductal epithelium in vivo, and this clearance is rescued by Trp53 loss. This provides a quantitative and mechanistic benchmark for ranking candidate perturbations.
Candidate driver genes will be introduced somatically at low frequency in mice - closely resembling the occurrence of early mutations in BRCA1 mutation carriers - through intraductal delivery of high-titer lentiviruses encoding Cre with cDNAs for overexpression or CRISPR guides for loss-of-function...

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Integrity Foundations - London
jobs.description:
About the team

The Applied Foundations team at OpenAI is dedicated to ensuring that our cutting-edge technology is not only revolutionary, but also secure from a myriad of adversarial threats. We strive to maintain the integrity of our platforms as they scale. Our team is at the front lines of defending against financial abuse, scaled attacks, and other forms of misuse that could undermine the user experience or harm our operational stability

The Integrity pillar within Applied Foundations is responsible for the scaled systems that help identify and respond to bad actors and harm on OpenAI’s platforms. We are creating a 0→1 team in London to architect next-generation systems that will support, leverage, and scale the work of experts in harms committed with our technology.

In this role, you will:

  • Design and build scaled foundational systems used in the detection, tracking, and enforcement of harm using our technologies.

  • Work closely with and learn from technical and non-technical experts on harms we are observing, and that stem from our platforms, to inform your designs and implementation.

  • Leverage OpenAI’s most advanced technologies to automate and augment our abilities to detect and reason about complex harms quickly, accurately, and with minimum human intervention.

  • Collaborate with policy, trust and safety operations, legal, investigations, and harm-specialised engineers and data scientists to holistically combat abusive actors and customers using OpenAI’s technology.

  • Stay abreast of the latest techniques and tools to stay several steps ahead of determined and well resourced adversaries.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of software engineering experience in backend and data systems.

  • Have at least 2 years experience in trust and safety analysis, investigation, and/or operations.

  • Are excited to learn from top experts in the world on harms committed with AI, and to collaborate in an interdisciplinary team including technical and non-technical roles to combat these harms.

  • Can dive into our codebase, intuit how it works, and be able to have a strong intuition for suggestions that will lead us to a stronger engineering position.

  • Have a voracious and intrinsic desire to learn and fill in missing skills. An equally strong talent for sharing that information clearly and concisely with others

  • Are comfortable with ambiguity and rapidly changing conditions. You view changes as an opportunity to add structure and order when necessary.

  • Experience in Machine Learning techniques is a plus, but not required.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

jobs.title: Logistics worker - entry-level position with growth opportunities!
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a chance to start a career in logistics, but you have little or no experience? Do you have a less stable work history and want an employer who values motivation and potential over a perfect CV? Then this opportunity could be exactly what you are looking for! In this position, motivation, commitment, and a willingness to learn are more important than an impressive CV.

Your starting point: packaging

You'll begin as a packer within the logistics department. There, you'll be responsible for carefully packing products according to quality and safety standards. Important: this role is performed in a refrigerated environment (cold storage/chilled warehouse).

In short term: growth

Employees who demonstrate commitment, reliability, and strong performance can quickly progress to more advanced logistics roles following positive evaluations.

Possible next steps:

  • Order picker: collecting and preparing customer orders
  • Warehouse worker: loading and unloading trucks

Both these positions are performed in a deep-freeze environment of -22°C with an electrical pallet truck (EPT).

We think motivation and a great attitude are more important than a perfect CV.

This position is perfect for you if you:

  • Don't have any experience in logistics and want to take your first step into warehouse work
  • Have a less stable work experience and want to prove yourself again
  • Really want to learn and grow step by step

What we expect from you:

  • A positive attitude with motivation, strong work ethic, reliability and punctuality
  • No fear of physical work in cold temperatures
  • Own transport to the company in Oostkamp (no public transport nearby)

Do you already have some experience in logistics or with an electrical pallet truck (EPT)? Not a requirement, but still a great advantage!

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium and have legal permission to work here. Actief cannot help with immigration or provide housing for you. If you don't have an official address or permission to work in Belgium, you don't qualify for this job !!

jobs.title: Assistent horecamanager
jobs.description:
Deze Belgische retailorganisatie beheert een netwerk van shops in heel België, op locaties met dagelijks veel passanten en pendelaars.

  • Ze ontwikkelt moderne winkelconcepten voor klanten die onderweg snel willen stoppen voor snacks, koffie of een snelle maaltijd.
  • De shops zijn 7 dagen op 7 geopend en bieden een assortiment voor verschillende momenten van de dag, van ontbijt tot lunch of een korte pauze.
  • Binnen de winkels staan comfort, klantvriendelijkheid en efficiëntie centraal.
  • Elke shop heeft een hedendaagse uitstraling en is ingericht om klanten in korte tijd een aangename en vlotte winkelervaring te bieden.


Jobomschrijving

3 redenen om voor deze job te kiezen

  • Je werkt in een enthousiast, familiaal team
  • Je krijgt een goede verloning en extra voordelen
  • De job is afwisselend met doorgroeimogelijkheden


Zo ziet je job er uit

Als Assistant Manager bij Foodstation ben je de rechterhand van de manager en speel je een cruciale rol binnen ons gloednieuwe foodconcept.

Jouw takenpakket bestaat uit:

  • het coördineren van de foodservice
  • helpen bij het bereiden en serveren van gerechten wanneer nodig
  • het aansturen, motiveren en ondersteunen van het team
  • het voorraadbeheer en de bestellingen opvolgen
  • toezien op netheid, hygiëne en veiligheid in de keuken en de foodcorner
  • klanten vriendelijk ontvangen en een uitstekende service garanderen
  • samen met de manager zorgen voor een vlotte werking en fijne werksfeer

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

De perfecte Assistant Manager van het Foodstation herkent zich in onderstaande eigenschappen:

  • je hebt ervaring in de horeca of catering, je bent bij voorkeur vertrouwd met healthy fast food
  • je bent vertrouwd met het reilen en zeilen binnen retail food
  • je kan terugblikken op een eerste leidinggevende ervaring waarbij je een team moest aansturen
  • je bent enerzijds klantgericht, maar ook een echte teamplayer naar collega's toe
  • je bent flexibel inzetbaar en kan ook in het weekend werken
  • je bent energiek, positief en hands-on ingesteld
  • je kan goed plannen, organiseren en motiveren
De ideale collega is...

De ideale collega is een enthousiaste en gedreven teamplayer die energie haalt uit afwisseling en het coachen van een team.

Je hebt een passie voor voeding en de bereiding ervan en vindt het leuk om in een dynamische omgeving te werken waar geen dag hetzelfde is.

Je kan terugkijken op een eerste leidinggevende ervaring in een horeca-keten of een supermarkt, waarin het aansturen van collega's zeker aan bod kwam.

Organiseren, delegeren en actie ondernemen zijn jouw tweede natuur.

Je bent flexibel ingesteld en vindt het geen probleem om in het weekend te werken. Ook vroege en late uren (tussen 5u en 23u) schrikken jou niet af.

Je kan ook op vroege en late uren vlot ter plaatse zijn.

Je zoekt een vaste job waar je kan groeien binnen een gezonde en innovatieve organisatie.

jobs.title: Facility Manager
jobs.description:
Our client is a global leader in integrated real estate and facility management services, supporting large corporate and industrial environments. The organisation delivers end-to-end technical, operational, and workplace solutions, with a strong focus on safety, innovation, digital tools, and sustainability.


Jobomschrijving

  • Ensure high-quality, cost-efficient, and safe delivery of engineering and technical services across the site.
  • Manage engineering service providers and suppliers in collaboration with procurement teams.
  • Oversee infrastructure maintenance, utilities, and engineering operations, ensuring uninterrupted service delivery (24/7).
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve Engineering SOPs, ensuring regular training and operational compliance.
  • Support preventive maintenance programs using CMMS tools, ensuring data accuracy and asset reliability.
  • Prepare and maintain long-term capital and infrastructure investment plans, aligned with site leadership priorities.
  • Maintain clear ownership of critical systems (electrical, thermal, pressure systems, life safety).
  • Support implementation of Health, Safety, Environment & Risk policies and ensure regulatory compliance.
  • Contribute to technical delivery of capital projects and new technology deployments.
  • Monitor and control engineering budgets, maintenance costs, and spare parts management.
  • Identify and implement energy efficiency and cost-saving initiatives without compromising service quality.
  • Ensure compliance with statutory, internal, and client-specific quality and safety standards.
  • Actively participate in audits, governance meetings, and quality assurance programs.
  • Foster a strong "One Team" culture across employees, contractors, and client stakeholders.

  • Strong technical background in building services engineering (HVAC, electrical, mechanical systems).
  • Proven experience in technical operations, facilities management, or engineering leadership roles.
  • Excellent leadership, prioritisation, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to analyse data, assess risk, and translate insights into practical actions.
  • Experience working in critical or high-availability environments.
  • Strong safety mindset with hands-on knowledge of HS&E frameworks.
  • Fluent in English, with good knowledge of Dutch or French.
  • Comfortable working with digital tools such as BMS, CMMS, ticketing, and financial systems.
  • Results-driven, proactive, and resilient, with a continuous improvement mindset.

jobs.title: Chief Product Officer - Tax platform
jobs.description:
The company is a global product base platform, employing a substantial workforce and offering innovative solutions to customers worldwide. With a commitment to technology-driven services, the company provides an environment that fosters creativity and results-driven performance.


Jobomschrijving

  • Define and own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the global tax platform.
  • Lead and develop a team of senior product managers.
  • Manage end-to-end tax platform capabilities, including (Tax master data, Tax determination and calculation, Invoicing and e-invoicing, Reconciliation, Tax reporting, Compliance and controls)
  • Partner with Tax, Finance, Engineering, and business stakeholders to translate regulatory and operational requirements into scalable product solutions.
  • Lead large-scale, multi-year transformation initiatives to modernize tax systems and capabilities.
  • Evaluate and drive buy-versus-build decisions for tax engines, e-invoicing platforms, and external technology vendors.
  • Work closely with engineering leadership to influence architecture, technical investments, scalability, and platform reliability.
  • Establish governance frameworks for tax configuration, controls, and change management.
  • Define success metrics, monitor platform performance, and communicate progress to executive stakeholders.



To apply online please click the 'Apply' button below. For a confidential discussion about this role please contact Narut Keereetaweep +6620125009.

  • At least 5 years in a senior product leadership role (Director, Head of Product, or equivalent).
  • Proven experience building, scaling, or transforming enterprise tax platforms within large digital businesses.
  • Deep understanding of indirect tax concepts, including:
    • VAT/GST
    • Marketplace and deemed-supplier models
    • Withholding tax
    • Global tax compliance requirements
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Tax determination systems
  • Tax rules configuration
  • Invoicing/e-invoicing solutions
  • Reconciliation and reporting processes
  • Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional programs in highly regulated environments.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior executives and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working with globally distributed teams.
