jobs.title: Service advisor
jobs.description:
Onze klant is een gevestigde Familiegarage in de Kempen en staat in voor de verkoop, het onderhoud en de herstelling van personenwagens. De naverkoopafdeling vormt een belangrijke schakel tussen klant en werkplaats en zorgt voor een vlotte opvolging van onderhouds- en herstellingsdossiers.

Waar onze klant voor staat:

  • Klantgerichte service
  • Technische expertise
  • Samenwerking
  • Kwaliteit

Na een eerste kennismakingsgesprek volgt een gesprek met de verantwoordelijke van de vestiging zodat je ook de werkplaats en het team leert kennen.


Jobomschrijving

3 redenen om voor deze job te kiezen

  • Grondige interne opleiding
  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen naverkoop
  • Afwisselende functie met klantencontact


Zo ziet je job er uit
  • Klanten ontvangen, hun vragen analyseren en herstellingsdossiers opstarten
  • Werkorders, planning, facturatie en betalingen verwerken via het Dealer Management System
  • Onderdelen opzoeken, bestellen en factureren in samenwerking met het magazijn
  • Schadecontroles uitvoeren op nieuw geleverde voertuigen
  • Klanten informeren over bijkomende werken en uitgevoerde herstellingen

Dit heb je nodig voor de job
  • Ervaring of een sterke affiniteit met de automotive sector is een must
  • Autotechnische kennis is nodig om klanten correct te adviseren en werkzaamheden in te schatten
  • Administratief nauwkeurig werken en vlot overweg kunnen met pc-toepassingen is een must
  • Een rijbewijs B is nodig in de functie
  • Ervaring met rechtstreeks klantencontact is een sterke meerwaarde
De ideale collega is...

Iemand die:

  • Klantvriendelijk en professioneel communiceert
  • Rust bewaart tijdens drukke momenten
  • Nauwkeurig en georganiseerd werkt
  • Initiatief neemt om de dienstverlening te verbeteren
  • Graag samenwerkt met collega's uit verschillende afdelingen

jobs.title: Director of Engineering  Data & AI | Nordics
jobs.description:
For the role of Director of Engineering – Nordics in a Data & AI Services organization, is a combination of technical leadership, delivery ownership, client engagement, people leadership, and regional growth.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

1. Engineering & Technology Leadership

    Define and drive the engineering strategy for the Nordics Data & AI business.
    Lead the architecture and delivery of modern Data, AI, Cloud, and Analytics solutions.
    Establish engineering standards, best practices, reusable frameworks, and quality processes.
    Provide technical direction across Data Engineering, AI/ML, Data Platforms, GenAI, Analytics, and real-time data solutions.
    Stay current with emerging technologies and identify opportunities to bring innovation to clients.
    Drive adoption of modern data platforms and technologies, including Databricks, cloud platforms, AI/ML, and GenAI.

2. Delivery & Customer Success

    Own technical delivery quality across the Nordics portfolio.
    Partner with customers and stakeholders to understand business challenges and translate them into scalable technology solutions.
    Act as a senior technical advisor for strategic customers and complex engagements.
    Ensure projects are delivered with high standards of quality, security, performance, and scalability.
    Support delivery teams in resolving complex technical and architectural challenges.
    Establish governance around delivery, technical risks, dependencies, and project quality.

3. Pre-Sales & Business Growth

    Partner with Sales and Account Management teams to drive Data & AI consulting and services growth across the Nordics.
    Lead technical discussions, discovery workshops, solutioning, RFP/RFI responses, and client presentations.
    Develop compelling technical proposals and solution architectures aligned with customer business outcomes.
    Identify opportunities for new engagements, expansions, and transformation programs within existing accounts.
    Build trusted relationships with CTOs, CIOs, CDOs, and other senior technology stakeholders.

4. People & Engineering Organization

    Build and lead a high-performing Data & AI engineering organization across the Nordics.
    Recruit, develop, mentor, and retain strong engineering and architecture talent.
    Define career paths, competency frameworks, and technical growth opportunities.
    Create a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
    Develop future technical leaders and architects within the organization.
    Work closely with global engineering teams to create a unified delivery and engineering culture.

5. Practice & Capability Development

    Build and scale Data & AI capabilities based on market and customer demand.
    Develop reusable accelerators, frameworks, methodologies, and industry solutions.
    Strengthen expertise across areas such as:
    Data Engineering & Modern Data Platforms
    Databricks / Lakehouse
    Cloud Data Architecture
    AI & Machine Learning
    Generative AI & AI Agents
    Data Analytics & Visualization
    Real-Time Data & Streaming
    Data Governance & Quality
    Establish partnerships with key technology providers and ecosystem partners.

6. Regional Leadership

    Represent the engineering organization and Data & AI capabilities across the Nordic region.
    Develop relationships within the Nordic technology and data community.
    Participate in industry events, customer forums, conferences, and technology communities.
    Identify emerging market trends and translate them into new service offerings and capabilities.
    Collaborate with global leadership to align Nordic priorities with the broader company strategy.

Ideal Candidate Profile

    18+ years of experience in software/data engineering, architecture, or technology leadership.
    8+ years in an engineering leadership, architecture leadership, or senior technology management role.
    Strong experience delivering Data & AI transformation programs for enterprise customers.
    Deep understanding of modern data platforms, cloud technologies, AI/ML, and GenAI.
    Strong Databricks/Lakehouse experience is highly desirable.
    Proven experience managing and scaling engineering teams.
    Strong client-facing and executive communication skills.
    Experience in pre-sales, solutioning, RFPs, and technology consulting.
    Commercial mindset with an understanding of professional services and consulting businesses.
    Ability to operate strategically while remaining hands-on enough to guide complex technical decisions.
    Experience working across distributed/global teams.
    Nordic market experience and/or an established network in Sweden, Norway, Denmark or Finland would be a strong advantage

jobs.description:

  • Du verantwortest die Beschaffung von Komponenten und Dienstleistungen für unsere stationären Batteriespeicherkraftwerke und die dazugehörige Energieinfrastruktur im In- und Ausland.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer – Release & Deployment (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Persönlichkeit – Engagement – Innovation!​

In der AppFactory bei GRAYOAK entstehen innovative, cloud-agnostische Softwarelösungen für kritische Infrastrukturen und hochsensible Betriebsumgebungen. Unsere Anwendungen werden für den sicheren Einsatz in der Cloud, On-Premise sowie in Air-Gapped-Umgebungen entwickelt.
 
Informationssicherheit, Compliance, Datenhoheit und Resilienz sind dabei feste Bestandteile unserer Architektur- und Entwicklungsprozesse. In interdisziplinären Teams begleiten wir unsere Kunden von der Konzeption über die sichere Umsetzung bis zum zuverlässigen produktiven Betrieb.
 
Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf verlässlichen Build-, Test- und Release-Prozessen: Deployments werden automatisiert, saubere Pipelines etabliert und neue Versionen schnell, sicher und nachvollziehbar ausgeliefert. Die Rolle konzipiert Release- und Deployment-Architekturen, die sich flexibel an unterschiedliche Kundenumgebungen anpassen lassen, und fungiert als technischer Ansprechpartner für Entwicklungs- und Produktteams.


Von der Theorie zur Praxis – bring Dein Wissen ins Spiel!

  • Konzipieren, Aufbauen und Betreiben von CI/CD-Pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) – für schnelle, stabile und wiederholbare Software-Releases in Produktion
  • Automatisieren von Build-, Test- und Deployment-Prozessen sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Release-Qualität und -Geschwindigkeit
  • Gestalten und Pflegen von Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep) für Azure-Umgebungen sowie aktives Vorantreiben des Shift-Left-Ansatzes
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungs-, Test- und Betriebsteams sowie Etablieren von DevOps-Best-Practices in der AppFactory
  • Umsetzen moderner Deployment-Strategien (Blue/Green, Canary, Rolling) und Begleiten interner sowie kundenseitiger Projekte bei der technischen Umsetzung
  • Analysieren von Incidents im Release-Prozess, Identifizieren von Schwachstellen und Entwickeln nachhaltiger Lösungen gemeinsam mit dem Team
  • Beraten von Kunden bei der Konzeption geeigneter Release- und Deployment-Architekturen sowie gezieltes Matchen der Anforderungen mit dem GRAYOAK-Lösungsportfolio
  • Übernehmen einer aktiven Architekturrolle im Kundenprojekt – von der Anforderungsanalyse über die Lösungskonzeption bis zur begleitenden technischen Umsetzung
  • Fungieren als technischer Ansprechpartner für Release- und Deployment-Fragen – intern für Entwicklungs- und Produktteams sowie extern für Kunde


Deine Skills, Dein Potenzial – das suchen wir!​

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation bzw. entsprechende praktische Erfahrung
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Release Engineering, DevOps oder CI/CD-Engineering – idealerweise im Beratungs- oder Produktumfeld
  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Git, Branching- und Tagging-Strategien
  • Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt oder in beratender Funktion – z.B. als Solution Engineer, Technical Consultant oder in einer ähnlichen Rolle
  • Kommunikationsstärke gegenüber technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern – Fähigkeit, komplexe Architekturen verständlich zu erklären
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in CI/CD-Tooling: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions oder vergleichbar
  • Verständnis von Release-Promotion-Prozessen (Development → Test → Pre-Production → Production) sowie von Hotfix- und Release-Strategien
  • Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code (Terraform und/oder Bicep/ARM)
  • Erfahrung mit Kubernetes-Deployment- und Rollback-Prozessen, Artifact-Management sowie Container-Image-Versionierung (Docker, AKS)
  • Vertrautheit mit unterschiedlichen Systemarchitekturen: Monolith, Monorepo-Strukturen, Multi-Tier sowie Microservices
  • Kenntnisse in Cloud-Architekturen, bevorzugt Microsoft Azure
  • Selbstständige, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch und Hands-on-Mentalität
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
Pluspunkte!
  • Versionierung von Helm Charts sowie GitOps-Workflows (z.B. Argo CD, Flux) und Erfahrung in agilen Entwicklungsumgebungen (Scrum, SAFe)
  • Monitoring & Observability: Azure Monitor, Grafana oder Prometheus
  • Azure- oder DevOps-Zertifizierungen (z.B. AZ-400, AZ-104)


Individuell stark, gemeinsam unschlagbar – das ist GRAYOAK​

  • Unsere Werte: Wir stehen für Wirksamkeit, Nachhaltigkeit und Technologie als Werttreiber – mit 100% Persönlichkeit, Engagement und Innovation, aber 0% unnötigem Schnickschnack
  • Dein Einstieg: Startklar ab Tag 1 mit IT-Equipment und einem coolen GRAYOAK-Merch-Paket 
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Arbeite hybrid – im Büro oder im Homeoffice – und passe deine Arbeitszeiten flexibel an deine Lebenssituation an

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
At Aevi, we're not just a team; we're a vibrant, global business, committed to shaking up the payments industry. Our culture is all about innovation, creativity, and a passion for pushing boundaries. We’re thrilled to welcome new Aevi’ators who vibe with our values and mission and are ready to join us on our journey of transformation and growth.
 

Want to work in the fintech industry, using the latest technologies and tools to help deliver online cloud and container based applications for a new breed of payment services? 
We are searching for Data Engineer, who will be responsible for transferring business requirements into technical requirements of the AEVI data architecture based on AWS technology.
 

What you'll be doing:
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications for AEVI’s AWS-based data architecture
  • Work with technologies such as Aurora, Oracle, Athena, Glue, and QuickSight
  • Manage and optimize Data Warehouses & Data Lakes
  • Design, configure, and administer data architecture in compliance with PCI, GDPR, and CCPA
  • Document data flows and implement data models within business applications
  • Ensure cloud data management meets CIA (Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability) standards
  • Redesign data models to maintain regulatory compliance
  • Develop and manage a structured data access model

    • The successful AEVI'ator: Data Engineer
  • Strong expertise in SQL, DML, and DDL
  • Excellent communication skills at both business and technical levels
  • Deep knowledge of AWS Cloud Data technologies
  • Proficiency in streaming platforms (Kafka, AWS Kinesis) for real-time data processing
  • Experience with big data frameworks (Apache Spark, Hadoop)
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation)
  • Solid knowledge of Python and Java
  • Strong data modeling and design skills
  • Proficiency in AWS database services
  • Good understanding of data classification, encryption, and privacy
    • Why not check us out on Glassdoor and hear for yourself what it's like to be an AEVIator! 

    Life at Aevi 
    Being part of Aevi? Flexibility, honesty, development, and support are the essentials of our work environment, and we live for a “work smarter, not harder” mindset. At Aevi, we celebrate diversity and inclusivity, firmly believing that our strength lies in our individuality. Our commitment to a better working culture is reflected in our respect and appreciation for each team member, cheering on everyone to just be themselves at work and outside.             
     
    What's in it for you?   
    - Be part of a dynamic, fun-loving team that values teamwork and flexibility.
    - Benefit from our unlimited vacation policy, so you can take a breather whenever you want and need it.
    - Quickly become a key player of our motivated, energetic, and global team.
    - Thrive in a culture that lets your unique work style shine.
     
    Who are Aevi: 
    Our mission is to build a more open world, where anyone, anywhere, can take or make any kind of payment.
    Our cloud-based platform lets payments and transaction data flow across all channels and consumer touchpoints. By connecting digital and in-person interfaces, we are committed to creating the best possible customer experience at the point-of-interaction. Today, we operate across Europe, Australia, and the US with offices in London, Prague, and Paderborn.
     
    Our Vision and Support:
    We are setting payments free!
     
    Supported by visionary shareholders in the industry like Mastercard and HPE Growth Capital, we stand at the forefront of payment innovation, surrounded by like-minded partners who share our vision for a seamless payment future.

We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Influencer Manager (m/f/d) Your Role

As our Influencer Manager, you'll build and own fonio's influencer program end-to-end - from strategy to creator partnerships to campaign execution. You'll turn creators into a scalable growth and brand channel, owning the relationships and the numbers behind every collaboration.

* Design and own fonio's influencer program end-to-end, aligned with business goals and brand messaging

* 2+ years of experience in influencer marketing or creator partnerships

* Proven negotiation and relationship-management skills

* A structured, data-driven approach to campaigns and reporting

* Strong communication skills and a sharp eye for the right creators

* High standards around speed, quality, and ownership

* Ideally experience in B2B SaaS or e-commerce

What We Offer

* Competitive gross annual salary (€ 65,000 - € 85,000) + equity

* On-site in Vienna

* Top equipment and a budget to conquer markets

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the Role

Replit is experiencing extraordinary growth across our customer base and seeking a Mid-Market Account Manager with strong communication skills to drive retention, expansion, and customer success. Candidates with Sales or Account Management experience in SaaS, particularly with some technical background (i.e. having some coding knowledge or prior experience at other developer tool companies) are ideal.

In this role you will:

 - Guide customers through Replit's rapidly evolving feature set, including Agent 3's autonomous capabilities, Plan Mode, and automation tools

Required skills and experience:

 - 3-5+ years in a quota-carrying Sales or Account Management role managing a mid-market book in SaaS or developer tools

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to sell technical value to both technical and non-technical audiences

    Demonstrated success in securing senior speakers (VP/C-level) from leading corporations or public institutions.
    Strong understanding of the Norwegian/Danish enterprise and innovation landscape — including key players in software, industrial tech, mobility, and digital transformation.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Norwegian or Danish and English. Swedish language skills will be sufficient also may you have experience working with Danish or Norwegian market.
    Ability to work independently and manage multiple content projects with precision and pace.
    A genuine interest in business, technology, innovation, and strategic leadership topics.

What We Offer

    Performance rewarded: You’ll receive an attractive compensation package with base salary, commission, and an additional starter bonus to support you as you ramp up and build your sales pipeline.
    Growth and learning: From day one, you’ll benefit from a four-week onboarding program and continuous coaching through our international AL Academy, ensuring you’re always developing and moving forward in your career.
    Career opportunities across Europe: As we continue to grow, you’ll have the chance to explore international opportunities. With offices in Helsinki, Amsterdam, Antwerp, Copenhagen, Berlin, Stockholm, Kuala Lumpur, and Barcelona, your career can take you anywhere.
    Recharge & Thrive: We care about your well-being and want you to stay energized both inside and outside of work. That’s why you can earn up to 12 extra vacation days each year and enjoy local perks such as gym and massage discounts, along with other wellness benefits. Curious about the details in your location? Ask your recruiter to learn more.
    We win together: Collaboration is our driving force, and every success is shared. That’s why we love bringing people together through company trips, international events, and local office celebrations — whether it’s hitting the slopes in Levi, running the Berlin Marathon together, or celebrating milestones across our offices in Europe.
    Annual company trip: Every summer, all employees from our different offices come together in Finland for an exciting company trip - a mix of team building, knowledge exchange, and celebrations.
    Global Community & Diversity: Diversity is part of our DNA. With colleagues from over 50 nationalities, you’ll join an international community where every culture, perspective, and background fuels innovation and success.

Recruitment Process:

    Screening video call with Recruitment Team.
    First interview with Hiring Manager.
    Second interview with Team Manager.
    Reference check & short personal (working style) assessment.

jobs.title: Account Executive - Manufacturing industries
jobs.description:
Do you thrive at the intersection of technology and business growth?

Are you driven by the challenge of turning innovative solutions into real partnerships that move industries forward?

Do you want to be part of a team that helps technology companies connect with the right decision-makers and shape the future of manufacturing?

If that sounds like you, keep reading.

Your Mission

As an Account Executive specializing in Manufacturing Technology Solutions, you drive revenue by selling our services to technology companies and solution providers whose key customers are manufacturing technology decision-makers, plant directors, and R&D within the intersection of hardware, software, devices, and technology.

Account Executive is responsible for the end-to-end sales process and acquiring new clients, building customer relationships, and developing sales strategies to help our clients optimize their sales and marketing operations. This role requires a background in working with trade fairs, exhibitions, or event sales, with a strong understanding of the solutions and services such as OT, IoT, Automation, Robotics and Sustainability Management related solutions.

In this role, you will:

    Sell Aurora Live's services to technology companies and solution providers serving manufacturing technology decision-makers, plant directors, and other relevant leaders.
    Ensure a deep understanding of client needs, challenges, and goals to position our offerings effectively.
    Identify and qualify potential leads through various channels (e.g., LinkedIn, industry events, referrals, and cold calling).

What We’re Looking For

    Good track record in B2B sales, specifically in trade fairs, exhibitions, or event sales targeting solution providers who serve manufacturing sector in i.e. OT, IoT, Automation investments, sustainability management, AI and Machine Learning related solutions, and / or alike.
    Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
    Results-driven with a proven ability to exceed sales targets.
    Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
    Full professional proficiency in English and French, German or Finnish.

What We Offer

    Performance rewarded: You’ll receive an attractive compensation package with base salary, commission, and an additional starter bonus to support you as you ramp up and build your sales pipeline.
    Growth and learning: From day one, you’ll benefit from a four-week onboarding program and continuous coaching through our international AL Academy, ensuring you’re always developing and moving forward in your career.
    Career opportunities across Europe: As we continue to grow, you’ll have the chance to explore international opportunities. With offices in Helsinki, Amsterdam, Antwerp, Copenhagen, Berlin, Stockholm, Kuala Lumpur, and Barcelona, your career can take you anywhere.
    Recharge & Thrive: We care about your well-being and want you to stay energized both inside and outside of work. That’s why you can earn up to 12 extra vacation days each year and enjoy local perks such as gym and massage discounts, along with other wellness benefits. Curious about the details in your location? Ask your recruiter to learn more.
    We win together: Collaboration is our driving force, and every success is shared. That’s why we love bringing people together through company trips, international events, and local office celebrations — whether it’s hitting the slopes in Levi, running the Berlin Marathon together, or celebrating milestones across our offices in Europe.
    Annual company trip: Every summer, all employees from our different offices come together in Finland for an exciting company trip - a mix of team building, knowledge exchange, and celebrations.
    Global Community & Diversity: Diversity is part of our DNA. With colleagues from over 50 nationalities, you’ll join an international community where every culture, perspective, and background fuels innovation and success.

jobs.title: GTM Compensation Lead, Commercial Operations
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As our GTM Compensation Lead on Commercial Operations, you’ll own commissions strategy, design, and execution for GTM. This is an opportunity to evolve how GTM Comp supports a growing GTM org through Notion’s AI-era selling motion and Enterprise growth. You’ll set the incentive systems that shape how our sellers focus, partner, and grow with customers. On a typical week, you’ll work with senior GTM leaders — including the Head of Sales and geo leaders — to translate business priorities into clear, accurate, scalable comp programs.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - By your 90th day, map the current GTM Comp operating model and publish a roadmap for evolving the function as GTM grows.

 - Introduce AI quick wins that improve the quality of work: triage inbound questions, help reps estimate payouts, flag discrepancies across systems, and automate reminders tied to the comp calendar.

 - Build a planning-cycle framework that makes design inputs, trade-offs, decision rights, and timelines clear across GTM, Finance, and Commercial Operations.

 - Provide board-level updates, including clear reporting on plan health, payout accuracy, systems quality, and key design decisions.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Demonstrated judgment balancing Finance discipline with GTM effectiveness — you can protect accuracy and controls while designing plans that support the selling motion.

 - Strong financial modeling and data fluency, with the ability to translate complex plan mechanics into clear analysis, recommendations, and executive-ready narratives.

 - Experience leading transformative operational projects from design through rollout, especially where cross-functional alignment and change management matter.

 - Track record of building and maintaining sustainable quarterly operating cadences, including clear calendars, communications frameworks, and repeatable review moments. Ideally you have managed this process at a public company.

 - AI-fluent operating style: you use AI to improve decision quality, automate manual checks, identify data discrepancies, and build tools or workflows that make teams more self-serve.

 - Familiarity with Everstage a plus!

jobs.title: Part time pastry chef
jobs.description:
English version below

Deltid · Opstart efter aftale

Martini House er en italiensk-amerikansk restaurant på Brigadevej på Amager med fokus på klassiske retter, varm gæstfrihed og masser af personlighed. Vi tager inspiration fra de klassiske italiensk-amerikanske restauranter og laver mad, der føles genkendelig, generøs og lidt nostalgisk.

Vi søger nu en deltids konditor / pastry chef, der kan tage ansvar for vores dessertprogram og være med til at udvikle det videre.

Dine opgaver

  • Udvikle og producere restaurantens desserter

  • Sikre høj kvalitet og ensartethed

  • Forberede mise en place til service

  • Arbejde tæt sammen med køkkenchefen om nye desserter og sæsonændringer

  • Stå for bestilling og lagerstyring inden for pastry

  • Holde struktur og overblik over dit eget område

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har erfaring fra restaurant, bageri eller konditori

  • Har stærk faglighed og sans for detaljer

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar

  • Er organiseret og god til at planlægge din egen produktion

  • Har interesse for klassiske italiensk-amerikanske desserter

  • Er professionel, stabil og en god kollega

Vi tilbyder

  • En fleksibel deltidsstilling

  • Stor indflydelse på dessertmenuen og mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg

  • Et lille, ambitiøst og jordnært team

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

  • Mulighed for at vokse med restauranten

Send dit CV + et par linjer om dig selv til work@martinihouse.dk

Emne: “Martini House Konditor”

English

Part-Time · Start Date: By Agreement

Martini House is an Italian-American restaurant on Brigadevej in Amager, focused on classic dishes, warm hospitality and plenty of personality. We take inspiration from the classic Italian-American restaurants and make food that feels familiar, generous and a little nostalgic.

We’re looking for a part-time Pastry Chef to take ownership of our dessert program and help us continue developing it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Developing and producing the restaurant’s desserts

  • Ensuring consistency and high quality

  • Preparing mise en place for service

  • Working closely with the Head Chef on new desserts and seasonal changes

  • Managing ordering and inventory for pastry

  • Keeping your area organized and running smoothly

What we’re looking for

  • Experience in a restaurant, bakery or pastry environment

  • Strong technical skills and attention to detail

  • Ability to work independently and take ownership

  • Good organization and the ability to manage your own production

  • An interest in classic Italian-American desserts

  • Someone professional, reliable and good to work with

What we offer

  • A flexible part-time position

  • A lot of influence over the dessert menu and room to put your own stamp on it

  • A small, ambitious and down-to-earth team

  • Competitive pay based on experience

  • Opportunity to grow with the restaurant

If this sounds like you, send your CV + a few lines about yourself to work@martinihouse.dk

Subject line: “Martini House Pastry Chef”

jobs.title: Responsable opérationnel(le) - Site touristique et de loisirs H/F (H/F)
jobs.employer: SOCIETE D'EXPLOITATION DES GRANGES DE BE
jobs.description:
La Société d'Exploitation des Granges de Béthencourt recherche un(e) Responsable opérationnel(le) pour assurer le bon fonctionnement quotidien de son site touristique et de loisirs.

Sous la responsabilité directe de la direction, vous coordonnez l'activité opérationnelle du site, les équipes et les prestataires afin de garantir la qualité de l'accueil et des prestations.

Missions principales

* organiser et coordonner l'exploitation quotidienne du site selon les orientations de la direction
* assurer l'accueil des clients, groupes et événements
* superviser les équipes et prestataires présents sur site
* organiser les plannings et la répartition des tâches
* suivre les réservations et la préparation des prestations
* veiller à la qualité de service et à la satisfaction client
* gérer les imprévus opérationnels
* assurer la coordination avec les fournisseurs et partenaires
* participer au suivi des approvisionnements
* contribuer au développement de l'activité et à la commercialisation des prestations
* suivre les indicateurs d'activité et réaliser un reporting à la direction
* proposer des améliorations organisationnelles et opérationnelles

Les décisions stratégiques, financières et RH restent de la responsabilité de la direction.

Profil recherché

Formation ou expérience en tourisme, hôtellerie, loisirs, événementiel ou gestion d'établissement.

Expérience en coordination ou encadrement appréciée.

Organisation, autonomie, sens du service client et capacité d'adaptation indispensables.

Maîtrise des outils informatiques.

Français courant exigé. Anglais professionnel souhaité.

Horaires

L'activité implique des horaires variables pouvant inclure soirées, week-ends, jours fériés et ponctuellement la nuit, selon l'activité du site.

Des périodes d'astreinte pourront être mises en place en fonction des besoins de l'établissement. Leur organisation et leur fréquence dépendront du niveau d'activité.

Les plannings sont établis en amont dans le respect de la réglementation du travail.

Conditions

CDI - 35h
Béthencourt (59)
2 600 € brut mensuel (31 200 € annuel)
Statut cadre - Niveau V - coefficient 300
Convention collective : CCNELAC - IDCC 1790

Prise de poste : octobre/novembre 2026, selon disponibilité.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - Product
jobs.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role
As a Senior Data Scientist for Product at Legora you will turn data into decisions. You'll sit close to the business, taking questions end-to-end: shaping the metric, modelling the data in dbt, running the analysis, and making the recommendation. You'll pull in new data sources when you need to. Insights are useful; impact is what we hire for.

We're an AI-first data team. We believe the data function should be redesigned around what AI now makes possible, not retrofitted with it, and we want someone excited to help define what that looks like in practice.

There's no single profile we hire for. Some of us are strongest at data modelling and analytics engineering, some at experimentation and causal inference, some at machine learning, some at stakeholder influence. You'll likely be excellent at one or two of these and competent across the rest. That's the bar.

We're a small, centralised team supporting the whole company, hiring for the person, not the seat. Depending on your strengths and where we have the biggest gap when you join, you could be embedded primarily with:

  • Product: instrumentation, feature adoption, user behaviour, A/B testing, shaping the roadmap with PMs and designers.

  • Finance & RevOps: ARR, NRR, forecasting, board reporting, pricing analytics across a 40-country footprint, and unit economics for an AI-native product.

  • Growth & Marketing: acquisition funnels, attribution, campaign measurement, lifecycle analytics, and what actually moves enterprise legal buyers.

  • GTM & Customer Success: pipeline analytics, customer health, expansion signals, and retention drivers in a category that didn't exist three years ago.

You'll partner directly with leaders across Product, Engineering, Finance, and GTM, most of whom are unusually data-fluent and will happily open a SQL editor with you. Your work will directly influence how we prioritise, how we sell, how we price, and how we build.

What you will be doing

  • Partner with stakeholders across Product, Finance, GTM, Growth, and beyond to translate ambiguous questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations.

  • Define the metrics that matter, design the experiments or analyses that test them, and measure the impact of what we ship.

  • Conduct deep-dive analyses on the questions that move the business, and proactively surface the questions nobody is asking yet.

  • Model the data you need for your work in dbt, pulling in new sources when necessary, and partner closely with data engineering on anything that needs to scale beyond your immediate use case.

  • Build dashboards and reporting that scale beyond you, so the company can answer its own questions where possible.

  • Help shape how the data team operates as we scale: standards, tooling, ways of working.


What you'll need

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python.

  • Solid grasp of data modelling and what it takes to build analytical work that is reliable and trusted.

  • Excellent communication skills and the confidence to influence decisions through data storytelling, including pushing back when the data doesn't support what someone wants to do.

  • Genuine depth in at least one of the following, with competence across the rest and curiosity to grow:

    • Data modelling and analytics engineering (dbt, dimensional modelling, semantic layers, self-service)

    • Experimentation and causal inference (A/B test design, quasi-experiments, statistical rigour)

    • Machine learning and applied data science (forecasting, prediction, segmentation, evaluation)

    • Product analytics and metric design (funnels, cohorts, adoption frameworks, North Star metrics)


Nice to have

  • Experience in a product-led or SaaS environment, ideally B2B.

  • Hands-on experience with our stack: Snowflake, dbt, Hex, Dagster.

  • Prior experience as an early data hire at a fast-growing company, i.e. you've built the muscle, not inherited it.

Most importantly, you are someone who

  • "Gets stuff done" and understands building a $10bn company isn't always glamorous and takes hard work and long hours.

  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment where the answers aren't always clear and processes are few.

  • Is genuinely domain-curious. You don't need to have worked on every part of a business, but you should be excited to.

 

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

Pleo's Intelligence function covers the full analytical picture - product behaviour, GTM performance, commercial data science, financial reporting, and operational intelligence. The Analytics Engineers who serve these teams own the data modelling layer that all of it runs on: dbt models, metric definitions, and semantic layer contributions that analysts, product teams, and AI tools depend on to get consistent, trustworthy answers.

You'll be embedded in the Product Intelligence team, building the tracking, experimentation, and data modelling foundations that make product data trustworthy and self-serve. You'll join a close-knit team actively migrating our analytics stack onto a new Analytics Warehouse and Omni, moving off legacy tools like Looker and Hippocampus. If you want to build the infrastructure that other people's product decisions run on rather than just report on what exists, this is the opportunity for you.

Who you'll work with and reporting to

You will report to an Analytics Manager leading Product Intelligence and Growth Intelligence. You'll partner closely with Product Managers, Product Analysts, and Engineering to get tracking, experimentation, and metric definitions right from the ground up. You'll also engage with the broader Analytics Engineering community across Pleo to drive shared standards, especially around the semantic layer that keeps metrics consistent across the organization.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain dbt models in our new Analytics Warehouse, using a clean, layered architecture and migrating logic off legacy tools as you go.

  • Own tracking plan implementation and QA directly in Segment and Amplitude in close partnership with Product and Engineering.

  • Support experimentation by modelling assignment and outcome data into structured formats that analysts and PMs can query directly.

  • Define and document metrics in our semantic layer, ensuring a single authoritative definition so downstream BI tools and AI applications yield consistent answers.

  • Apply AI-augmented data modelling practices as a standard part of how you write, review, and migrate code.

  • Partner with Product Managers and Analysts to turn one-off questions into durable, reusable data models.

  • Maintain data quality in your domain through dbt tests, freshness SLAs, and proactive monitoring.

What you bring

  • Solid SQL and dbt experience, with a clear comfort owning models end to end.

  • Working knowledge of event-based tracking tools like Segment or Amplitude.

  • Experience with Git-based development workflows, including opening and reviewing pull requests.

  • Clear communication skills to explain data definitions and structures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Genuine day-to-day use of AI tooling as part of your standard coding and workflow routine.

  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and untangling legacy logic to build modern foundations.

This role is NOT a good fit if

  • You only want to write dashboards without touching or owning the underlying data models.

  • You require rigid processes and heavy upfront structure before taking initiative.

  • You prefer to avoid data migration, cleanup work, and legacy system refactoring.

Your first 6 months

  • Ramp up: Master our dbt project structure, tracking plans, and migration roadmap while shipping small, reviewed code changes early on.

  • Take ownership: Own a dedicated slice of the migration, such as an event domain or our core experimentation data models.

  • Drive consistency: Establish semantic layer definitions for your domain so analysts and PMs can self-serve accurate metrics without custom workarounds.

Our tech stack context

  • Data warehouse: GCP / BigQuery (new Analytics Warehouse)

  • Transformation: dbt

  • Orchestration: Airflow

  • Tracking and Oroduct Analytics: Segment, Amplitude

  • BI and Analytics: Omni (migrating off legacy Looker and Hippocampus)

  • Languages: SQL

     

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days—enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office.

  • Comprehensive private healthcare depending on your location (coverage options include Vitality, Alan, or Médis).

  • 25 days of annual holiday plus public holidays, with the option to purchase 5 additional days through salary sacrifice.

  • Flexible working options supporting both hybrid and fully remote setups.

  • Free mental health and well-being support through MyndUp.

  • Generous paid parental leave policies to support growing families.

The interview process

  1. Intro Call: 30 minutes with our Talent Partner

  2. SQL Test: Completed via CodeSignal / CoderPad

  3. Hiring Manager Interview: 45 minutes with our Data & Analytics Manager

  4. Team Interview & Live Case: Data modelling case via CodeSignal

  5. Final Interview: 30 minutes with our VP of Data & AI


Application deadline

To ensure everyone has a fair opportunity to apply, applications for this role will close on Monday, September 7th at 11:59 PM.

If you are interested, please submit your application before the deadline. We look forward to reviewing your profile!

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired an Analytics Engineer, we received a total of 173 applications but only 10 were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: it was very clear that many of the CVs we saw were very generic and AI generated. There is no issue with leveraging AI to help with CV writing, there was little indication of what real impact the candidates had in their previous experience. You might have heard of the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit Laszlo Bock ~2014), this is a great way to give a clear picture of what you have actually worked on. Some link or quick description of the companies you’ve worked with is also a great help.

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: there was misunderstanding about the type of experience we expect from an Analytics Engineer and we received many applications from candidates who had never been exposed to a product-led environment or had been exclusively focused on SQL/dbt work when we’re looking for both technical and stakeholders management and team collaboration experience. To be perfectly clear, this is NOT a Data Engineer role or a Data Analyst role! This is a heavily-driven dbt modelling role, experience in this area is critical. We’ve taken great care in writing this role description to reflect the reality of the job as best as possible, please ensure you read it carefully and highlight on your CV the experience relevant to what we are looking for.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Last time we hired an Analytics Engineer, we received a total of 173 applications but only 10 were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: it was very clear that many of the CVs we saw were very generic and AI generated. There is no issue with leveraging AI to help with CV writing, there was little indication of what real impact the candidates had in their previous experience. You might have heard of the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit Laszlo Bock ~2014), this is a great way to give a clear picture of what you have actually worked on. Some link or quick description of the companies you’ve worked with is also a great help.

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: there was misunderstanding about the type of experience we expect from an Analytics Engineer and we received many applications from candidates who had never been exposed to a product-led environment or had been exclusively focused on SQL/dbt work when we’re looking for both technical and stakeholders management and team collaboration experience. To be perfectly clear, this is NOT a Data Engineer role or a Data Analyst role! This is a heavily-driven dbt modelling role, experience in this area is critical. We’ve taken great care in writing this role description to reflect the reality of the job as best as possible, please ensure you read it carefully and highlight on your CV the experience relevant to what we are looking for.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

jobs.title: Iltapäiväkerhotoiminnan ohjaajan sijainen
jobs.description:
Huvikumpu ry hakee innokasta ja motivoitunutta iltapäivätoiminnan ohjaajan sijaista (2 kpl) täydentämään iloista työtiimiä Porvooseen. Keskuskoululla työskentelevä tiimimme kaipaa reippaita ohjaajan sijaisia paikkaamaan lyhyitä poissaoloja esim sairasloma. Huvikumpu ry järjestää perusopetuksen iltapäivätoimintaa myös Helsingissä kahdella eri koululla.

Meille mieluisa työkaveri olisi lasten kanssa tehtävästä työstä kokemusta omaava, positiivinen ja toimeen tarttuva persoona. Odotamme, että ohjaajan sijaisemme ovat motivoituneita myös ohjaamaan lapsia monipuolisesti mm. erilaisten kädentaitojen ja liikunnan saralla. Järjestämme lapsille mielekästä ohjattua toimintaa päivittäin, mutta toki jätämme tilaa myös leikille sekä vapaalle ulkoilulle. Työ on hyvin monipuolista ja antoisaa. Porvoon yksikön vahvana tukena toimii koordinaattori ja kaksi palveluntuottajaa.

Ohjaajan sijaisen tehtävänä on mm. koululaisten iltapäivätoiminnan suunnittelu, toteutus ja ohjaus yhdessä muun työtiimin kanssa. Tehtäviin kuuluu myös tarvittaessa yhteydenpito sekä yhteistyö niin kouluun kuin vanhempiin. Noudatamme iltapäiväkerhoisamme teemakuukaudet ajattelua sekä viikko-ohjelmaa. Näin takaamme mielekästä ja vaihtelevaa ohjelmaa lapsille. Tärkeä osa laadukasta iltapäiväkerhotoimintaa on ns. maksuton kerhotoiminta, jota suunnittelemme ja toteutamme perheiden sekä lasten toiveiden pohjalta. Olemme koonneet työn tueksi perehdytyskansion, jonka avuin uusien työntekijöiden on helppo ja mukava aloittaa työ Huvikummussa.

Työhön sopiva koulutus/ tutkinto voisi olla esim. liikuntaneuvoja, liikunnanohjaaja AMK, aamu- ja iltapäivätoiminnan ohjaaja, artenomi, lähihoitaja, sosionomi, nuoriso- ja vapaa-ajanohjaaja. Tehtävään valitun tulee esittää lasten kanssa työskenteleviltä vaadittava rikosrekisteriote.

Jos olet innokas kuulemaan lisää, niin ota rohkeasti yhteyttä! Juuri sinä voit olla meidän uusi työkaverimme.

jobs.title: Jalometalliostaja
jobs.description:
**Oletko rohkea, sosiaalinen ja kaupallisesti nälkäinen ihminen, joka osaa kohdata asiakkaan ja tehdä kauppaa? Tässä työssä onnistumisesta myös maksetaan sen mukaisesti.**

Haemme nyt uusia **ostajia** kasvavaan toimintaamme pääkaupunkiseudulla, Etelä-Suomessa ja eri puolille Suomea.

Ostamme **jalometalleja, kultaa ja hopeaa, arvokelloja, pöytähopeaa, merkkikoruja, militariaa, seteleitä, kolikoita sekä erilaisia keräily- ja arvoesineitä**.

Työpisteesi voi olla kauppakeskuksen ostoständillä, kaupungin keskeisellä ostopisteellä tai liikkuvassa ostoyksikössämme. Liikkuvat yksikkömme kiertävät ennalta suunniteltuja reittejä ja paikkakuntia. Työpisteestä riippumatta saat kaiken tuen paikan keskeisestä sijainnista sekä mainostiimimme panoksesta.

**Tässä työssä tuloksentekijä palkitaan**

Työ on vahvasti tulospohjaista, eikä ansaintaa ole tarkoitettu rajattavaksi keinotekoisella palkkakatolla, kuten alalla on tapana.

**Hyvät tekijämme ansaitsevat erittäin hyvin, ja parhaiden kuukausiansiot ovat nousseet jopa 15 000 euroon.**

Emme etsi vain valmiita huippumyyjiä, vaan myös nälkäisiä tekijöitä, jotka haluavat huipulle. Tarjoamme kaiken tuen omien kykyjen löytämiseen ja valjastamiseen joka päivä.

Työtä on mahdollista tehdä tilanteesta riippuen joko **työsuhteessa tai laskuttavana yrittäjänä**. Ja toki myös osa- tai täysiaikaisesti.

**Mitä ostaja käytännössä tekee?**

Asiakkaat tulevat mainonnan tai keskeisen sijainnin ansiosta luoksesi myymään omistamiaan arvoesineitä. Tehtäväsi on kohdata asiakas, arvioida tarjottava kokonaisuus, neuvotella ja tehdä molemmille osapuolille järkevä kauppa.

Ostopisteitämme tuetaan aktiivisesti **moninaisella mainonnalla**, kuten **lehti- ja verkkonäkyvyydellä** sekä **telesales-tiimimme** aktiivisen ajanvarauksen keinoin.

Sinulle rakennetaan siis ympäristö, jossa pääset keskittymään olennaiseen: **ihmisten kohtaamiseen ja kauppojen tekemiseen.**

**Kenelle työ sopii?**

Tutkintotodistuksia tärkeämpää meille on se, millainen olet ihmisten kanssa.

**Saatat olla etsimämme henkilö, jos:**

- uskallat mennä ihmisten luo ja aloittaa keskustelun

- olet luonteeltasi ulospäinsuuntautunut ja sosiaalisesti taitava

- herätät ihmisissä luottamusta

- sinulla on tervettä itseluottamusta ja pilkettä silmäkulmassa

- nautit kaupanteosta ja neuvottelusta

- osaat lukea ihmisiä ja tilanteita

- raha ja tuloksen tekeminen motivoivat sinua

- kestät painetta etkä lamaannu vastoinkäymisistä

- otat vastuuta omasta tuloksestasi.


**Jos sinussa on vanhan koulukunnan torikauppiaan rohkeutta yhdistettynä modernin myyjän ammattitaitoon, saatat sopia meille erinomaisesti.**

Aiempi kokemus myynnistä, ostamisesta, kaupankäynnistä, kelloista, jalometalleista tai keräilyesineistä on hyödyksi, mutta oikealle ihmiselle kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi.

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

- Turvallisen pohjapalkan, jonka päälle on helppo rakentaa provisiot

- Vahvan provisiomallin ja erittäin korkean ansaintapotentiaalin

- Parhaimmillaan lähes 15 000 €/kk yltäneitä kuukausiansioita

- Valmiiksi markkinoituja ostopisteitä ja asiakasvirtaa

jobs.title: Vinduespudser søges
jobs.description:
Bliv vinduespudser hos os – og få et job, der faktisk er fedt at møde op til

Er du træt af kedelige jobs, hvor dagene bare flyder sammen?
Vil du hellere have frihed, ansvar, god løn og et team, du faktisk gider hænge ud med?

Så læs lige videre…..

 

Hvad går jobbet ud på?

Du bliver en del af vores team som vinduespudser, hvor du:

  • Arbejder ude hver dag (ingen kontorstol her:) ❌

  • Får ansvar for dine egne opgaver og kunder

  • Kører rundt i din egen firmabil med topmoderne udstyr

  • Leverer kvalitet og god service – og kan se resultatet med det samme

 

Hvem leder vi efter?

Vi søger to typer:

Erfaren vinduespudser

  • Du har min. 3 års erfaring

  • Du ved, hvad du laver – og går op i kvalitet

  • Du vil være en del af et stærkt team og bidrage med din erfaring

Ny i faget (vi lærer dig op)

  • Du har den rette energi og vil lære

  • Vi giver dig en grundig oplæring + bred erfaring

  • Du bliver en del af et team, der faktisk gider hjælpe dig

 

Hvem er du som person?

  • Du er mødestabil og tager ansvar

  • Du har god energi og en positiv attitude

  • Du bidrager til en fed stemning og stærkt fællesskab

  • Du vil ikke bare have et job – du vil være en del af noget

 

Derfor er det her ikke bare et job

Hos os handler det ikke kun om arbejde – det handler om kulturen:

  • Et ungt team med plads til humor og god stemning

  • Sociale aktiviteter, som du selv kan være med til at planlægge

  • Ordnede forhold og respekt for hinanden

  • Et sted hvor man både kan arbejde seriøst – og have det sjovt imens

 

 Hvad får du?

  • Din egen firmabil + det nyeste udstyr på markedet

  • Mulighed for at tjene ekstra:

  • Bonus for at skaffe nye kunder

  • Ekstra indtjening hvis du vil arbejde mere

  • Frihed under ansvar

  • Ferie og fridage fra day one

  • Et job hvor du kan udvikle dig og få ansvar

 

Kort sagt:

Hvis du vil have et job med:

  • Frihed

  • God løn

  • Et stærkt fællesskab

  • Og en hverdag du faktisk glæder dig til

…så er det her dit næste job!

 

Klar på at blive en del af holdet?

Send en ansøgning + CV til os i vores link. 

Du skal kunne læse og forstå Dansk eller Engelsk.

Vi ansætter løbende  –  så vent ikke for længe:)

jobs.title: POLYCEA - Ingénieur / Ingénieure DevOps (H/F)
jobs.description:
Expert de la transformation numérique, Polycea se distingue par son ADN hybride alliant vision stratégique et excellence technologique. De la réflexion avec les dirigeants jusqu'au déploiement opérationnel, nous maîtrisons l'intégralité de la chaîne de valeur.
Pour résoudre ces problématiques complexes, nos équipes pluridisciplinaires réunissent consultants, product managers et experts techniques (Data, DevOps, Architecture). Ensemble, ils conçoivent des solutions logicielles et data sur-mesure, en France comme à l'international.
Nos clients ? Des acteurs du CAC40, des ETI et des institutions publiques, évoluant dans des domaines aussi variés que l'aéronautique, le luxe ou la logistique.
Rejoindre Polycea, c'est intégrer une culture d'excellence et d'entraide, conçue pour responsabiliser les talents et accélérer leur évolution sur des missions à fort impact.
Votre rôle
En tant qu'Ingénieur Cloud DevOps senior, votre rôle s'articule autour de trois principaux axes :

Garantir l'excellence : Être le garant des standards de qualité et diffuser les bonnes pratiques au sein des équipes projets.
Mentorer : Accompagner la montée en compétences des consultants juniors en mission et faciliter leur progression technique au quotidien.
Innover : Orienter les choix techniques et mener l'amélioration continue de nos pratiques (Continuous Delivery, self-service, observabilité) grâce à une veille technologique constante.

Vous intervenez sur des environnements à forte complexité opérationnelle pour piloter et réaliser des chantiers de transformation :

Architecture & Build : Concevoir des stratégies d'hébergement sur mesure et déployer des plateformes Cloud (Greenfield) hautement sécurisées et résilientes.
Modernisation & Migration : Auditer l'existant pour définir et piloter la refonte d'architectures ou la migration de SI vers le Cloud (Replatforming / Refactoring).
Industrialisation Avancée : Mettre en œuvre une automatisation à l'état de l'art (Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, GitOps) afin de fiabiliser et d'accélérer le delivery.
Conseil & Gouvernance : Mettre en place des cadres de gouvernance (Landing Zones, CCoE - Cloud Center of Excellence) et accompagner les équipes clients dans leur acculturation DevOps et l'adoption de nouvelles pratiques.

Environnement technique :  

Conteneurisation : Docker, Kubernetes, Helm.
Automatisation & CI/CD : Terraform, Ansible, ArgoCD, GitLab CI.
Cloud Providers : AWS, Azure, GCP, OVHcloud, Outscale.
Bases de données : Relationnelles, NoSQL, Clustering.
Observabilité & Monitoring : Prometheus, Stack ELK / Grafana, Splunk, PagerDuty.

Exemples de missions récentes

Secteur Mobilité : Refonte, migration vers Azure et infogérance d'une plateforme critique de gestion d'alertes pour un leader mondial du stationnement.
Secteur Médias : Conception et exploitation d'une plateforme DevOps as-a-Service permettant le déploiement automatisé des infrastructures de la plateforme vidéo d'un grand groupe français.
Secteur Public : Déploiement et exploitation des infrastructures GCP d'une application grand public à destination de la jeunesse pour le Ministère de la Culture.
Secteur Gaming : Pilotage de la transformation Cloud d'un acteur international du jeu vidéo mobile (mise en place de la gouvernance, Landing Zone et migration des workloads).
Secteur Édition : Cadrage stratégique et exécution opérationnelle de la migration vers AWS pour un leader mondial.

Ce que nous attendons de vous
Issu(e) d'une Grande École d'Ingénieurs ou équivalent, vous justifiez idéalement d'une expérience d'au moins 2 ans en tant que DevOps ou SRE, idéalement acquise dans le conseil ou au sein de contextes de transformation complexes.
Sur le plan technique, une maîtrise opérationnelle d'au moins un Cloud Provider majeur ainsi qu'une excellente compréhension des enjeux de la conteneurisation sont attendues. Adepte d'une approche systématique de l'automatisation ("Everything as Code") pour fiabiliser les opérations, vous savez également vulgariser ces concepts techniques complexes auprès d'interlocuteurs variés.
Doté(e) d'un fort sens du service et du collectif, votre capacité à mentorer votre équipe et votre envie de contribuer activement à la structuration de notre practice Infra/Ops seront de véritables atouts.
Enfin, pour vous intégrer rapidement à nos taskforces projets et interagir efficacement avec nos clients, la maîtrise courante du français (à l'écrit comme à l'oral) est indispensable.
Pourquoi rejoindre Polycea ?

Vous intervenez sur des missions à impact et voyez le résultat de vos actions
Vous êtes responsabilisé(e) et évoluez dans un environnement propice à l'apprentissage et à la progression, au contact de talents qui se tirent vers le haut
Vous travaillez dans une ambiance à la fois détendue et stimulante, prônant esprit d'équipe et prise d'initiatives
Vous profitez d'une vie interne riche en événements (sportifs, culturels, culinaires.)
Votre équilibre vie pro / vie perso e...

jobs.title: Ingénieur commercial (construction)
jobs.description:
En tant qu'Ingénieur(e) Commercial Technique, vous accompagnez les acteurs du secteur de la construction dans le choix de solutions adaptées à leurs projets. Vous combinez expertise technique, développement de relations commerciales et suivi de projets afin d'apporter une réelle valeur ajoutée à vos clients.

Informations sur l'entreprise

Notre client est un acteur majeur du secteur de la construction, spécialisé dans les solutions structurelles innovantes destinées aux projets résidentiels et non résidentiels.

Adossée à un groupe international solide, l'entreprise bénéficie de moyens importants tout en conservant une culture de proximité. L'innovation, la qualité des réalisations et le développement des collaborateurs occupent une place centrale dans sa stratégie.


Missions

Au sein de l'équipe commerciale et technique, vous êtes responsable du développement et du suivi de votre portefeuille de projets.

Vos missions comprennent notamment :

  • Développer et fidéliser un réseau d'architectes, bureaux d'études et entreprises générales
  • Apporter un conseil technique aux clients dans le choix de solutions constructives
  • Identifier de nouvelles opportunités commerciales
  • Étudier les besoins des clients et analyser la faisabilité des projets
  • Assurer le suivi technique et commercial des dossiers
  • Participer aux négociations et défendre les solutions proposées
  • Coordonner les échanges avec les équipes internes (études, production, dessin, projets)
  • Devenir le référent technique de vos clients tout au long du projet
  • Assurer une présence régulière sur le terrain afin de développer des relations durables

Nous recherchons un profil qui apprécie autant les aspects techniques que le contact client.

  • Ingénieur(e) Industriel ou Civil en Construction
  • Intérêt prononcé pour le développement commercial et la relation client
  • Compréhension des techniques de construction
  • Excellentes capacités de communication
  • Bon niveau en français et connaissance du néerlandais
  • Une expérience dans la construction, les structures ou le béton constitue un atout

Le candidat idéal est un ingénieur qui ne souhaite pas rester exclusivement derrière un écran et qui apprécie les échanges avec les clients et les partenaires du secteur.

jobs.title: Customer service agent
jobs.description:
Ben jij een echte teamspeler die graag klanten verder helpt? Spreek je vlot Nederlands en Frans en zoek je een stabiele functie met toekomstperspectief? Dan hebben wij misschien wel de ideale uitdaging voor jou!

Jouw functie: 
Als Customer Service Agent ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten. Je zorgt ervoor dat elke vraag professioneel, vriendelijk en efficiënt wordt behandeld.

Je takenpakket bestaat uit:

Beantwoorden van inkomende telefoongesprekken van klanten (ongeveer 50% van je tijd, gemiddeld 40 oproepen per dag).
Verwerken van e-mails en schriftelijke aanvragen.
Opvolgen van klantendossiers en administratieve taken.
Klanten informeren en ondersteunen bij hun vragen.
Samenwerken met collega's om een optimale dienstverlening te garanderen.
Deze functie heeft een administratieve en repetitieve component. Daarom zoeken we iemand die graag structuur heeft, nauwkeurig werkt en voldoening haalt uit het helpen van klanten.

Wie zoeken wij?
Voor ons zijn motivatie, klantgerichtheid en teamspirit belangrijker dan jaren ervaring.

Je profiel:

Zeer goede kennis van Nederlands en Frans (tweetalig NL/FR of FR/NL).
Je houdt van klantencontact en helpt mensen graag verder.
Je bent communicatief, geduldig en beschikt over gezond verstand.
Je zoekt een functie op lange termijn en bent op zoek naar stabiliteit.
Je werkt nauwkeurig en bent administratief sterk.
Je bent een echte teamplayer.

Pluspunten:
Een eerste ervaring in customer service, een callcenter of een andere klantgerichte functie.
Ervaring binnen de logistieke sector is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste.

jobs.title: IT Systems & Support Technician
jobs.description:
This is a full-time, onsite position based in Stockholm, Sweden.

Do you have a passion for gaming and IT operations? As a part of my3Twelve, you will have an opportunity to join a dynamic team supporting a global enterprise client. My3Twelve is seeking a technically skilled professional who thrives in both hands-on IT support and strategic systems administration. This role is ideal for someone eager to grow into advanced responsibilities, independently drive projects, and act as a technical project manager with minimal oversight.



Key Responsibilities

·      Provide front-line technical support, troubleshooting hardware/software issues, and delivering desktop support across multiple platforms

·      Manage onboarding/offboarding IT tasks (PC build-out, dev kit setup, etc.)

·      Maintain and optimize a large fleet of test devices (Windows, Android, Chrome OS, etc.)

·      Transition lab operations to cloud-hosted environments

·      Develop and deploy automation scripts (PowerShell or similar)

·      Set up lab infrastructure (racking, cabling, servers, provisioning)

·      Own and improve processes for managing technical requests, tracking issues, and communicating status

·      Deliver both tactical (day-to-day) and strategic (long-term) IT projects

·      Evaluate and recommend hardware solutions for diverse technical needs

·      Monitor, maintain, and secure servers, networks, and computer systems

·      Implement system updates, patches, backups, and disaster recovery operations

·      Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements

·      Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve issues and enhance system performance

·      Document IT procedures and system configurations

·      Independently drive projects to completion, acting as a technical project manager:

·      Develop project plans and timelines

·      Proactively identify and mitigate risks

·      Communicate project status and milestones to stakeholders

·      Facilitate team meetings and stakeholder reviews

·      Track KPIs and project outcomes

·      Capture lessons learned and implemented best practices



Qualifications



·      3–5 years’ experience in IT operations or similar roles

·      Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field

·      Strong scripting skills (PowerShell, C# preferred)

·      Deep knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux), as well as using and automating Azure and XML

·      Experience with network administration, security, and Azure virtual machines

·      Familiarity with corporate IT environments (AAD, AD, Directory Services, SharePoint, ADO)

·      Experience with ITIL-based helpdesk systems and ticketing platforms (JIRA, Autotask, Kaseya, etc.)

·      Ability to work independently and collaboratively

·      Service-minded, positive, can-do attitude

·      Highly Recommended:

·      Experience in IT operations/engineering for a game studio

·      Certifications: CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate

·      Experience troubleshooting client issues in complex corporate environments

·      Experience in technical lab environments and front-line IT operations

jobs.title: Asiakaspalvelija
jobs.description:
Etsimme ihmistä, joka tykkää puhua puhelimessa. 15 €/h + bonukset, täysin etänä.

Moviqa on biomekaniikkaan perustuva digitaalinen valmennuspalvelu. Autamme ihmisiä liikkumaan paremmin ja kivuttomammin – emme myy dieettejä emmekä ihmelaitteita, vaan valmennusta, joka lähtee siitä miten keho oikeasti liikkuu.

Nyt etsimme ihmistä, joka soittaa ja varaa ihmisille ajan maksuttomaan liikkumisen kartoitukseen.

MITÄ TYÖ KÄYTÄNNÖSSÄ ON

Soitat pääkaupunkiseudun ihmisille ja kerrot heille jostain mukavasta: maksuttomasta liikkumisen kartoituksesta, jossa katsotaan miten keho liikkuu ja mistä ne niska- ja polvijomotukset oikeasti johtuvat. Aika harva saa puhelun, jossa tarjotaan jotain ilmaista ja aidosti hyödyllistä.

Puhelut ovat lyhyitä ja hyväntuulisia. Kerrot muutamalla lauseella mistä on kyse, juttelet hetken ja varaat kiinnostuneelle ajan kalenteriin. Kirjaat tuloksen ylös. Siinä se.

Et myy mitään puhelimessa. Et kysy korttitietoja. Et painosta ketään – kaikki eivät innostu, ja se on ihan ok. Siirryt seuraavaan hyvillä mielin. Loput hoitaa valmentaja.

Kun tämä sujuu, työ laajenee: otat vastaan myös saapuvia puheluita ja hoidat asiakaspalvelua. Aloitamme kuitenkin rauhassa ajanvarauksesta.

KÄYTÄNNÖN ASIAT, JOTKA ON HYVÄ TIETÄÄ ETUKÄTEEN

\- Soittoajat ovat joustavat. Sovitaan ne yhdessä sinun aikataulusi mukaan.

\- Soitat yrityksen numerosta. Oma puhelinnumerosi ei näy asiakkaalle, eikä sinun tarvitse antaa sukunimeäsi.

\- Kaikki tapahtuu koneelta. Et mene kenenkään kotiin etkä tapaa asiakkaita.

\- Työ on täysin etänä, omalta koneelta, omassa rauhassa.

KENELLE TÄMÄ SOPII

Tämä sopii sinulle, jos juttelet mielelläsi ihmisten kanssa ja haluat työn, jonka päivät järjestät itse. Osa tekijöistämme tekee tätä opintojen ohessa iltaisin, osa lasten päiväunien aikaan, osa aamuisin ennen muuta.

Aiempaa kokemusta ei tarvita. Olemme opettaneet tämän ihmisille, jotka eivät olleet koskaan soittaneet työkseen – tärkeintä on lämmin ja selkeä puhetapa. Sen oppii, mitä sanoa: sinä tuot äänen.

Jos hyvinvointi ja liikkuminen kiinnostavat sinua muutenkin, tämä on mukavampaa työtä kuin moni muu puhelintyö. On helpompi kertoa palvelusta, johon itsekin uskoo.

Hae, vaikka et olisi varma että osaat. Emme odota valmista tekijää.

MITÄ TARJOAMME

\- 15 €/h kiinteä tuntipalkka – ei pelkkää provisiota, palkka juoksee vaikka päivä olisi hiljaisempi

\- Bonus jokaisesta toteutuneesta tapaamisesta päälle, ilman kattoa

\- Täysi etätyö

\- Joustavat työajat: sovitaan viikkotuntimäärä, ja päivät järjestät itse

\- Valmis puhelurunko, valmiit kontaktit ja kunnon perehdytys

\- Tuki koko ajan saatavilla – et jää yksin listan kanssa. Ensimmäiset soitot tehdään yhdessä.

\- Mahdollisuus kasvaa asiakaspalvelun ja tiimin puolelle

MITÄ TARVITSET

Tietokoneen, headsetin, toimivan nettiyhteyden ja rauhallisen paikan, jossa voit puhua häiriöttä. Muun me hoidamme.

HAKEMINEN

Käy ensin tutustumassa meihin osoitteessa moviqa.fi – siellä näet mistä on kyse ja mitä asiakkaamme sanovat. Jos tuntuu omalta, lähetä lyhyt hakemus osoitteeseen hei@moviqa.fi otsikolla "Asiakaspalvelu".

Kerro viestissä:

1\. nimesi ja puhelinnumerosi

2\. kuka olet ja mitä teet nyt

3\. montako tuntia viikossa haluaisit tehdä ja milloin voisit aloittaa

Pitkää hakemusta ei tarvita – muutama rehellinen lause riittää, eikä CV ole pakollinen. Soitamme sopiville hakijoille lyhyen puhelun, koska tässä työssä ääni kertoo enemmän kuin paperi. Se puhelu ei ole koe, vaan ihan tavallinen juttutuokio.

Kysyttävää tehtävästä? Kysy rohkeasti samasta osoitteesta ennen hakemista – vastaamme nopeasti.

Käsittelemme hakemuksia heti niiden saapuessa ja täytämme paikan sopivan tekijän löydyttyä.

jobs.title: ERP Project Manager Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Talencia is looking for a "Job title" for one of its clients.
 
Location :Bruxelles and La Louviére
Start date : October
Duration : 2 years 
 
Context :
 
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead and coordinate a major ERP transformation project focused on Supply Chain processes.
The Project Manager will be responsible for coordinating the different functional and technical teams involved in the project, with a particular focus on the analysis and design phase.
You will act as the central point of coordination between business stakeholders, functional analysts, technical teams, key users and external implementation partners. Your role is to ensure that the different teams work towards a common objective, that dependencies are properly managed and that the analysis activities progress according to scope, planning and quality expectations.
The ideal candidate has strong experience managing complex ERP projects and is comfortable operating in environments involving multiple stakeholders, parallel workstreams and significant business transformation.
 
Description :
 
Project Management & Coordination
  • Take ownership of the overall planning and coordination of the ERP project.
  • Coordinate multiple functional and technical workstreams.
  • Define and monitor project milestones, deliverables, dependencies and priorities.
  • Ensure that the different teams remain aligned with the overall project objectives.
  • Organise and facilitate project meetings, workshops and follow-up sessions.
  • Monitor progress and proactively identify delays, dependencies, risks and blockers.
  • Ensure effective communication between business, IT and implementation partners.
  • Provide regular project status reporting to management and key stakeholders.
Coordination of the Analysis Phase
 
A major part of the role will be to coordinate and structure the functional analysis activities rather than performing all analysis personally.
  • Coordinate the functional analysts working on the different Supply Chain processes.
  • Structure the analysis approach, priorities and deliverables.
  • Ensure that functional teams have a clear understanding of scope and expected outcomes.
  • Coordinate workshops with business stakeholders and key users.
  • Ensure consistency between analyses performed across different processes and teams.
  • Identify gaps, overlaps and dependencies between functional workstreams.
  • Challenge proposed solutions where necessary and ensure alignment with the overall ERP strategy.
  • Track open points, decisions, assumptions and actions resulting from the analysis.
  • Ensure that functional specifications and process documentation are delivered on time and with the expected quality.
Supply Chain ERP Transformation
 
The project focuses on the transformation and optimisation of Supply Chain processes within an ERP environment, including areas such as:
  • Procurement and purchasing
  • Supplier processes
  • Product and article master data
  • Inventory and stock management
  • Warehouse management
  • Order management
  • Logistics and delivery processes
  • End-to-end Supply Chain process flows
  • Integration with other ERP and business processes
The Project Manager does not need to be the deepest functional expert in every area, but must have sufficient ERP and Supply Chain understanding to...... -
