jobs.title: Kundservicemedarbetare på deltid till KONES larmcentral!
jobs.description:
Vill du göra skillnad i ditt arbete genom att säkerställa säkerhet för KONEs kunder? Vi utökar nu vår studentpool på deltid hos KONE där du kommer bemanna företagets larmcentral och ta emot felanmälningar. Läs mer nedan och ansök redan idag!

Om tjänsten

Academic Work söker för KONEs räkning en Kundservicemedarbetare där du kommer arbeta med felanmälningar i larmcentralen på huvudkontoret i Kista! Du kommer att bidra med ett viktigt jobb för att säkerställa säkerhet för alla som använder företagets produkter.

Starten är omgående där du förväntas arbeta två pass i veckan under terminerna och uppemot heltid under lov såsom sommar och jul.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som Kundservicemedarbetare kommer dina arbetsuppgifter bestå av att via telefon ta emot felanmälningar och larm från kunder och privatpersoner. Du kommer tillsammans med dina kollegor arbeta mot att nå företagets högt uppställda servicemål. Du kommer att få en gedigen introduktion på plats och ha en Teamleader som närmsta chef. Tillsammans med din teamleader kommer ni att följa upp och du har möjlighet att ständigt utvecklas!

Du kommer till exempel att:

    Identifiera säkerhetssituationer och hantera dessa genom att lämna lämpliga anvisningar  
    Hantera ett ärende till dess att ärendet accepterats av en tekniker

Vi söker dig som

    Har erfarenhet av serviceinriktat arbete
    Studerar på eftergymnasial nivå och har minst 1,5 år kvar av dina studier
    Har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och goda kunskaper i engelska, i så väl i tal som skrift, då det används i det dagliga arbetet

Det är meriterande om du:

    Har erfarenhet av kundservice med telefon som främsta arbetsverktyg

För att lyckas väl i rollen som kundservicemedarbetare hos KONE krävs det att du är fokuserad på att hjälpa deras kunder och dina kollegor. Vi värdesätter personliga egenskaper som skapar trygghet och relation med alla som kontaktar KONE. Vi tror också att du är en glad och positiv person som gillar att arbeta i en miljö där tempot stundtals är högt. Du kommer att ha mycket kontakt med företagskunder, privatpersoner, servicetekniker och arbetsledare vilket kräver god samarbetsförmåga. Du är en utpräglad lagspelare och har även förmågan att prestera individuellt. Vidare ser vi även att du förstår vikten av ett gott och professionellt beteende på en seriös arbetsplats.

Övrig information

    Start: Omgående och sträcker sig långsiktigt under studieperioden
    Omfattning: Deltid under terminerna och uppemot heltid under sommar/jul
    Arbetstider: 2 pass i veckan vilka är förlagda mellan 7-17, måndag - fredag. De flesta pass är halvdagar (07-12 eller 11-17) men heldagar kan förekomma
    Placering: Kista

Vår rekryteringsprocess

Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.

jobs.title: Jeg søker inntil 9 tilkallingsvikarer som kan jobbe ved sykdom, annet fravær.
jobs.description:
Hei! 😀

Jeg er en kvinne med et aktivt liv. Jeg liker kino, turer, svømming, bilturer og sosiale sammenkomster, men også rolige kvelder hjemme. Jeg starter på skole i august og tar opp fag. Jeg har bodd i Jessheim i ett år og er svært fornøyd der. Jeg er din arbeidsleder, og det er meg du forholder deg til i det daglige.

Som min assistent bistår du meg i hverdagen med både praktiske og sosiale oppgaver. Arbeidet varierer fra personlig hygiene til aktiviteter som kino, konserter og reiser – også utenlandstur til Spania kan forekomme.

Kvalifikasjoner 📌

- Over 23 år (krav på grunn av bilforsikring)
- Det er ønskelig at du er omtrent på samme alder som meg
- Erfaring som BPA er en fordel
- Førerkort klasse B, manuelt gir (absolutt krav)
- Kunne lage mat
- Førstehjelpskurs er en fordel (kan gis)

Assistentene mine er en forlengelse av meg i hverdagen. Det er derfor viktig at du er fleksibel, trygg og komfortabel med varierte oppgaver. Jeg ser spesielt etter deg som har noe erfaring med business, enten fra arbeidslivet eller sosiale medier.

  

Arbeidstid 🕰

Vaktene settes etter behov:

- Dag: kl. 07.00–14.30
- Kveld: kl. 14.30–22.00
- Natt: kl. 22.00–07.00

Tidene kan variere ut fra dagsform og aktiviteter.

Håper du vil bli med på laget og bli min nye superhelt! 😊

Jeg verdsetter mangfold og oppfordrer alle som kjenner seg igjen i beskrivelsen til å søke.


Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Tarifflønn, ansiennitetsregulert

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Veiledning og opplæring

  • Assistentkurs i regi av Humana Omsorg og Assistanse

  • Egen app for håndbøker og rutiner

  • Rabatter hos bl.a. SATS

  • Attraktive rabatter med fordelsprogrammet Visma LogBuy



Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.title: Expert IT Analyst
jobs.employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
jobs.description:
Job ID: 5647



Are you passionate about finance and IT, and want to take the next step in your career? We are currently looking for a motivated and dynamic person to join our Capital Management Requirements & Analysis team at Nordea. In our team, we pride ourselves on engineering solutions and direct Nordea’s transformation by providing a holistic technological view and structured understanding of the bank, and its surrounding environment to enable the Customer Vision and the Business Strategy.

We are now looking for a Expert IT Analyst with solid experience from the banking industry that are eager to join us on our current journey of re-engineering our IT landscape within Capital reporting. You will play a crucial role in the project development lifecycle, and you will be allocated to one (or more) projects with a specific role in the execution structure.

We believe our new Expert IT Analyst loves working in cross-functional teams, have a passion for data analysis, data modelling and problem solving, and see their interpersonal communication as one of their strongest skills. If this sounds like you, and you are eager to learn and develop as a IT Analyst, it might be you who we're looking for!

About this opportunity

Meet the Capital Management Requirements & Analysis team. We work in Capital Management reporting and provide data for different reporting solutions, including Basel and Corep, and we specialize in IT analysis, data modelling, and data architecture. Our team is filled with international, diverse, and highly skilled professionals, working with a broad range of technology support that spans across the entire bank. The team is defined by a high work ethic and a strong mindset towards enabling high customer and user-oriented IT services. Collaboration, ownership, passion, and courage is therefore of utmost importance when joining this team, since these are the values that guide us in being, and performing, at our best.

This position can be located either in Gdansk/Gdynia, Warsaw, Helsinki or Stockholm. This position might require travelling.

What you’ll be doing:

    Take lead and drive requirements and analysis work that involves multiple stakeholders, ultimately to design sustainable and value adding solutions, this includes:
    Elicit requirements (functional and non-functional) supported by established frameworks
    Secure requirements traceability during end-to-end development
    Be responsible for requirements documentation and provide know-how throughout the entire software delivery value stream
    Build a contextual understanding of business processes on one hand and functional/technical know-how of our solutions on the other. This requires collaboration between business stakeholders and our developers and to support in building and prioritizing the product backlog
    Provide technical counselling across all aspects of our end-to-end data architecture
    Proactively share own knowledge and IT competencies, both on a cross unit and cross border basis to enable the continuing strengthening of competencies
    Interest in and preferably experience with AI-enabled analytics, automation and improvements

Who you are

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the four key values that guide us in being at our best. We imagine that you enjoy learning and are excited about bringing your ideas to the table. You’re dependable, willing to speak up – even when it’s difficult – and committed to empowering others.

We believe that you come from a solid background as a IT Business Analyst in the banking industry, with a thorough understanding of banking, Basel and similar regulations, as well as experience from pushing requirements and analysis work with multiple stakeholders. You probably have excellent communication skills and experience from (and loves) working in globally distributed teams.

To succeed in this role, we believe that you have:

    Minimum 10 years of working experience in IT projects, whereas minimum 5 years working as IT Business Analyst
    Solid background from banking industry and knowledge within credit risk domain more specifically regulatory reporting covering following areas e.g. collaterals, risk exposure amount, reconciliations, guarantees, risk models
    Knowledge and experience of reporting frameworks such as COREP, AnaCredit, Pillar III
    Good experience in Data analysis using SQL queries
    Experience from working with Python and/or Power BI as well as reporting software such as Controller View and an interest to learn
    Experience working in Agile Software development, ideally SAFe framework

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

We kindly ask you to submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 20/09/2026. We will ongoingly be reviewing applications and conducting interviews as we receive them, and might close the recruitment process before the posting end date. Therefore, we ask you to submit your application as soon as possible. Any applications or CVs sent by email, direct messages, or any other channel than our application forms, will not be accepted or considered.

At Nordea, we know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable workplace. We deeply believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics, and traits make us better at serving our customers and communities.

For union information, please contact finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACONordea@nordea.com.

jobs.title: Lagerarbetare till OneMed – Göteborg
jobs.description:
Om tjänsten



Vi gör skillnad för svensk hälso- och sjukvård varje dag. Nu söker OneMed engagerade lagerarbetare till vår verksamhet i Göteborg.

Hos oss blir du en del av ett team med stark lagkänsla där vi tillsammans arbetar för att nå våra gemensamma servicemål.

Under 2026 kommer OneMed att flytta till ett nybyggt lager i Halvorsäng. Arbetet kommer därför att utföras både på vårt nuvarande lager på Tagenevägen 29 och på det nya lagret i Halvorsäng, beroende på verksamhetens behov.

Om rollen



Som lagerarbetare på OneMed har du en viktig roll i vår logistikverksamhet. Arbetet är varierande, fysiskt och sker i ett högt tempo.

Dina arbetsuppgifter består bland annat av:

    Plock och pack av varor
    Plock i automationsanläggning
    In- och utleveranser
    Truckkörning

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som:

    Har truckkort A1–A4
    Har erfarenhet av lagerarbete, gärna från plocklager
    Har god datorvana och lätt för att lära dig nya system

För att trivas hos oss tror vi att du är engagerad, ansvarstagande och trivs med att arbeta mot tydliga mål i ett högt tempo.

Meriterande:

    Erfarenhet av lagersystemet Astro
    Erfarenhet av skjutstativtruck

Du behöver ha goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift, då arbetet innebär hantering av skriftlig information.

Vi erbjuder



Hos oss på OneMed arbetar du i ett team med stark lagkänsla och fokus på gemensamma mål. Vi erbjuder en aktiv arbetsdag tillsammans med engagerade kollegor.

Start: Omgående

Omfattning: Heltid, tidsbegränsad anställning till och med 31/1 2027

Arbetstider: Skift – 07:00–15:30 eller 15:30–00:00

Utöver detta erbjuder vi:

    Massage på arbetsplatsen (massör på plats 1–2 gånger per vecka)
    Gratis parkering
    Fräscha och nyrenoverade lokaler
    Tillgång till personalgym

Information kring tester

När du söker jobb hos oss på OneMed ska du känna dig trygg i att du blir rättvist bedömd och att vi ger alla kandidater samma möjligheter att få ett jobb hos oss. Som en del i detta arbetar vi med en strukturerad rekryteringsprocess och utgår från en tydlig kravprofil som röd tråd genom hela processen, från ansökan till anställningsbeslut. Som en del i processen använder vi oss av tester, ett logiskt problemlösningstest och ett personlighetstest. Testerna utgår från vedertagen forskning och ger oss möjlighet att på ett opartiskt sätt bedöma dina styrkor och eventuella utmaningar i relation till aktuell tjänst. Resultatet kan sammanfattas som en av pusselbitarna i vår förståelse för din matchning till rollen och ligger till grund för den fortsatta rekryteringsprocessen hos oss.

I denna rekrytering använder vi tester i ett tidigt urval och om du går vidare till nästa steg i rekryteringsprocessen kommer du får mer information om tester via mejl.

Ansökan

jobs.title: Receptionist to Axis Communications
jobs.description:
If you enjoy delivering world-class service and want to take ownership of a professional front desk function, this could be the role for you. We are now looking for two receptionists to join our Facilities Services team at our head office in Lund.

About the role

As a Receptionist, you are the first point of contact for visitors, partners and employees. You represent the company daily and are responsible for maintaining a professional and well-functioning reception environment. We are looking for an outgoing and service-minded person who enjoys being the public face of the organization and contributing to a positive experience for both visitors and employees.

Your future team

You will be part of the Facilities External & Internal Services department, which includes service desk, reception, event and conference services, as well as mail and courier services. Together with related teams such as Premises and Security, the department ensures a high level of service and a safe, stimulating work environment for all employees in Lund. We value teamwork highly and support one another in our daily work. Being part of the team means being engaged, flexible and willing to step in when needed.

Work tasks

    Professionally welcome and assist visitors, partners and suppliers
    Independently manage incoming calls and shared email inbox
    Handle internal service requests via digital case management systems
    Perform structured administrative tasks and documentation
    Manage mail and courier services, including registration and distribution
    Handle invoices and perform numerical follow-up
    Coordinate smaller assignments and contribute to process improvements
    Ensure compliance with internal routines and security procedures

We are looking for

    3–5 years of documented experience from a professional service role (e.g. reception, front desk, hospitality or similar)
    Completed upper secondary education
    Experience from a front desk / meet & greet environment
    Confident user of Microsoft 365 and SharePoint
    Fluent Swedish and exceptional English, both written and spoken

Meritorious

    Post-secondary education within service management, hospitality or equivalent
    Experience with invoice handling and basic financial administration

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are

This role requires a high level of professionalism, structure and service maturity, where you are expected to work independently, manage parallel tasks with accuracy and maintain consistent service standards in line with internal routines and security procedures. In this position, you will meet colleagues, partners and visitors from across the globe and will often be their first impression of Axis in Lund.

Other information

    Start: We are looking for two receptionists. One will start on October 26 and the other on December 7.
    Scope: Full-time
    Location: Lund
    Working hours: 8 hours between 07:30 and 17:00
    About the assignment: You will be employed by Academic Work on a six-month consulting assignment, after which there is a possibility of over-recruitment

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

The role is based in Ludvika and requires frequent presence at our office, with flexibility of hybrid working.

jobs.title: Teamleder for rengøring – Erhvervsrengøring   /  Cleaning Supervisor – Commercial Cleaning
jobs.description:
Rengøringsleder – Erhvervsrengøring

Vi søger en erfaren rengøringsleder til vores team.

Har du erfaring med erhvervsrengøring, og er du god til at koordinere medarbejdere, kunder og de daglige opgaver? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Stillingen

Som rengøringsleder bliver du en vigtig del af vores daglige drift og fungerer som højre hånd for vores Service Managers.

Du får ansvar for at koordinere en mindre gruppe kunder og støtte vores rengøringsassistenter, så vores kunder altid modtager en høj og ensartet service.

Dine kunder kan blandt andet være skoler, kontorer og engangsopgaver.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Koordinere rengøringsopgaver for en mindre kundeportefølje.

  • Planlægge og følge op på de daglige rengøringsopgaver.

  • Motivere, vejlede og støtte rengøringsassistenter.

  • Sikre, at rengøringskvaliteten lever op til vores standarder.

  • Følge op med kunder og bidrage til gode kunderelationer.

  • Håndtere praktiske udfordringer og finde løsninger, når der er behov for det.

  • Assistere Service Managers med de daglige driftsopgaver.

  • Træde til og hjælpe med rengøring, når det er nødvendigt.

Vi søger dig, som

  • Har solid erfaring med erhvervsrengøring.

  • Har erfaring med rengøring eller koordinering af rengøringsopgaver på skoler, kontorer eller lignende.

  • Har gode organisatoriske og koordinerende evner.

  • Er god til at kommunikere med både kunder og medarbejdere.

  • Kan motivere rengøringsassistenter og gå forrest med et godt eksempel.

  • Er stabil, ansvarsbevidst og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Har en positiv og løsningsorienteret tilgang.

  • Trives med at tage ansvar og træffe beslutninger i den daglige drift.

Vi tilbyder

  • En alsidig og ansvarsfuld stilling i en virksomhed i vækst.

  • Et tæt samarbejde med vores Service Managers.

  • Mulighed for at tage ansvar og udvikle dig i rollen.

  • Et positivt og professionelt arbejdsmiljø.

  • En stilling, hvor din erfaring og dit initiativ bliver værdsat.

Sådan søger du

Send dit opdaterede CV til:

jobs@sjreng.dk

Bemærk, at kun ansøgninger med et opdateret CV vil komme i betragtning.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

_________________________________________________________________________________

We are looking for an experienced Cleaning Supervisor to join our team.

Do you have experience in commercial cleaning and are you good at coordinating people, customers, and daily tasks? Then you may be the person we are looking for.

The position

As Cleaning Supervisor, you will be an important part of our daily operations and act as the right hand to our Service Managers.

You will be responsible for coordinating a small number of customers and supporting our cleaning assistants to ensure that our customers receive a high and consistent standard of service.

Your customers may include schools, offices, and one-shot cleaning assignments.

Your main responsibilities

  • Coordinate cleaning services for a small portfolio of customers.

  • Plan and follow up on daily cleaning tasks.

  • Motivate, guide, and support cleaning assistants.

  • Ensure that cleaning quality meets our standards.

  • Follow up with customers and help maintain good customer relationships.

  • Handle practical issues and find solutions when needed.

  • Support the Service Managers with daily operational tasks.

  • Step in and help with cleaning when required.

We are looking for someone who

  • Has solid experience in commercial cleaning.

  • Has experience cleaning or supervising work in schools, offices, shops or similar environments.

  • Has good organizational and coordination skills.

  • Is confident communicating with both customers and employees.

  • Can motivate cleaning assistants and lead by example.

  • Is reliable, responsible, and able to work independently.

  • Has a positive and solution-oriented attitude.

  • Is comfortable taking responsibility and making decisions in daily operations.

We offer

  • A varied and responsible position in a growing cleaning company.

  • Close cooperation with our Service Managers.

  • The opportunity to take responsibility and develop your role.

  • A positive and professional working environment.

  • A position where your experience and initiative are valued.

How to apply

Please send your updated CV to:

jobs@sjreng.dk

Please note that only applications with an updated CV will be considered.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Bli med og gjør en forskjell for barn og familier i Astafjord
jobs.description:
Bli med og gjør en forskjell for barn og familier i Astafjord.

Ønsker du en jobb der du hver dag kan bidra til å skape trygge og gode oppvekstvilkår for barn og unge? Astafjord interkommunale barneverntjeneste søker en engasjert kollega som vil være med på å gjøre en forskjell for barn, unge og familier i våre fem deltakerkommuner: Gratangen, Lavangen, Salangen, Ibestad og Dyrøy.

Hos oss blir du en del av et erfarent og dedikert fagmiljø med høy kompetanse innen barnevernsfaget. Vi arbeider i hovedsak etter en generalistmodell, der saksbehandlerne følger hele saksløpet, fra undersøkelse og oppfølging av tiltak til fosterhjemsarbeid. Dette gir en variert og spennende arbeidshverdag, med gode muligheter for faglig utvikling og helhetlig oppfølging av barn og familier.

Samtidig ønsker vi å styrke vårt tiltaksarbeid. Har du erfaring som familieveileder, tiltakskonsulent eller annen relevant kompetanse innen endrings- og veiledningsarbeid, er dette erfaring vi vil vektlegge. Vi er åpne for å tilpasse stillingens innhold ut fra søkernes kvalifikasjoner og tjenestens behov, slik at vi sammen kan bygge et enda sterkere tilbud til barna og familiene vi følger opp.

Vi har ledig 100 % fast stilling.


Hva kan du forvente hos oss?

Varierte og meningsfulle arbeidsdager, hvor du får jobbe med både saksbehandling, tiltaksarbeid og familieveiledning.
Tett samarbeid med barn, unge, foreldre og andre fagpersoner – alltid med barnets beste i fokus.
Mulighet til å påvirke hvordan stillingen utformes, slik at din kompetanse kommer best mulig til nytte.
Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø hvor vi heier på hverandre og deler kunnskap.

Kvalifikasjoner
  • Relevant bachelorgrad eller tilsvarende utdanning innen barnevern, sosialfag eller annet relevant fagområde.
  • For familieveilederrollen er det ønskelig med videreutdanning, kurs eller sertifiseringer innen veiledningsmetoder og tiltaksarbeid.
  • Erfaring fra slikt arbeid vil bli vektlagt.
  • Førerkort klasse B.
Vi ser etter deg som:
  • Har et varmt engasjement for barn og familier, og møter mennesker med trygghet, ydmykhet og respekt.
  • Trives med å jobbe både selvstendig og i team, og som kommuniserer godt – både muntlig og skriftlig.
  • Ønsker å utvikle deg videre, og gjerne har erfaring eller utdanning innen familieveiledning og tiltaksarbeid.

Vi vil legge stor vekt på søkernes personlige egnethet til stillingene.

Vi tilbyr
  • Lønn etter kvalifikasjoner og gode pensjonsordninger.
  • Faglige utfordringer, kurs og mulighet for videreutdanning.
  • En arbeidsplass i naturskjønne omgivelser, med nærhet til både fjord, fjell og et rikt friluftsliv.
  • Muligheten til å jobbe i kommunen som Unicef har kåret til Norges beste oppvekstkommune. 
  • Stimuleringstilskudd på kr. 35.000,- per år i 1/1 stilling
  • Meget god pensjonsordning

Annen informasjon
Send søknad og CV ved å klikke på knappen merket "Søk på stillingen" på denne siden. Vi ber om at du fyller ut CV i løsningen og ikke legger ved denne.
Det er søker sitt ansvar å sørge for at alle relevante vedlegg er lagt inn innen fristen, som for eksempel attester og vitnemål. Dersom vitnemål, karakterutskrifter eller annen dokumentasjon ikke er på et skandinavisk språk eller engelsk, må søker selv laste opp attesterte oversettinger.
Ikke send søknad på e-post til enkeltpersoner i kommunen.

Ved tiltredelse må politiattest fremlegges.
Vi gjør oppmerksom på at i følge offentlighetsloven § 25, 2. ledd kan opplysninger om søkeren bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har bedt om unntakelse fra oppføring på søkerliste. Søkeren vil alltid bli varsla på forhånd dersom søknaden blir offentligjort.

Interne søkere har fortrinnsrett ihht HTA og AML dersom de er kvalifisert og egnet for stillingen.

Salangen kommune er en liten og ambisiøs kommune i Indre Sør-Troms, der du får mulighet til å jobbe tett på både fagmiljø, ledelse og innbyggere – og faktisk være med og gjøre en forskjell. Vi har korte beslutningsveier, stor tillit til medarbeiderne våre og rom for å tenke nytt og finne gode løsninger.

Kommunesenteret Sjøvegan ligger vakkert til mellom fjord og fjell, sentralt plassert mellom Narvik, Harstad, Finnsnes og Tromsø. Her møter du et inkluderende lokalsamfunn, varierte tjenester og et arbeidsmiljø preget av samarbeid, engasjement og utviklingsvilje – med gode muligheter for både faglig vekst og et aktivt liv utenfor jobb.

jobs.description:
Primary location:
SEINÄJOKI

Hae RAVINTOLATYÖNTEKIJÄKSI täysin uuteen Kivistön Ravintolamaailmaan, Seinäjoelle!
Seinäjoen Kivistön liikekeskus uudistuu vuoden 2026 aikana ja avaamme kiinteistöön myös täysin uuden Ravintolamaailman. S-marketin yhteyteen rakentuva uusi ravintolatila tarjoaa viihtyisän kohtaamispaikan niin lounastajille, ostosten lomassa taukoa pitäville kuin perheillekin. Asiakkaita palvelevat jatkossa Hesburger Drive In ja Rosso Pizza -ravintola.

Tähän uuteen ravintolakokonaisuuteen haemme nyt ravintolatyöntekijöitä. Avoinna olevat työsuhteet ovat vakituisia ja määräaikaisia, osa-aikaisin työtunnein 12-75h/3vkoa. Monipuolinen osaaminen mahdollistaa hyvät sopimustunnit sekä mukavaa vaihtelua työhön, osa tehtävistä on yhdistettävissä myös opintojen oheen. Seinäjoen ravintolamaailmat Kivistö ja Prisma tekevät arjessa tiivistä yhteistyötä, joten tässä työssä ravintolatyöntekijän työn monipuolisuus toteutuu mahdollisuutena työskennellä kahdessa ravintola yksikössä. Työ onvauhdikasta ravintola-alan työtä, jossa pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitosi monipuolisestiasiakaspalvelun, myynnin, Hesburgerin sekä keittiön työtehtävissä.

Odotamme sinultaHaemme innostuneita ja motivoituneita tekijöitä ravintola-alan asiakaspalvelu- ja keittiötehtäviin. Arvostamme halua työskennellä monipuolisesti ravintolamaailman työpisteissä, olemme yhtä tiimiä, jossa pääset oppimaan sekä Hesburgerin että Rosso Pizzan työtehtäviä. Aiempi kokemus asiakaspalvelu tai myyntityöstä, kokin työstä, pizzan tai hampurilaisten valmistuksesta on ehdottomasti plussaa. Mikäli osaamiset ja kokemukset alalta ovat vielä vähäisiä, se ei ole este hakea, sillä joukossamme opit varsinaiseksi moniosaajaksi. Tärkeintä on positiivinen asenne ja halu oppia sekä intohimo ja kiinnostus alaa kohtaan. Teemme työtä tiiminä, joten arvostamme hyvää työkaveruutta ja yhteistyötaitoja. Edellytämme asiakaspalvelutilanteissa kommunikointikykyä suomenkielellä, joustavuutta työskennellä vuorotyössä ravintolan aukioloaikoina. Olethan myös täysi-ikäinen, 18-vuotta täyttänyt.

Me Eepeellä sanomme olevamme Ihan tavallisissatöissä. Työtä kuvaillaan usein erilaisin korulausein, jotka toivottavasti ovat myös totta, mutta meidän mielestämme ihan tavallinen työ on mahtavaa. Meillä on myös poikkeuksellisen kivoja työkavereita, erinomaisia henkilöstöetuja ja harvinaisen paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia.

jobs.title: Lead Project Cost Controller
jobs.description:
Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.

If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.

At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.

Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.

This role requires a strong on-site presence in Boden, as the work is closely connected to the day-to-day execution of the project. The role is best suited for someone who can maintain a consistent presence on site throughout the assignment, whether you already live in the region, have ties to Northern Sweden, or are prepared to make Boden your base during the project.

Type of employment: Direct temporary employment with Stegra for 12 to 24 months OR consultancy through one of our consultancy-partners.

Placement: Boden

What you’ll do

Right now, we are looking for a Lead Project Cost Controller for our Project Services team. In this role you will report to our Project Controls leadership and sit within our Project Delivery function. The team is responsible for providing financial transparency, cost governance, and decision support across one of the largest industrial projects in Europe.

As Lead Project Cost Controller, you will be responsible for leading cost control activities within a major project area, ensuring accurate forecasting, reporting, and financial performance throughout project execution. You will work closely with Project Managers, Area Managers, EPCM partners, Finance, Procurement, and Project Controls to ensure project costs are understood, controlled, and communicated effectively.

Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.

    Lead cost control activities for a major project area, ensuring alignment with budgets, project objectives, and contractual commitments
    Develop and maintain forecasts, cash flow projections, variance analyses, and cost performance reporting
    Review and challenge EPCM cost reports, commitments, accruals, change orders, and expenditure forecasts
    Monitor project performance to identify cost risks, trends, and opportunities, and drive mitigation actions
    Support project change management through cost impact assessments and evaluation of budget implications
    Collaborate with Project Managers, Area Managers, EPCM contractors, Procurement, Planning, Finance, and Accounting teams
    Prepare cost reports, dashboards, and executive summaries to support project leadership and decision-making
    Drive continuous improvement of project controls processes, reporting standards, and cost management practices

What you’ll bring

You’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.

Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below

    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Finance, Economics, Project Controls, or a related field
    Around 10 years of experience in project cost control, project controls, or commercial project management within major industrial or infrastructure projects
    Experience managing project forecasts, commitments, change management processes, and contractor cost reporting
    Strong understanding of project controls principles, forecasting methodologies, and cost management best practices
    

    Experience working with EPCM contractors and multidisciplinary project organizations
    

    Advanced analytical skills, including forecasting, trend analysis, performance reporting, and financial assessment
    Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to challenge assumptions and influence decision-making
    Excellent communication skills in English and proficiency in Excel and project controls software

Benefits at Stegra

At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.

You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.

Read more about Benefits at Stegra here.

This is Stegra

Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.

By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.

Our Boden Site

Our Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.

jobs.title: Photography and adventure guide, Levi - Part Time
jobs.description:
Beyond Arctic is a leading photography-oriented tour operator based in Levi, Finland, specializing in outdoor and adventure travel. We offer unique and authentic experiences to guests seeking exclusivity and memorable adventures. With an emphasis on small groups, flexibility, and exceptional service, we focus on delivering the highest standard of Arctic experiences in the heart of Lapland. We are currently seeking passionate and experienced adventure guides to join our team for the 2026-2027 winter season. Both full-time and part-time positions are available.

About Beyond Arctic:

As a family-owned company, Beyond Arctic is committed to providing a positive and engaging work environment for our team. Our company culture revolves around a deep love for nature, photography, and delivering extraordinary experiences for our guests. We pride ourselves on offering small, intimate group tours, where personal connections and high-quality service are our top priority.

Your Role:

As a Beyond Arctic Adventure Guide, you will lead small groups up to 8 people through the stunning landscapes of Lapland. Your primary role will be to provide exceptional Arctic experiences, help guests capture the beauty of the Arctic, and share the wonders of Finnish culture and nature. Tours include Northern Lights photography, Arctic Animals and winter activities like snowshoeing, back-country skiing, ice fishing, and nature hikes.

Beyond Arctic is dedicated to sustainable travel, and we are a Green Activities certified service provider, involved in the Sustainable Travel Finland program to help preserve the Arctics natural beauty.

Key Responsibilities:

jobs.title: Geotechnical Geologist to Gruvteknik
jobs.description:
Do you want to use your geological and geotechnical expertise to solve meaningful challenges in one of the world's most advanced underground mining environments? At LKAB, you will contribute to sustainable mining together with experienced colleagues in a supportive, international team where collaboration, learning and long-term development are central.

The sustainable transformation begins with us

We are facing our greatest challenge yet – ensuring that Sweden and Europe have what it takes to transform. So that we can live the lives we want, both today and tomorrow. In the same way that we strive to improve the future, we are committed to developing everyone who joins us on this journey, both personally and professionally.

Would you like to be part of laying the foundation for the way we live – and for the world around us?

Your role

As a Geotechnical Geologist, you will help build and develop the geotechnical understanding that supports safe, sustainable and future-oriented underground mining. You will work with data collection, geological and geotechnical modelling, technical studies and project development, always in close cooperation with colleagues from different specialist areas. The role gives you the opportunity to contribute with your expertise while continuing to learn from others across geology, rock mechanics, seismology, numerical modelling and project management. 

In the role, you will for example: 

    Coordinate geotechnical data acquisition, modelling and model application
    Plan and budget drilling programs in collaboration with relevant stakeholders
    Create, maintain and improve geotechnical models
    Contribute to technical studies and reporting
    Participate in infrastructure and mining development projects
    Collaborate with consultants and internal stakeholders on critical mining studies

What you bring

We are looking for someone who enjoys analysing complex information and translating it into useful insights. You work in a structured way, take initiative when needed and value working together with others. You communicate clearly, ask questions when something needs to be understood more deeply and are motivated by contributing to solutions that make a difference for both operations and people. 

To be eligible for the role, you need to have: 

    A Master of Science degree in Mining Engineering, Engineering Geology, Geology or another related field.
    Experience from exploration geology or engineering geology.
    Experience from underground mining environments.
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken; proficiency in Swedish is highly desirable.
    A valid driving license equivalent to Swedish category B.

It is also an advantage if you have:

    Experience with geotechnical logging and modelling, preferably using Leapfrog.
    Experience with geotechnical databases, such as AcQuire, Imago or Imdex.
    Knowledge of rock mass characterization systems.
    Experience with technical report writing and working with large geotechnical datasets.

We encourage applications from candidates whose experience may not align with every listed requirement but who are enthusiastic about the opportunity, passionate about the industry and confident in their ability to succeed in the role.

What we offer

In addition to the general benefits we offer — which you can find a bit further down — we can also offer the following to those who do not currently live in Sweden:

    Relocation support for you and your family.
    Excellent conditions for settling in. We guide you through the official procedures necessary to settle in the country if you come from outside Sweden. We also provide temporary accommodation for a reasonable period and help you find a permanent place to live according to your personal needs.
    LKAB helps you learn Swedish, a tool for a better understanding of Swedish culture.
    The Swedish vacation law entitles all employees to five weeks of vacation per year, and four consecutive weeks during June, July, or August. Your contract may include extra vacation days.

Additional information

We strive for a fair and objective recruitment process. Therefore, we usually do not request cover letters. Instead, we ask you to answer questions related to the specific position you are applying for. Your responses help us understand your skills and experience, so please take the time to answer as clearly and thoroughly as possible.

Vi er bevidste om at vi er ansat til to ting: faglighed og samarbejde. Vi arbejder i faste teams og er i gang fuld gang med arbejdet omkring den nye ældrelov, hvor der er hovedfokus på faglighed/borgerperspektivet og samarbejde. Vi holder dagligt møder vedr. tidlig opsporing, og hver uge holder vi teamsmøde, hvor vi arbejder med personcentret omsorg omkring borgere og os selv. Vi er en hjemmeplejegruppe i stor udvikling, hvor der er plads til gode grin og forskellighed. 

Hos os får du:

  • et meningsfuldt arbejde, hvor vores hovedfokus er borgeren
  • et selvstændigt arbejde med ansvar og faglige udfordringer
  • en sektion, hvor vi arbejder med både faglig og personlig udvikling
  • stort fokus på tværfagligt samarbejde
  • tæt samarbejde med kompetente og erfarne kollegaer
  • mange forskellige sygeplejefaglige opgaver
  • gode kolleger, som har fokus på arbejdsmiljøet
  • frihed under ansvar
     

Vi mangler en medarbejder der:

  • er stabil, loyal og er engageret i sit arbejde
  • har stærke samarbejdsevner
  • har lyst til faglige udfordringer og læring
  • trives i en hektisk hverdag og har et godt overblik
  • bidrager til god trivsel og godt arbejdsmiljø
  • har kørekort


Ansøgningsfrist: 20.09.26.

For yderligere information er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionsleder Sonnie Løvenholdt 2488 6870. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig, der ønsker et job med mening.
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst.
For stillinger i Social, Sundhed og beskæftigelse skal der afleveres en privat straffeattest ved ansættelse i stillingen.
 

I Svendborg Kommune ligger lønnen for denne type stilling typisk mellem 36.205 og 46.820 kr. pr. måned ved fuldtidsansættelse. Lønnen er inklusive pension, særlig feriegodtgørelse og faste tillæg. Der kan desuden være arbejdstidsbestemte tillæg og andre særydelser. Det er vigtigt at bemærke, at din konkrete løn fastsættes ud fra din erfaring, anciennitet og kompetencer og aftales ved forhandling med den relevante faglige organisation.

Svendborg Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Vi ønsker, at røgfri arbejdstid skal bidrage til et sundt arbejdsmiljø for alle medarbejdere.

 

Ældreområdet 

Når du arbejder på ældreområdet, møder du bag hver enkelt dør et unikt menneske. Et menneske, du gør en forskel for. Hos os har du frihed til at møde netop dét menneske – måske i en lille snak, i en svær stund eller med en hjælpende hånd.
Vi har ikke én færdig opskrift på det gode ældreliv, fordi vi hylder forskelligheden. Men vi gør os altid umage med at møde det enkelte menneske med værdighed. 
Vi insisterer på at skabe de bedste rammer for, at du kan udføre dit arbejde godt og meningsfuldt. Vi har også høje forventninger til dig og til din faglighed. Du får lov at bruge det, du kan, og arbejde med det, du brænder mest for. 
Du vil få en synlig leder, du kan sparre med, og dejlige kolleger at dele hverdagen med. 

 

Om Svendborg Kommune

Svendborg Kommune er i vores øjne en arbejdsplads af en helt perfekt størrelse: Vi er små nok til at være tæt på hinanden i et varmt uhøjtideligt fællesskab med korte kommandoveje og uden skjulte dagsordner. Og vi er store nok til at have god plads til ambitioner, høj faglighed og rige muligheder for udvikling. 

Vi holder af hverdagen og insisterer på, at det skal være rart at gå på arbejde. Vi har travlt, men ikke for travlt til at hjælpe hinanden. 

Velkommen til Svendborg - Øhavets hovedstad!
Svendborg har en suveræn beliggenhed midt i den skønneste natur, på kanten af det Sydfynske Øhav og med en mini-metropol, der byder på det hele. Vi tøver ikke, når vi med stolthed kalder Svendborg for Fyns kulturhovedstad. Vi har en charmerende bymidte og livlig handelsby med teatre og museer samt et rigt foreningsliv. Vores dagtilbud og folkeskoler er i top og med særligt fokus på bevægelse og sport, og vi har flere videregående uddannelser, som snart samles i et attraktivt uddannelsesmiljø ved havnen. Svendborg er placeret midt i landet med en halv time til Odense og under to timer til København og Århus. Svendborg er med sine ca. 60.000 indbyggere Fyns andenstørste kommune.

Every day, youll visit different homes and meet people from all walks of life, so no two working days are exactly the same. If you enjoy working independently while knowing that you always have a supportive team behind you, this could be the right job for you.

For us, what matters most is not how many years of experience you have in the cleaning industry, but that you take pride in your work, treat customers with kindness and are willing to learn and develop. We provide you with the training, support and tools you need to succeed.

**What we offer**

- **A close-knit and supportive team:** Youll never have to face challenges alone. Help and support are always available when needed, and good work is genuinely recognized and appreciated.

- **Varied and flexible work:** Different homes and customers bring variety to your working days, so the job is never monotonous.

- **Fixed hourly pay:** Salary in accordance with the collective agreement (TES), based on experience, starting from **€12.26/hour**.

- **Performance-based incentives:** Good and consistent performance is rewarded — your hard work can also be reflected in your paycheck.

- **Clear and predictable working hours:** Assignments are generally scheduled on weekdays between **8:00 AM and 5:00 PM**, making it easier to balance work and free time.

- **Opportunities for growth:** Develop your skills as a professional cleaner and progress in your career as you gain experience.

- **Thorough onboarding and support:** Youll receive proper training for the job and equipment, so you wont be thrown straight into the deep end.


**What we expect from you**

Previous experience in professional cleaning is **not required**. The most important things are the right attitude and a willingness to learn. We particularly value the following:

- **Customer-oriented approach:** You treat customers with kindness and take their wishes and needs into consideration.

- **Attention to detail:** You take pride in your work and pay close attention to detail in every home.

- **Problem-solving skills:** You are able to work independently and find solutions even in unexpected situations.

- **Fluent Finnish:** You can communicate smoothly and confidently with both customers and team members.

- **Driving licence:** Having your own car is considered an advantage, as our cleaning assignments are located across the area we operate in.

- **Initiative and flexibility:** You adapt to varying working days and take responsibility for your own work.

- **Reliability and a positive attitude:** You stick to agreed schedules and bring good energy to the team.


**What does a typical workday look like?**

Your working day will consist of several home cleaning assignments, which vary from day to day. Youll receive a clear route and task list, so youll always know what is expected at each location.

Some customers will become familiar faces from week to week, making the work personal and rewarding. Youll see firsthand how your work makes your customers everyday lives easier — and youll be able to see the results of your work immediately.

jobs.title: Business Controller
jobs.description:
Bli HAVI:s nya  Business Controller

HAVI tror på att rekrytera människor, inte bara CV:n. Om du drivs av att omsätta siffror till insikter, vill arbeta nära verksamheten och tycker om att påverka affärsbeslut genom analys och uppföljning, kan detta vara rätt nästa steg för dig.

Till HAVI rekryterar vi nu en Business Controller till deras Finance-team i Tumba. Det här är en bred och verksamhetsnära roll där du får ansvar för controllerarbetet inom en egen verksamhetsenhet samtidigt som du arbetar nära Operations, Sales och övriga delar av organisationen för att stödja affären och driva förbättringar.

 Location: Tumba, Sverige

Workplace: På plats

Om rollen

Som Business Controller hos HAVI blir du en viktig affärspartner för verksamheten. Du ansvarar för uppföljning, rapportering, budget och prognoser för en av våra verksamhetsenheter och arbetar nära chefer och verksamhet för att omsätta finansiella data till affärsmässiga beslut.

Rollen kombinerar klassiska controlleruppgifter med ett starkt verksamhetsfokus. Du analyserar resultat, identifierar trender och möjligheter samt bidrar med insikter som hjälper verksamheten att utvecklas och nå sina mål.

Du blir en del av ett engagerat Finance-team där samarbete, utveckling och ständiga förbättringar är en naturlig del av vardagen.

Dina ansvarsområden:

    Ansvara för KPI-uppföljning, analys och resultatrapportering för en verksamhetsenhet  
    Driva budget-, forecast- och uppföljningsarbete  
    Genomföra resultatanalyser och stödja verksamheten med ekonomiska insikter och rekommendationer  
    Fungera som affärspartner till Operations och stötta verksamheten i både operativa och strategiska frågor  
    Ansvara för kundrapportering och samarbeta nära både kund, Sales och andra interna funktioner  
    Bidra till utveckling av rapporter och analyser i Power BI  
    Stödja framtagning och uppföljning av business case för nya affärsmöjligheter  
    Identifiera och driva förbättringsinitiativ inom processer, rapportering och arbetssätt  
    Arbeta med både business controlling och finansiell uppföljning

Vi tror att du:

    Har en universitetsutbildning inom ekonomi, finans eller liknande område  
    Har några års erfarenhet av controlling, business controlling eller liknande ekonomifunktion  
    Har god förståelse för finansiell uppföljning, budgetering och prognosarbete  
    Är analytisk och trivs med att omvandla data till affärsmässiga rekommendationer  
    Har mycket goda kunskaper i Excel  
    Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift  
    Arbetar strukturerat, självständigt och tar ansvar för dina leveranser  
    Trivs med att samarbeta och bygga relationer med personer i olika delar av verksamheten

Meriterande är erfarenhet från kundnära roller i komplexa flöden, serviceverksamhet eller restaurangbranschen. Erfarenhet av Power BI och datavisualisering samt mycket god vana av Office-paketet, framför allt Excel, är också meriterande.

"Vi söker någon som är nyfiken, analytisk och vill vara med och utveckla både verksamheten och vårt sätt att arbeta. Här får du kombinera siffror och analys med nära samarbete ute i affären, vilket gör rollen både varierande och utvecklande."

April Lindberg, Controlling Manager på HAVI

Därför kommer du trivas hos oss:

    En verksamhetsnära roll med stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka  
    Möjlighet att arbeta nära både Finance, Operations och Sales  
    Ett engagerat och prestigelöst team med hög kompetens, god sammanhållning och en hjälpsam kultur  
    En organisation som uppmuntrar utveckling, förbättringsarbete och nya idéer  
    Kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor

Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande, så vänta inte för länge om detta låter spännande. Skicka in din ansökan inkluderat CV och personligt brev redan idag via ansökningslänken.

Har du några frågor gällande tjänsten kontaktar du Jesper Frey Morin eller Martin Westman på NXT Interim & NXT Rekrytering som hanterar hela rekryteringsprocessen, jesper.freymorin@nxtinterim.se (mailto:jesper.freymorin@nxtinterim.se) , martin.westman@nxtinterim.se (mailto:martin.westman@nxtinterim.se)  

Om HAVI

HAVI är ett globalt, privatägt företag som fokuserar på att utveckla, optimera och hantera leveranskedjor åt ledande varumärken. I Sverige har HAVI cirka 220 medarbetare och vår verksamhet omfattar både logistik och huvudkontor i Tumba. Vi arbetar med välkända kunder som McDonald’s, Espresso House, Taco Bell, Pizza Hut och Subway och levererar pålitliga, effektiva och hållbara lösningar inom supply chain. På HAVI kombinerar vi globala styrkor med en stark lokal närvaro – och vi glömmer aldrig att det är våra medarbetare som är nyckeln till allt vi gör.

jobs.title: Finance Business Partner to automobile company in Gothenburg
jobs.description:
Are you a finance professional who wants to work close to vehicle programs, product development, and senior leadership? In this role, you will combine strategic business partnering with hands-on operational and program controlling in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

About the position

Perido is looking for a Finance Business Partner for our client, an automobile company that bring mobility technology and solutions to satisfy the global demand for premium electric vehicles. The position is located in the office in Gothenburg.

Key Responsibilities

Business Partnering

    Act as the primary financial partner to the SVP Vehicle Line Center and the leadership team
    Provide clear, actionable financial insights to support both strategic and operational decision-making
    Challenge assumptions, identify risks and opportunities, and proactively drive financial performance

Operational Controlling

    Lead the monthly financial closing process for the Vehicle Line Center, including variance analysis and performance reviews
    Support and monitor OPEX tracking
    Track operational KPIs and drive actions to achieve financial targets.
    Ensure compliance with financial policies and internal control

Program Controlling

    Manage program budgets, forecasts, and long-term financial plans for vehicle line–specific projects
    Monitor project spend, burn rate, and forecast accuracy; identify deviations and propose corrective actions
    Ensure financial alignment across engineering, procurement, and program management functions

Governance & Approval

    Review and approve purchase requests (PRs) and supplier invoices, ensuring alignment with program budgets, contracts, and internal guidelines
    Maintain financial transparency throughout the entire program lifecycle

Planning & Forecasting

    Lead annual budgeting processes and recurring forecast cycles for both operational and program-related activities
    Consolidate financial plans, assess assumptions, and prepare management presentations for senior leadership
    Ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability of financial forecasts and outlooks

Your characteristics

You have a strong business-oriented mindset and the confidence to challenge assumptions and influence decision-making at multiple levels of the organization. You communicate clearly and effectively, and you are skilled at building strong relationships with a wide range of stakeholders. You are proactive and well-structured, able to manage complexity and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines, while thriving in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

We look forward to reading your application!

Qualifications:

    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field
    2–5+ years of relevant finance experience, depending on seniority
    Fluent in English, spoken and written

IT / Systems Requirements

    SAP S/4HANA
    Advanced Excel
    Power BI

Meritorious:

    Experience with Excel Query/Power Query and Macros
    Experience with Power BI
    Experience with SAP S/4HANA
    Chinese language skills

Contract type and hours

Full-time, consulting assignment until 2027-08-31. Start 2026-09-01.

Application

Please apply through our website at perido.se/lediga-jobb/. Simply click the "Apply" button in the job advertisement, fill in your details, and upload your CV. We recommend submitting your application as soon as possible, as the selection process is ongoing. Please note that some details about the assignment and/or client company may have been deliberately disclosed in the advertisement. If your profile matches what the client is looking for and you are contacted by a recruiter, you will receive all the information you need. Responsible recruiter is charlotte.crowley@perido.se

You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still haven't found the answer you are looking for, you are most welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se and one of our Recruitment Communicators will answer you. Always enter the reference number 35945 in the subject line. Please note that we only accept applications through our website and that we are unable to provide updates on your application status.

About Perido

Why is our company named Perido? The name comes from the Latin word Peridoneus, which means 'well-matched'. Perido is a consulting and recruitment company specializing in the white-collar sector, dedicated to helping you take the next step in your career. Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. We have grown steadily since our founding in 2003 and now have over 1,500 employees across the country, including around fifty internal staff at our headquarters in Stockholm and Gothenburg. As a Perido consultant, you’ll play a key role in our organization, growing alongside us while strengthening our clients' businesses with your skills. Please visit our website www.perido.se for more information.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager – Supply Planning & Transformation to Axis!
jobs.description:
As a Project Manager, you will take on a key role in leading complex cross-functional transformation initiatives that shape the long-term direction of Operations and Axis. In this role, you will navigate a broad stakeholder landscape, introduce new ways of working, and lead key initiatives that drive Axis’ digital and organizational journey.

About the role

Based at Axis headquarters in Lund, you will join the Cross Functional Projects & Systems team within Operations Development. The team leads strategic transformation initiatives, manages the Operations project portfolio, and drives business system development across the organization.

As a Project Manager, you will initially lead a key Supply Planning transformation program, helping shape future capabilities that support Axis' continued growth. Working closely with Operations, IT, and external partners, you will drive the initiative from strategy and design through implementation and business adoption. Beyond this program, you will lead cross-functional transformation projects across Axis, influencing strategic decisions, improving ways of working, and delivering sustainable business value across the organization.

What We Offer

    A dynamic role where you will both participate in exciting projects and actively contribute to the development of the strategic supply chain capabilities impacting process and business technology
    A collaborative and down-to-earth environment where ideas, creativity, and innovative thinking are encouraged and put into practice
    A secure employment with attractive benefits, including flexible working hours, company bonus, insurance coverage, daily breakfast, relocation support if needed, your own Axis bicycle, and more

Work tasks

This role focuses on leading a large-scale supply planning transformation, ensuring that new processes and systems are successfully integrated into the global organization to meet strategic deadlines. The role will include, among other things, the following responsibilities:

    Lead the strategic Supply Planning transformation initiative, driving the project from business requirements and solution design through implementation, deployment, and adoption, while supporting the broader transformation roadmap  
    Define scope, establish governance structures, and create clarity in complex cross-functional initiatives  
    Drive change management, organizational readiness, and the successful adoption of new capabilities and ways of working  
    Lead complex cross-functional transformation and improvement initiatives across Axis, translating business challenges into scalable and sustainable solutions  
    Facilitate workshops and decision forums, aligning business stakeholders, IT, and external partners around common goals  
    Contribute to the development of Axis' transformation capabilities, project portfolio management practices, and the continued growth of the team  
    Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, IT, and external partners to ensure alignment across processes, systems, and organizational goals

We are looking for

    A relevant university degree and several years of experience leading complex Supply Chain, Operations, or Business Transformation initiatives
    Proven experience leading Supply Planning, Planning Transformation, or Integrated Planning initiatives from concept through implementation and adoption
    Strong knowledge of Supply Planning and end-to-end supply chain processes, including planning-related disciplines such as S&OP/S&OE
    Experience working with business technology, including end-to-end system capabilities and complex system implementations from a business perspective
    Experience working with planning systems and business transformation, bridging business needs, processes, and technology
    A track record of leading cross-functional teams and managing senior stakeholders in complex environments
    Strong communication, stakeholder management, and change management skills, with the ability to drive adoption and deliver business value

It is meritorious if you have

    Hands-on experience driving business value through Supply Chain Planning platforms (e.g., Kinaxis, o9, Blue Yonder, or similar)

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:

    Goal oriented
    Orderly
    Responsible

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer in-house
jobs.description:
Analytics Engineer

Stockholm or Munich | Full-time

The Role:

As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll help shape how data is structured, accessed, and used across the business. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to build reliable, scalable data solutions that support smarter decisions.

As a vital member of our international IT organization, you will be involved in the foundation of our internal product development and will join the cross-functional data team that is responsible for developing and maintaining Netlight's business-critical data platform and strives to decentralize analytics. That is why it is important that you are a self-driven person, who is comfortable with taking initiative and responsibility, as well as a service-minded and communicative team player.

Who you are:

    A trusted communicator who builds relationships across technical and non-technical stakeholders and translates data into decisions.
    Self-driven and proactive, but also team-oriented, with sound judgment on when to lean on AI tools for speed and when human oversight and design thinking matter more.
    Comfortable working in ambiguity — organized yet flexible, able to adapt as tools, priorities, and team structures evolve quickly.
    A curious, fast learner with a growth mindset — genuinely energized by new tools, AI-assisted workflows, and continuously raising your own technical bar.

Qualifications

We are looking for someone with:

    A degree in a quantitative field (e.g. software engineering, computer science, economics, mathematics, statistics) — if you think you’re a great fit, we want to hear from you!
    At least 2+ years of relevant experience in fields like Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Data Science, or Software Development.
    Strong SQL skills, with hands-on experience building and testing data models in dbt on a cloud warehouse, and an understanding of dimensional data modeling (star schemas, facts and dimensions).
    Solid grasp of version control with Git, including CI/CD workflows for data pipelines.
    Familiarity with Python for data transformation, automation, and light pipeline work.
    Fluency in written and spoken English (business level).
    Comfort working with AI copilots and AI-assisted analytics tools (e.g. Copilot-style code/doc generation, AI BI assistants) while maintaining human oversight on data quality and design.

Nice to have:

    Experience with, or strong interest in, semantic layers and metric governance — ensuring a single, trusted definition of key business metrics that both humans and AI tools can rely on.

What you will do:

You will join the cross-functional data team responsible for Netlight's data platform, enabling decentralized analytics across the organisation. Your key focus areas will be:

    Data Modeling & Quality: Transform raw data into clean, usable datasets for analytics, business intelligence, and AI use cases. Collaborate with stakeholders to define and maintain a semantic layer and single source of truth for key business metrics. Ensure data quality and consistency across teams and tools, and build robust, well-documented data models using Snowflake and dbt.
    Governance & Enablement: Provide compliant, user-friendly access to data across various tools (e.g. Power BI, Excel, or AI-powered BI assistants). Empower users of all technical levels — including AI agents — to find, understand, and securely query the data they need. Own the data access lifecycle end-to-end, balancing self-service efficiency with security, privacy, and compliance requirements. Maintain clear documentation and metadata (data catalog, definitions, lineage, ownership).
    Optimization & Agile Delivery: Continuously evaluate and improve data models for performance and scalability. Contribute to agile ways of working, participating in planning, refinement, and delivery cycles. Stay current with emerging tools and practices in the data stack (e.g. orchestration, observability, AI-assisted development) and help the team adopt what is genuinely useful.

What we offer:

    The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry
    Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
    Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm or Munich
    A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
    Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)
    Mental health & parental support offerings
    30 days of paid vacation.

Specific benefit package if positioned in Stockholm:

    5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)
    Private pension savings

Specific benefit package if positioned in Munich:

    Deutschlandticket
    Wellpass

About us

Netlight is a global consulting company, turning complex needs into practical, real changes.

Come work with us

You will join a company built around personal responsibility, collaboration, and continuous learning. Different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives make that possible, and we welcome applicants of all identities.

Apply today

This is a full-time role based in Stockholm or Munich, with a start date as soon as possible. Please read the required qualifications carefully: fluency in English is essential.

Send us your current CV in English. Links to relevant projects, GitHub, or any repositories are welcome. If your profile looks like a match, you will hear from us within two weeks of applying. We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Kirjastotoimenjohtajan virka
jobs.description:
Heinäveden kunnan kirjastotoimenjohtajan virka vapautuu organisaatiomuutoksen myötä ja virka täytetään toistaiseksi voimassa olevana 1.1.2027 alkaen.

Kirjastotoimenjohtaja johtaa vapaa-aikapalveluiden osastoa sekä vastaa kunnan kirjastopalveluista. Tehtävään kuuluu vapaa-aikapalveluiden kokonaisuuden strateginen kehittäminen sekä kirjastopalveluiden toiminnan, talouden ja henkilöstön johtaminen.

Vapaa-aikapalveluiden osaston vastuulle kuuluvat kirjastopalvelut, kulttuuri- ja opistopalvelut, liikunta- ja nuorisopalvelut, hyvinvoinnin ja terveyden edistämisen työ sekä kotouttamispalvelut. Kutakin tulosyksikköä johtaa oma esihenkilö. Kirjastotoimenjohtajan suoria alaisia ovat vapaa-aikaohjaaja, koordinaattori (viestintä ja kulttuuri), koordinaattori (kotouttaminen) sekä kirjaston tietopalvelusihteerit.

Virkaan kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on soveltuva ylempi korkeakoulututkinto. Lisäksi edellytetään hyvää perehtyneisyyttä vapaa-aikapalveluiden, kirjastojen tehtäviin ja toimintaan sekä johtamistaitoa lain yleisistä kirjastoista (1492/2016) 17 §:n mukaisesti.

Arvostamme kokemusta esihenkilötehtävistä, kykyä toiminnan, palveluiden ja talouden kehittämiseen, henkilöstöjohtamisen osaamista, erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä verkostoitumis- ja sidosryhmäyhteistyöosaamista.

Virassa noudatetaan kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa ja valituksi tulleen on ennen vaalin vahvistamista ja viran vastaanottamista toimitettava hyväksyttävä lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan. Työehtosopimuksena virassa noudatetaan kunta-alan virka — ja työehtosopimusta (KVTES). Palkkaus 3 600 euroa.

Työsuhde-etuna tarjoamme uuden ja monipuolisen kuntosalin käytön, ePassi-edun sekä ehtojen täyttyessä kolme kuukautta veloituksetonta asumista (lisätiedot kunnan verkkosivuilta https://www.heinavesi.fi/asuminen-ja-tontit/).

Rekrytoinnin aikataulun mukaisesti haku on avoinna 31.8.–27.9.2026, haastattelut suoritetaan viikoilla 40–41 ja varsinainen valintapäätös tehdään 19.10.2026 kunnanhallituksen kokouksessa.

Hakemukset toimitetaan sähköisesti kunta@heinavesi.fi / viite kirjastoimenjohtaja tai postitse Heinäveden kunta, Kermanrannantie 7, 79700 Heinävesi su 27.9.2026 mennessä.

Lisätietoja: kunnanjohtaja Maarika Kasonen puh. 0405505811 maarika.kasonen@heinavesi.fi

jobs.title: Vil du kombinere saksbehandling med ansvar for et lite team?
jobs.description:
Vil du ha en sentral rolle i skjæringspunktet mellom saksbehandling, administrasjon og ledelse? I Mio Gruppen søker vi en strukturert og nøyaktig medarbeider til økonomiavdelingen vår på Skøyen. Dette er først og fremst en operativ rolle innen økonomi, administrasjon og saksbehandling, hvor du selv jobber aktivt med oppfølging av driftskontoer, utlegg, refusjoner og henvendelser. I tillegg får du faglig ansvar og personalansvar for to erfarne medarbeidere.

Omtrent 80 % av stillingen er operativ, mens rundt 20 % er knyttet til ledelse og personaloppfølging. Rollen passer derfor godt for deg som trives med tall, struktur og saksbehandling, men som også ønsker å utvikle deg gjennom ansvar for mennesker og arbeidsprosesser.

Om Mio Gruppen

Mio Gruppen er et norsk konsern som består av Mio Omsorg, Mio BPA og Mio Bolig. Vi er en av Norges største leverandører av hjemmesykepleie, hjemmehjelp og brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA).

Hos Mio blir du en del av et inkluderende og engasjert arbeidsmiljø hvor vi ønsker å spille hverandre gode. Vi er stolte av kulturen vår, den gode tonen og menneskene som hver dag bidrar til visjonen vår: «Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv».

Hva er en driftskonto?

I våre BPA-ordninger kan det oppstå løpende utgifter i forbindelse med assistansen. Dette kan eksempelvis være utgifter knyttet til aktiviteter, transport eller andre kostnader som følger av BPA-ordningen.

Driftskontoen brukes til å administrere slike utgifter. Vårt driftskontoteam sørger blant annet for at utlegg og refusjoner behandles korrekt, at nødvendig dokumentasjon er på plass og at kundene våre får god oppfølging.

Du trenger ikke å kjenne til BPA eller driftskonto fra før – det viktigste er at du har interesse for økonomi, trives med saksbehandling og liker å jobbe nøyaktig og systematisk.

Om rollen

Som en del av driftskontoteamet får du en sentral rolle i økonomiavdelingen og ansvar for den daglige oppfølgingen av kundenes driftskontoer.

Dette er en operativ stilling hvor du selv deltar aktivt i saksbehandlingen. Du vil blant annet behandle saker, følge opp dokumentasjon og håndtere henvendelser fra kunder og kolleger.

Samtidig får du faglig ansvar og personalansvar for to kunnskapsrike medarbeidere. Du skal bidra til å koordinere og prioritere arbeidet i teamet og sørge for gode og effektive arbeidsprosesser.

Stillingen gir dermed en fin kombinasjon av økonomisk saksbehandling, administrasjon og ledelse, uten at du trenger å ønske deg en tradisjonell lederrolle hvor mesteparten av arbeidshverdagen består av personaloppfølging.

Stillingen rapporterer til økonomidirektør.

Dine viktigste arbeidsoppgaver

  • Saksbehandling og oppfølging av kundenes driftskontoer

  • Behandling og kontroll av utlegg, refusjoner og tilhørende dokumentasjon

  • Besvare og følge opp henvendelser fra kunder, verger og interne avdelinger

  • Sikre korrekt administrasjon og dokumentasjon

  • Planlegge, koordinere og prioritere oppgaver innenfor driftskontoområdet

  • Ha faglig ansvar og personalansvar for to medarbeidere

  • Bidra til kontinuerlig forbedring og standardisering av rutiner og prosesser

  • Videreutvikle driftskontoområdet i takt med selskapets vekst

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi tror du har erfaring fra økonomi, regnskap, administrasjon eller saksbehandling. Kanskje jobber du i dag som regnskapsmedarbeider, økonomimedarbeider, økonomikonsulent eller med saksbehandling innen bank, forsikring eller offentlig forvaltning.

Relevant utdanning innen økonomi, regnskap eller administrasjon er en fordel, men relevant arbeidserfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning.

Tidligere leder- eller personalansvar er positivt, men ikke et absolutt krav. Det viktigste er at du er komfortabel med å ta ansvar og ønsker å bidra til både faglig utvikling og et godt samarbeid i teamet.

Vi tror du vil trives og lykkes hos oss dersom du:

  • liker å jobbe med tall, detaljer og saksbehandling

  • arbeider strukturert, nøyaktig og systematisk

  • har god økonomiforståelse

  • er komfortabel med digitale systemer og lærer nye verktøy raskt

  • tar eierskap til oppgaver og følger dem helt i mål

  • kommuniserer godt på norsk, både skriftlig og muntlig

  • møter kunder og kolleger på en profesjonell og løsningsorientert måte

  • ønsker å bidra til gode rutiner og smartere arbeidsprosesser

Hos Mio får du

  • En variert rolle i skjæringspunktet mellom økonomi, saksbehandling og ledelse

  • Muligheten til å kombinere operativt arbeid med personalansvar

  • Meningsfulle arbeidsoppgaver og et viktig samfunnsoppdrag

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn

  • Fast 100 % stilling i Mio Gruppen AS

  • En arbeidsplass i et solid selskap i vekst

  • Et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

  • Eget ansattfordelsprogram

  • Mulighet for hjemmekontor

  • Kontorplass på hovedkontoret vårt på Skøyen

  • Kantine – og så mye kaffe du klarer å drikke ☕

Høres dette ut som en rolle for deg?

Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg! Send oss søknaden din og fortell gjerne litt om erfaringen din med økonomi, administrasjon eller saksbehandling.

Søknadsfrist: 14. september

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio gruppen er 100 prosent norskeid og består av selskapene Mio BPA, Mio Omsorg og Mio bolig. Sammen er vi en av Norges største leverandør av hjemmesykepleie, hjemmehjelp og brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA). Vi tilbyr et bredt spekter av tjenester til unge seniorer, eldre og personer med funksjonsnedsettelser. Vi har også et hyggelig seniorpensjonat i Moss.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.
