jobs.title: Välinehuoltaja, Välinehuolto, Salo
jobs.description:
Tehtäväsi

Työskentelet ensisijaisesti Tyks Salon sairaalan välinehuoltokeskuksessa, jossa vastaat sairaanhoidon ja suun terveydenhuollon tutkimuksissa sekä toimenpiteissä käytettävien välineiden huollosta. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat välineiden pesu, desinfiointi, pakkaaminen sekä niiden kunnon ja toimivuuden tarkastaminen. Lisäksi steriloit välineitä höyryautoklaavissa tai matalalämpöplasma-sterilointilaitteessa ja huolehdit laadunvarmistuksesta dokumentoimalla työn eri vaiheissa tehtävät tarkastukset.

Välinehuoltokeskuksessa työ painottuu yksittäisten välineiden ja erilaisten välinekokonaisuuksien käsittelyyn ja kokoamiseen. Tarvittaessa voit työskennellä myös Salon alueen sote-asemien yhteydessä olevissa välinehuoltopisteissä, joissa työn painopiste on suun terveydenhuollon välineiden huoltoprosessissa.

Tyks Salon sairaalan välinehuoltokeskus kuuluu sertifioidun ISO 9001:2015-laatujärjestelmän piiriin, joten osallistut osaltasi laadukkaan toiminnan ylläpitämiseen ja kehittämiseen.
Työtä tehdään arkisin pääsääntöisesti klo 7.00-17.30 välisenä aikana.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Tarjoamme vastuullisen ja merkityksellisen tehtävän osana terveydenhuollon palveluketjua. Pääset työskentelemään tehtävässä, jossa huolellinen työsi vaikuttaa päivittäin potilaiden turvalliseen hoitoon ja sujuvaan toimintaan.

Työ tarjoaa monipuolisia tehtäviä sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattitaitoasi välinehuollon eri osa-alueilla. Työympäristö edellyttää jatkuvaa oppimista ja antaa mahdollisuuden hyödyntää omaa osaamistasi sekä osallistua laadukkaan toiminnan ylläpitämiseen ja kehittämiseen.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Odotamme sinulta tarkkuutta, järjestelykykyä ja sitoutumista uuden oppimiseen. Työssä menestyminen edellyttää erityistä huolellisuutta, vastuuntuntoa sekä kykyä toimia laadukkaasti myös muuttuvissa tilanteissa.

Arvostamme joustavuutta, asiakaspalvelutaitoja, motivaatiota sekä hyvää yhteistyökykyä. Toivomme, että osaat vastaanottaa ja antaa palautetta rakentavasti sekä osallistua aktiivisesti työilmapiirin kehittämiseen. Moniammatillisessa toimintaympäristössä tarvitset hyviä tiimityötaitoja, paineensietokykyä sekä kykyä tehdä itsenäisiä ratkaisuja ja ottaa vastuuta työn järjestämisestä.

Eduksi luemme aikaisemman kokemuksen alan työtehtävistä.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on välinehuoltajan tutkinto tai muutoin hankittu riittävä osaaminen välinehuoltajan tehtäviin. Tehtävässä edellytetään suomen kielen taitoa.

Haastattelut aloitamme jo hakuaikana ja työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian.

Jos tunnistat itsesi kuvauksesta ja haluat mukaan tekemään laadukasta välinehuoltotyötä osana terveydenhuollon ammattilaisverkostoa, jätä hakemuksesi jo tänään.

jobs.title: SALGSSPECIALIST TIL ENTREPRENØRMASKINER – JYLLAND & FYN
jobs.description:
Kan du åbne nye døre, skabe relationen og lukke salget?

På vegne af Dansk Maskincenter A/S søger SelectioPlus en erfaren og resultatorienteret salgsspecialist, der skal være med til at udvikle Dansk Maskincenters salg inden for entreprenørsegmentet i Jylland og på Fyn – med Develon som en central del af sortimentet.

Dansk Maskincenter har et bredt sortiment af maskiner og løsninger til markedet. Develon er det senest tilkomne brand inden for entreprenørmaskiner og udgør en central del af ambitionen om at styrke virksomhedens position i entreprenørsegmentet.

Derfor leder vi ikke efter en sælger, der primært skal passe en eksisterende kundeportefølje. Vi søger en hunterprofil, som kender entreprenørbranchen, forstår markedet og motiveres af at opsøge nye kunder, skabe muligheder og omsætte dem til konkrete handler.

Du får stor frihed til at drive dit marked – og samtidig meget tydelige forventninger til resultaterne.

OPGAVEN

Din vigtigste opgave bliver at skabe vækst i Dansk Maskincenters salg inden for entreprenørsegmentet – med Develon som en central del af sortimentet.

Du skal aktivt ud i markedet og opbygge relationer til både nye og eksisterende kunder i Jylland og på Fyn. Det kræver, at du trives med den opsøgende del af salget og selv tager initiativ til at finde de næste muligheder.

Dine centrale opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

·       opsøge og udvikle nye kunder

·       sælge entreprenørmaskiner fra Dansk Maskincenters sortiment til nye og eksisterende kunder

·       identificere nye salgsmuligheder i markedet

·       følge mulighederne hele vejen fra første kontakt til afsluttet handel

·       rådgive kunderne og finde den rigtige løsning til deres behov

·       sikre høj aktivitet og en stærk pipeline

·       deltage på relevante messer, kundearrangementer og møder

·       bidrage praktisk, når det er nødvendigt – her hjælper man hinanden

Det afgørende er ikke, at du er den mest administrative sælger i branchen. Det afgørende er, at du kan skabe salg og afslutte handler.

HVEM ER DU?

Vi forestiller os, at du allerede kender entreprenørbranchen og har erfaring med salg i markedet.

Du har minimum tre års salgserfaring – gerne fem år eller mere – og du ved, hvad der skal til for at skabe en kundeportefølje og holde momentum i et salgsområde.

Din konkrete uddannelsesbaggrund er mindre vigtig. Erfaring, branchekendskab og dokumenterede salgsresultater vejer tungere.

Som person er du udadvendt og kontaktskabende. Du får energi af at være ude hos kunderne og er ikke afhængig af, at leads og muligheder kommer til dig.

Du er selvkørende, resultatorienteret og vedholdende. Og når muligheden er der, har du både lysten og evnen til at bede om ordren og få handlen afsluttet.

Samtidig skal du være ordentlig. Dansk Maskincenter ønsker langsigtede kunderelationer, så resultater skal skabes med troværdighed, empati og respekt for kunden.

Du taler og skriver dansk og kan begå dig på engelsk.

DER ER KLARE FORVENTNINGER

Du kommer ind i en stilling, hvor succes kan måles.

Efter de første tre måneder er ambitionen, at du har opbygget en reel pipeline med omkring 24 tilbud og har solgt de første tre maskiner.

Efter seks måneder er målet omkring otte solgte maskiner.

Efter 12 måneder er ambitionen et salg på cirka 15 mio. kr., samtidig med at det brugte lager løbende bliver omsat.

Tallene fortæller noget vigtigt om stillingen: Det her er en salgsrolle.

Du bliver ansat til at skabe aktivitet, nye kunder og resultater – og du får samtidig friheden til selv at finde vejen derhen.

STOR FRIHED I HVERDAGEN

Salgsområdet er Jylland og Fyn, og derfor er det oplagt, at du bor et sted i dette område.

Du behøver ikke bo tæt på Dansk Maskincenters hovedkontor. Du får mulighed for at have kontor på en af virksomhedens lokationer og kan også arbejde hjemmefra.

Du tilrettelægger i høj grad selv din hverdag og dine kundebesøg. Den normale arbejdstid ligger omkring kl. 8.00-16.00, men jobbet kræver naturligvis fleksibilitet i forbindelse med messer, kundemøder og andre relevante aktiviteter.

DU BLIVER EN DEL AF DANSK MASKINCENTER

Dansk Maskincenter A/S er en moderne maskinforretning med afdelinger i Jelling, Odder, Rimmerhus og Toftlund og omkring 87 engagerede medarbejdere.

Virksomheden sælger blandt andet traktorer, høstmaskiner, redskaber, plæneklippere, mindre maskiner og Develon entreprenørmaskiner. På alle lokationer understøttes kunderne desuden af reservedelssalg og egne værksteder.

Det giver dig en organisation i ryggen, som kan understøtte både salget og kunderne efter handlen.

Kulturen er flad og uformel med højt til loftet, god energi og humor. Der er frihed under ansvar – men også forventning om, at du tager ejerskab for dit område og dine resultater.

VI TILBYDER

Du tilbydes en fast fuldtidsstilling med en månedlig grundløn, afhængigt af kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Herudover tilbydes pension, sundhedsforsikring, fri telefon og firmabil.

Der er ikke bonusordning knyttet til stillingen. Til gengæld får du stor selvstændighed og mulighed for at få en central rolle i udviklingen af Dansk Maskincenters forretning inden for entreprenørsegmentet.

Tiltrædelse ønskes hurtigst muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

INTERESSERET?

Rekrutteringen gennemføres af SelectioPlus på vegne af Dansk Maskincenter A/S.

Send dit CV og gerne en kort motivation til:

Henrik Sødequist
Headhunter & Managing Partner, SelectioPlus
hs@selectioplus.dk

Vi indkalder relevante kandidater løbende og afslutter processen, når det rette match er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du også meget velkommen til at kontakte Henrik Sødequist.

SELECTIOPLUS – People. Purpose. Precision.

jobs.title: Fuldtid - Vicevært? Flyttesynstekniker? Handy-person? - Genopslag
jobs.description:
Din titel er ikke afgørende for os. Bare du har hænderne skruet rigtig på og lysten til at blive en del af en virksomhed, hvor vi har tendens til at blive hængende på holdet i lang tid.

Da vi skal starte nye ejendomme op i og omkring Ålborg, så søger vi et team af nye viceværter. Vi forventer at vi skal bruge 1 på fuldtid og 2 på deltid.

Denne her stilling er fuldtid, med mulighed for fleksible arbejdstider, men vi hører gerne til dine forventninger og ser om vi kan få det til at gå op med resten af teamet.

Det er vigtigt at du i din ansøgning oplyser, at den stilling du søger er fuldtid.

Hvem er du og hvorfor passer du ind hos os?
Det går du fordi, du er:

Servicemindet - du nyder en hverdag, hvor din primære opgave er at sikre en god oplevelse for beborerne.

Handy - måske selvlært eller fordi du har en teknisk uddannelse, men du kan løse de fleste udbedringer i lejemålene og på ejendommene selv, som fx udskiftning af blandingsbatterier, kontrol af gulvvarmeanlæg, justering af skabslåger, mm. De ting du ikke har prøvet før, kan du gennemgå med en kollega, så du er godt klædt på til at klare det selv næste gang.

Struktureret og har styr på dine aftaler. Vi sætter stor værdi i at holde, hvad vi lover hinanden og vores kunder.

Motiveret af et fleksibelt arbejdsliv. Du bestemmer selv, om din arbejdsdag starter kl. 8 eller kl. 10 – bare opgaverne bliver løst med høj kvalitet og til tiden.

Hvem er vi og hvorfor er vi sjove at arbejde hos?
Vi er en professionel leverandør af ejendomsservice og vores kunder er udlejningsejendomme, ejerforeninger og lignende. Vi vækster og har netop vundet vores 3. gazelle. Det betyder, at der på sigt kan være mulighed for flere timer eller mere ansvar, hvis det er noget, du ønsker.

Vi har tillid til hinanden og opbakning fra vores chef.

Det betyder, at vi arbejder selvstændigt med vores egne opgaver og at vi altid kan spørge om hjælp, når vi har brug for det.

Vi er uformelle og møder hinanden og vores kunder i øjenhøjde. Samtidig tager vi naturligvis ansvar for vores opgaver og sikrer, at vi løser tingene godt.

Hvad er det så for nogle opgaver, som du kan være med til løse hos os?

Arbejdsopgaverne
•   Pasning og renholdelse af ejendomme
•   Udførelse af ind-/fraflytningssyn
•   Håndtering af lejerhenvendelser og udbedring af ting i lejemålene
•   Evt. pasning af mindre grønne områder, så som græsslåning
•   Andre viceværtsrelevante opgaver

Det med småt

Bil: Da stilling er fuldtid, stiller vi en firmabil til rådighed.

Vi tilbyder dig firmatelefon, tablet og et kollegialt fællesskab med høj trivsel.

Derudover kan du selv frem til en opstart, hvor du bliver klædt på af dine kolleger - som du også lærer at kende til de sociale arrangementer, som vi holder i løbet af året.

jobs.title: Senior Sourcing Specialist
jobs.description:
Job titleSenior Sourcing SpecialistJob description:

At BeGreen, we develop and operate renewable energy projects built to last across generations.

We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Sourcing Specialist with a strong background in renewables to lead sourcing activities and commercial contracting across solar, hybrid, and energy storage projects based in Denmark, with exposure to international suppliers and projects.

This position is ideal for someone who understands the unique sourcing and commercial challenges of renewable energy, whether in solar, BESS, or hybrid technologies—and who knows that the right supplier relationships and contracts are what make or break a project. Broader experience in energy infrastructure, construction, or adjacent industries is equally welcome, and will add valuable perspective to our team.

About the role

You will take ownership of sourcing strategies, supplier engagement, and contract execution across the full renewable energy project lifecycle. Working closely with Project Management, Engineering, Construction, Sustainability, Cyber Security, HSE, and Legal, you will ensure that commercial decisions drive project performance and long-term value.

Your hands-on knowledge of the renewables market—its key suppliers, technology trends, cost drivers, and contractual complexities—will be a distinct advantage in this role. Whether you're navigating a large EPC tender for a solar park, structuring a BESS supply agreement, or evaluating a new contractor in an emerging market, your sector insight will be central to how you work.

Beyond large and complex tenders, you will also support pragmatic sourcing for lower-value purchases, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and speed without compromising quality or governance.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end competitive tenders for major renewable energy packages, including planning, evaluation, negotiation, and contract award
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies specifically tailored to solar parks, hybrid plants, and battery energy storage systems
  • Leverage renewables market knowledge to drive supplier assessments, benchmark pricing, and identify strategic sourcing opportunities
  • Lead commercial negotiations with energy suppliers and contractors, with a strong focus on risk management and contract robustness
  • Manage both complex, high-value sourcing processes and agile lower-value purchasing activities (RFQs, call-offs, POs)
  • Prepare decision-making materials, including total cost of ownership analyses with a clear understanding of energy project cost structures
  • Support early contract management, including supplier onboarding, performance tracking, and risk assessments
  • Contribute market intelligence on renewable energy supply chains to strengthen category strategies and long-term supplier partnerships

What you bring

We are looking for someone with a solid commercial background, and we particularly value:

  • Direct sourcing or commercial experience in solar, BESS, hybrid energy, wind or other renewable technologies
  • Familiarity with key renewable energy suppliers, EPC contractors, and technology providers
  • Understanding of the commercial and technical dynamics specific to utility-scale renewable projects

Broader energy & infrastructure experience (also highly valued):

  • Experience in conventional energy, oil & gas, transmission, or large-scale infrastructure procurement
  • Background in complex project environments with multi-stakeholder commercial interfaces
  • Exposure to long-term contracts, framework agreements, and supplier performance management

In addition, you bring:

  • Confidence in leading negotiations and managing commercial interfaces
  • A structured, proactive, and ownership-driven approach to work
  • Strong stakeholder management and clear communication skills
  • Knowledge of EU procurement regulations (Utilities Directive) or the motivation to build it
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in Danish or Swedish is a plus
  • Relocation packages are not available for this role and a valid Danish work- and residence permit is a precondition

The team you will join

You will join BeGreen's Procurement team, a group of specialists working across category management, sourcing, and contract management. We collaborate closely, share knowledge openly, and prioritize integrity in both processes and relationships.

What we offer

  • A key role in shaping sourcing practices at a fast-growing renewable energy company
  • Influence across the full project lifecycle—from early development through construction to operations
  • A collaborative, international work environment with passionate and ambitious colleagues
  • A strong focus on professional development and continuous learning
  • Office based in Carlsberg Byen, Copenhagen.


About BeGreen

BeGreen develops, builds, and operates onshore energy facilities – primarily solar, wind, and battery solutions. We are around 60 colleagues from diverse backgrounds. We design our projects to work in practice – technically, commercially, and in interaction with local communities.

BeGreen is headquartered in Denmark and is part of Equinor, an international energy company. This provides a strong foundation and access to experience and competencies across markets.

Our values: collaboration, integrity and ambition are applied to our projects, decisions, and the way we work together internally and externally.

jobs.title: Operating Partner & General Manager (Profit Sharing & Equity)
jobs.description:
Operating Partner & General Manager – RAY'S Chicken

We run RAY'S Chicken at Hejrevej in Nordvest, sharing a roof and a taproom with Gamma Brewing. We take a lot of pride in what we do: 24-hour buttermilk marinades, custom spice rubs, homemade sauces, and fried chicken that stands out in Copenhagen.

We are ready to build RAY'S into a multi-location brand. To do that, we need a partner on the ground to take over the daily operation of our flagship location, dial in our systems, and build the foundation for our next openings.

This role comes with base pay, direct profit sharing, and an equity track.

What the Job Looks Like

You will start on the floor. To run and expand this business, you need to understand every moving part firsthand.

  • Step 1: Learn the Shop You'll spend your first weeks working the line—prepping chicken, running the fryers, packing orders, handling Wolt and takeaway rushes, and talking to guests.

  • Step 2: Take Full Ownership of Hejrevej Once you know the rhythm of the place, you take the reins of day-to-day operations: scheduling the crew, ordering from suppliers, keeping food costs tight, staying on top of Fødevarestyrelsen hygiene standards, and making sure the food quality never slips.

  • Step 3: Build for Expansion You'll help turn our daily workflows into clear, repeatable routines so that training new staff is easy. When we are ready to open location number two, you will be deeply involved in site setup, hiring, and launch.

Who We Are Looking For

You do not need years of high-end restaurant experience. If you have run a busy kitchen or managed a bar, great. But if your background is in retail, small business, logistics, or running physical projects and you love fast-paced, hands-on work, we want to hear from you.

Here is what actually matters to us:

  • High Agency: You don't wait for someone to tell you what needs fixing. If a station is dirty, an order is delayed, or inventory is running low, you jump in and solve it.

  • Comfortable on Your Feet:  You enjoy the energy of a packed Friday night shift and you lead your team by working alongside them.

  • Organized & Practical: You notice small details. You can build simple checklists, manage inventory without wasting stock, and keep a kitchen running cleanly under pressure.

  • Good with People: You stay calm and constructive when the ticket machine is going non-stop and the room is full. You treat your team with respect and set a solid pace.

  • Long-Term Mindset: You want to build something real and share in the financial upside through profit distribution and equity as the business grows.

The Deal

  • Compensation: Base salary after experience with a road map to profit sharing.

  • Equity Pathway: Clear, milestone-based equity vesting as you take full operational ownership and we expand.

  • Direct Access: You work directly alongside the founders. No bureaucracy, no corporate politics—good ideas get tested and put into action immediately.

  • Great Location: A vibrant base at Hejrevej 6B in Nordvest, working alongside the Gamma Brewing team.

How to Apply

Send us your CV along with a short email telling us:

  1. What you have built, managed, or fixed in previous jobs.

  2. Why running and scaling a food business at this stage makes sense for you.

  • Email: work@diamondslice.dk

  • Subject: Rays Partner

If you’re an analytical problem solver who thrives on tackling complex business challenges, working cross-functionally, and translating strategy into execution, let’s talk.

What You’ll Do 📈 Shape the Strategy – Assess market opportunities, identify challenges, and help define the roadmap for Instabee Finland’s growth.

🔍 Lead High-Impact Projects – Take ownership of complex, cross-functional initiatives that drive business performance and scale our operations.

🤝 Work with Leadership – Collaborate closely with the Country Manager and senior team to set targets and implement strategic plans.

📊 Use Data to Drive Decisions – Monitor performance, track key business metrics, and adjust strategies based on insights.

⚡ Remove Roadblocks – Identify challenges, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure our strategic initiatives run smoothly.

🚀 Think Big, Plan for the Future – We’re looking for someone with the ambition and potential to grow into a larger leadership role over time.

Who You Are

✅ A Strategic Thinker with a Commercial Edge – You have experience in strategy, management consulting, investment banking, or business development. Start-up/scale-up experience is a bonus.

✅ A Problem-Solver Who Gets Things Done – You thrive in ambiguity, take ownership, and know how to move projects forward.

✅ A Data-Driven Decision Maker – You use insights, analytics, and performance tracking to sharpen your approach and drive measurable impact.

✅ An Effective Communicator – You can turn complex ideas into clear, actionable plans and collaborate across teams.

✅ Experience Matters Most, but Education Helps – you have probably Master’s degree in business, economics, engineering, or a related field

✅ Fluent in English (Finnish is a bonus) – You can communicate clearly and persuasively in a fast-moving, international environment.

Why Instabee?

🌍 Join a Fast-Growing Company – Be part of a team that’s reshaping e-commerce logistics in Europe.

🚀 Advance Your Career – This role is built for growth, with a path toward broader leadership.

🏢 Work Flexibly – Hybrid setup with a modern Helsinki office centrally located in Kluuvi.

💡 Work with Cutting-Edge Tech – Shape the future of logistics with smart, data-driven solutions.

🎉 A Culture That Values Action – We move fast, make decisions quickly, and focus on what works.

Ready to Make an Impact? We’re looking for someone who’s ready to own projects, drive strategy, and shape the future of Instabee in Finland. If that’s you, apply today.

About Instabee

Instabee was founded in 2022 after combining Budbee and Instabox — two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox and Porterbuddy. Instabee is present in six countries, serving thousands of online merchants, including ASOS, Zalando, Inditex and H&M and is on track to become the most admired European e-commerce enabler.

In Finland, Budbee has been a key player since 2018 — and we’re moving fast.

jobs.title: RenTid søger ASSISTANT MANAGER - RenTid is hiring an ASSISTANT MANAGER
jobs.description:
"Er du vores nye højre hånd?"

RenTid søger en engageret og erfaren Assistant Manager til en fast stilling på 37 timer om ugen.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst, og derfor søger vi en dygtig og ansvarsbevidst person, som har solid erfaring med både erhvervsrengøring og privat rengøring, og som har lyst til at få en mere ledende rolle i hverdagen.

Som Assistant Manager bliver du en vigtig del af den daglige drift og kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med virksomhedens ledelse.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor du blandt andet kommer til at:

  • Planlægge og koordinere rengøringsopgaver

  • Følge op på kvaliteten af vores rengøring

  • Have kontakt med både privat- og erhvervskunder

  • Hjælpe med oplæring og introduktion af nye medarbejdere

  • Være med til at løse praktiske udfordringer i den daglige drift

  • Kontrollere, at opgaver udføres efter RenTid's standarder

  • Hjælpe med vagtplaner og koordinering af medarbejdere

  • Træde til ved sygdom og akutte situationer

  • Udføre rengøringsopgaver efter behov

  • Deltage i kundebesøg og kvalitetskontroller

  • Bidrage til udviklingen af vores arbejdsgange og rutiner

Du skal derfor både kunne tage ansvar fra kontoret og være med ude på opgaverne.

Vi forestiller os, at du

Vi søger en person, der:

  • Har flere års erfaring med rengøring

  • Har erfaring med både privat- og erhvervsrengøring

  • Har et godt øje for detaljer og kvalitet

  • Er struktureret og god til at planlægge

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage beslutninger

  • Er god til at kommunikere med både kunder og medarbejdere

  • Har naturlige lederegenskaber

  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorienteret

  • Kan bevare overblikket, når der er travlt

  • Har en professionel tilgang til kunder og kollegaer

  • Har almindeligt kørekort (B)

Det er en stor fordel, hvis du allerede har erfaring som teamleder, supervisor, driftsleder, inspektør eller lignende.

Det vigtigste er, at du har den nødvendige erfaring, ansvarsfølelse og lysten til at udvikle dig.

⭐ Vi tilbyder

Hos RenTid bliver du en del af en virksomhed i udvikling, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling.

Vi tilbyder:

  • 37 timers fast stilling

  • En spændende og varieret arbejdsdag

  • Stor mulighed for ansvar og indflydelse

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt og personligt

  • En central rolle i virksomhedens daglige drift

  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø med fokus på ordentlighed og kvalitet

  • Gode kollegaer og en uformel omgangstone

  • Mulighed for at være med til at udvikle RenTid

En stilling med mulighed for mere

Vi leder ikke bare efter en medarbejder.

Vi leder efter en person, som på sigt kan blive en helt central del af RenTid's organisation.

Hvis du har ambitionerne, viljen og erfaringen, er der gode muligheder for at få mere ansvar og udvikle dig sammen med virksomheden.

Arbejdsområde

Stillingen vil primært være i Aarhus og omegn, og du skal derfor være indstillet på at køre mellem forskellige kunder og opgaver.

Lyder det som dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og CV til RenTid, hvor du fortæller lidt om dig selv, din erfaring inden for rengøring og hvorfor du mener, at du er den rette person til rollen som Assistant Manager. Mærk ansøgningen "ASSISTANT MANAGER"

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler, så send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag.


English*

"Are you our new right-hand person?"

RenTid is looking for an experienced, motivated and responsible Assistant Manager for a permanent full-time position of 37 hours per week.

We are a growing cleaning company, and we are looking for someone with solid experience in both commercial and residential cleaning, who is ready to take the next step into a more responsible and leadership-oriented role.

As Assistant Manager, you will become an important part of our daily operations and work closely with the company management.

Your main responsibilities

Your working day will be varied, and your responsibilities will include:

  • Planning and coordinating cleaning assignments

  • Following up on the quality of our cleaning services

  • Communicating with both residential and commercial customers

  • Assisting with the training and onboarding of new employees

  • Helping solve practical challenges in the daily operations

  • Ensuring that all work is carried out according to RenTid's quality standards

  • Assisting with employee schedules and coordination

  • Stepping in when employees are absent or unexpected situations arise

  • Carrying out cleaning assignments when needed

  • Participating in customer visits and quality inspections

  • Helping develop and improve our procedures and workflows

You should therefore be comfortable both taking responsibility from the office and working hands-on in the field.

We are looking for someone who

We are looking for a person who:

  • Has several years of experience in the cleaning industry

  • Has experience with both residential and commercial cleaning

  • Has a strong eye for detail and quality

  • Is structured and good at planning

  • Can work independently and make decisions

  • Communicates well with both customers and employees

  • Has natural leadership skills

  • Is flexible and solution-oriented

  • Can maintain an overview when things get busy

  • Has a professional attitude towards customers and colleagues

  • Holds a valid Category B driver's license

Experience as a team leader, supervisor, operations manager, cleaning inspector or similar is a major advantage.

The most important thing is that you have the necessary experience, a strong sense of responsibility and the ambition to develop yourself.

⭐ What we offer

At RenTid, you will become part of a growing company where there is a short distance from ideas to action.

We offer:

  • A permanent 37-hour-per-week position

  • A varied and exciting working day

  • A high level of responsibility and influence

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development

  • A key role in the company's daily operations

  • A positive working environment focused on professionalism and quality

  • Great colleagues and an informal working atmosphere

  • The opportunity to help shape and develop RenTid

A position with opportunities for growth

We are not simply looking for another employee.

We are looking for someone who can eventually become a key part of RenTid's organisation.

If you have the ambition, motivation and experience, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility and grow together with the company.

Area of work

The position will primarily cover Aarhus and the surrounding areas, so you must be comfortable travelling between different customers and assignments.

Does this sound like you?

Then we would love to hear from you!

Please send us your CV and application, telling us a little about yourself, your experience within the cleaning industry, and why you believe you are the right person for the Assistant Manager position. Mark the application "ASSISTANT MANAGER"

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Kunnossapitoasentaja
jobs.description:
Alkuperäinen ilmoitus täällä:https://rekry.puhdistamo.fi/jobs/8289224-kunnossapitoasentaja

**Kunnossapitoasentaja**

**Etsimme kunnossapitoasentajaa, joka ei ainoastaan korjaa laitteita vaan haluaa kehittää niiden toimintaa yhdessä tuotannon kanssa. Meillä merkittävä osa työstä on linjastojen säätämistä, optimointia ja tuotannon tukemista, jotta tuotteet valmistuvat tehokkaasti ja laadukkaasti päivästä toiseen.**

Lempäälän tehtaallamme kunnossapito on tärkeä osa tuotannon onnistumista. Tässä roolissa olet mukana varmistamassa, että tuotantolaitteemme toimivat luotettavasti, tuotanto pysyy käynnissä ja yhdessä löydämme jatkuvasti parempia tapoja tehdä asioita.

Meillä arvot eivät jää seinälle, vaan näkyvät päivittäisessä tekemisessä:

Intohimo paremmasta Kehitämme toimintaa rohkeasti, etsimme jatkuvasti parempia ratkaisuja. Laatu syntyy huolellisesta tekemisestä ja halusta parantaa asioita päivä päivältä.

Yhdessä tavoitteeseen Tuotanto ja kunnossapito pelaavat samaan maaliin. Kun linjat pysyvät käynnissä, tuotanto sujuu ja haasteet ratkaistaan yhteistyöllä, onnistuminen kuuluu koko tiimille.

Välittömyydestä voimaa Olemme reiluja toisillemme ja pidämme huolta hyvästä työilmapiiristä myös kiireen keskellä. Meillä saa kysyä, oppia ja jakaa osaamistaan. Uskomme, että parhaat tulokset syntyvät, kun ihmiset viihtyvät työssään ja auttavat toisiaan onnistumaan.

**Miltä roolisi näyttää?**

Työskentelet osana kunnossapitotiimiä ja vastaat omalla panoksellasi tuotantolaitteiden toimintavarmuudesta. Päiväsi koostuvat monipuolisista kunnossapidon tehtävistä, kuten ennakkohuolloista, korjauksista, vianhausta sekä tuotantolinjojen säätämisestä ja optimoinnista.

Merkittävä osa työstä on käytännön tekemistä tuotannon keskellä. Huolehdit laitteiden kunnosta, osallistut tuotantolinjojen pesuihin liittyviin teknisiin tehtäviin ja varmistat, että laitteet toimivat mahdollisimman tehokkaasti ja luotettavasti.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

- Tuotantolaitteiden kunnossapito, huollot ja korjaukset


- Ennakko- ja määräaikaishuoltojen toteuttaminen


- Tuotantolinjojen pesuihin ja tuotteenvaihtoihin liittyvät tekniset työt


- Mekaaniset tarkastukset, säädöt ja vianhaku


- Linjastojen asetusten optimointi ja tuotannon tukeminen säätötilanteissa


- Kunnossapitojärjestelmän käyttö ja dokumentointi


- Tekninen tuki tuotannon päivittäisissä haasteissa


Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä tuotannon kanssa, mutta ennen kaikkea olet käytännön tekijä, joka pitää laitteet kunnossa ja tuotannon käynnissä.

Työskentelet elintarviketuotannossa, jossa käsittelemme pääosin kuivia jauheita. Tuotantomme jakautuu valmistuksen ja pakkauksen osastoihin, missä tuotantosolukohtaisesti laitekanta ja automaation taso vaihtelee. Tuotantolaitteemme ovat kompakteja, joten työvälineesi ovat enemmänkin ruuvimeisseli ja 13 mm kiintoavain kuin rautakanki ja rekkari. Osassa työtiloista käytetään suojavarusteita pölyisyyden vuoksi, minkä takia työ ei välttämättä sovi esimerkiksi astmaatikolle.

Työtä tehdään kahdessa vuorossa arkipäivisin. Aamuvuoro on klo 7–15 ja iltavuoro klo 14–22.

**Millainen henkilö sopii rooliin?**

Olet oma-aloitteinen ja käytännönläheinen ongelmanratkaisija, joka tarttuu toimeen eikä jää odottamaan ohjeistusta silloin, kun näkee parannettavaa. Sinua kiinnostaa laitteiden toiminta käytännössä, ja nautit sekä käsillä tekemisestä että teknisten ongelmien ratkaisemisesta. Viihdyt tuotantoympäristössä ja osaat tehdä sujuvaa yhteistyötä tuotannon henkilöstön kanssa. Työskentely ajoittain hektisessä tuotannossa saa sinut mukaan yhteiseen työn imuun.

Turvallinen työskentely ja työympäristön turvallisuudesta huolehtiminen on sinulle luonnollista. Ymmärrät, että hyvä kunnossapito syntyy huolellisesta perustyöstä, mutta osaat myös nähdä mahdollisuuksia parantaa ja sujuvoittaa yhteistä tekemistä.

Toivomme sinulta:

- Soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta


- Kokemusta kunnossapito-, huolto- tai tuotantoympäristöstä


- Mekaanista osaamista ja hyvää teknistä ongelmanratkaisukykyä


- Kokemusta tai kiinnostusta tuotantolaitteiden säätämiseen ja optimointiin


- Oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista työotetta


- Hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja


- Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa


- Valmiutta hyödyntää englanninkielistä dokumentaatiota


- Tietoteknisiä taitoja kunnossapitojärjestelmien käyttöön


Arvostamme lisäksi automaatio-, sähkö- tai pneumatiikkaosaamista. Olisi hienoa, jos tekniikka kiinnostaisi sinua myös vapaa-ajalla. Saatat puuhastella autojen tai muun teknisen tekemisen parissa ja haluat oppia, miten laitteet toimivat ja miksi.

**_Meistä_**

Puhdistamo on vuonna 2009 perustettu kotimainen yritys, jonka tavoitteena on räjäyttää Suomen (ja koko maailman!) hyvinvointikulttuuri uuteen uskoon. Olemme Suomen tunnetuin hyvinvointibrändi, ja laajaan portfolioomme kuuluvat erilaiset ruoka- ja juomatuotteet sekä vitamiinit, kivennäis- ja hivenaineet. Valmistamme suurimman osan tuotteistamme omalla tehtaallamme Lempäälässä. Lempäälän ja Helsingin toimipisteillämme työskentelee yhteensä reilut 110 henkilöä, ja toimimme pienellä tiimillä myös Ruotsissa.

Katso video yritystarinastamme!

**Puhdistamon työntekijänä saat myös:**

- Puhdistamon tuotteet käytettävissä työaikana ja reilut henkilökunta-alennukset


- Työnantaja maksaa 50 % julkisen liikenteen kausilipusta työmatkoille


- Työnantajan tarjoama vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus


- Kulttuuri-, liikunta- ja hierontaetu.


**_Ja vielä faktat pöytään_**

Työpaikka sijaitsee Lempäälässä. Meille pääsee myös bussilla Tampereelta.

Työsuhde on kokoaikainen (40 h/vk) ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva.

Työsuhde alkaa sopivan henkilön löydyttyä sopimuksen mukaan.

Noudatamme Elintarvikealan työehtosopimusta. Palkka sovitaan osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan.

Haku on auki 20.9.2026 asti.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa tuotantopäällikkö Tapani Lehtonen keskiviikkona 9.9. klo 15–16. ja torstaina 17.9. klo 14–15 numerosta 044 742 1674.

Rekrytointiprosessiin liittyvissä kysymyksissä voit olla yhteydessä HR-päällikkö Viivi Kankaaseen, viivi.kangas@puhdistamo.fi

jobs.title: Dishwasher
jobs.description:
About Us

Tandoori Twist is an offering from Tinyhus Cafe, a child-friendly cafe in Copenhagen, Denmark, serving authentic Indian delicacies. 

We serve not only classic favourites like butter chicken and biriyani, but also lesser known Indian regional food, with myriad of spices and flavours as our specilities.

Our cafe Tinyhus serves continental food, also traditional local cuisines for events and catering. 

We strive to provide authentic food and exceptional service to our guests and we look for team members who are self-motivated, proactive and passionate to walk the extra mile to provide exceptional culinery experience for our guests. 

Our people, just like our food, are the ambassadors of our cafe and restaurant. If you like challenges and you are looking for a place where you can contribute positively, overcoming the odds of a new but growing restaurant, then please do get in touch; we will look forward to hear from you.

Job Description

Tandoori Twist, a growing Indian Restaurant and Takeaway located in Copenhagen, looking for a dedicated and reliable dishwasher and cleaning assistant to join our team and help our kitchen running smoothly. If you have similar experience, especially in Asian / Indian restaurant and are proactive & quick-learner, then please feel free to contact us.

Only applications through our career site will be considered https://www.tandooritwist.dk/tandooritwist-career/

Job description

  • Washing plates, pots, pans, utensils and kitchen equipment.

  • Keeping the dish washing area clean and organized

  • Helping maintain cleanliness in the kitchen and surrounding areas

This is a part-time position. The work is mainly in the evening and also during weekends. Please note that you need to have right to work in Denmark as work-permit will not be sponsored for this position.

Requirements

Your profile:

  • It is mandatory to have prior experience in kitchen and familiarity with Indian cuisine

  • You are fluent in English.

  • You are reliable and punctual.

  • You are proactive and structured in your work.

  • You have strong attention to detail and cleanliness.

  • You can work in a fast-paced environment.

  • You are able to work 2-3 hours daily for 3-4 times a week.

  • Since this is a part-time position, work-permit will not be sponsored for this position. Unless you have a valid residence and work permit to work in Denmark, your application will not be proceeded with.

We take continuous interviews and the positions are closed as soon as we find the right candidate. Only shortlisted candidates will be communicated for interview.

jobs.title: Ravintolatilojen siivooja, Ruka
jobs.description:
Osa-aikainen siivooja ravintolatilojen siivoukseen

Etsimme asiakkaallemme luotettavia siivoajia ravintolatilojen siivoukseen. Työnkuvasi on siivota ravintolatiloja ja työvuorot tulevat painottumaan pe-ma välillä aamu-/päiväajalle klo. 06:00-13:00, mutta on myös arkivuoroja. Osan työstä pystymme myös suorittamaan klo. 13:00 jälkeenkin, joten työajat ovat joustavat oman käytettävyytesi mukaan. Työpäivien kesto vaihtelee riippuen siivottavasta kohteesta 4-6h. 

Kanssamme sinulla on mahdollisuus neuvotella työajoistasi, työpäivien määristä viikoittain sekä työajankohdista riippuen mahdollisista muista töistä, joita teet. Työ sopiikin joustavan luonteensa takia erinomaisesti esimerkiksi henkilöille, jotka haluavat osa-aikaisia töitä tai sitten lisätunteja oman työnsä oheen. 

Jotta olisit sopiva työhön, niin täytyy sinun olla valmis siivoamaan välillä hurjaksikin lipeävien juhlien railakkaita jälkiä. Siivoustekniikat, perusperehdytyksen työhön ja uudet ammattimaiset työvälineet tulet saamaan asiakkaaltamme, joten työhön voit hakea vaikka sinulla ei vielä kokemusta siivousalalta olisikaan. Toivomme kuitenkin, että et ole helposti säikähtävää luonnetta, sillä siivoustyön tiimellyksessä voit törmätä tahraan jos toiseenkin 

Tarjolla ei ole erikseen työn puolesta majoitusta, joten ennenkuin haet työtä, niin on sinulla oltava jo majoitus tai asunto lähialueella sekä tietenkin kulkuväline, jos liikut kauempaa kuin Rukan kylältä töihin. 

Palkkaa työtehtävästä maksetaan sopimuksen mukaisesti 12,59-14€/h + lisät kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimusta noudattaen.

Töitä on tarjolla nopeimmille jo syksystä alkaen ja jatkuen ympäri vuoden sesonkeja kuitenkin mukaillen! 

In english;

Looking for someone living in Ruka or nearby to pick up extra hours in restaurant cleaning!

We are looking for reliable cleaners for our client who are interested in earning extra income through part-time cleaning work. Your job will be to clean restaurant spaces, with shifts primarily scheduled between Friday and Monday in the morning or daytime hours from 6:00AM to 1:00PM. Some tasks can also be completed after 1:00PM, making work hours flexible to fit your availability. The duration of each shift varies depending on the cleaning site, ranging from 4 to 6 hours.

With us, you have the opportunity to negotiate your working hours, the number of workdays per week, and the exact scheduling of shifts based on any other jobs or commitments you may have. Thanks to its flexible nature, this job is perfect for those looking for part-time work or extra hours alongside their primary job. 

To be suitable for this role, you should be prepared to clean up after some wild parties at times! You will receive training on cleaning techniques, a basic introduction to the job, and new professional cleaning equipment from our client, so you can apply even if you have no prior experience in the cleaning industry. However, we do hope youre not easily startled—because in this job, youll encounter all kinds of messes!

Accommodation is not provided as part of the job, so before applying, please make sure you already have a place to stay in the area and a means of transportation if youre commuting from outside Ruka village.

The salary for this role is between €12,26 and €14 per hour, plus additional compensation in accordance with the collective agreement for the real estate services industry.

Work is available for the quickest applicants starting from the Autumn, and can continue year-round, adjusting to seasonal demand!

jobs.title: Data Engineer in Data Product Engineering
jobs.description:
If you choose to apply, please read the job ad in full and include a short cover letter. We are most interested in hearing from the real you, so we encourage authentic applications written in your own words.

The opportunity in a nutshell

Interested in combining hands-on data engineering with close collaboration across the business? This role could be a good fit for someone with 4+ years of experience who enjoys building reliable data products and working with others to make them useful.

Role: Join as a Data Engineer in our Data Product Engineering team within Schibsted's Data & AI organization, where we build reliable, well-governed, and scalable data products used across Finance, HR, Product, Subscription, and other parts of the business.

Core tools and practices: Our everyday toolkit includes SQL and Python as core languages, together with Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, AWS, Terraform, and Git, supported by solid engineering practices around testing, documentation, CI/CD, and version control.

Company: Schibsted is home to some of the most established and widely used media brands in the Nordics, including Aftenposten, VG, Svenska Dagbladet, Aftonbladet, E24, Bergens Tidende, and Stavanger Aftenblad. Across our broader Data & AI focus, data, analytics, and AI help us build better products, support smarter decisions, and create value across those newsrooms and businesses.

Location: This role is based in Oslo or Stockholm. We work in a hybrid setup, which means this is not a fully remote role, and candidates need to reside in Sweden or Norway and be able to work from one of our offices at least 2 days a week.

Why this role: You will join a relatively new team with room to contribute, learn, and help shape how we work as we continue to build trusted data products across Schibsted.

Sounds like your kind of role? Read onWho are you?

We are looking for someone with a solid foundation in data engineering who is also excited by the opportunity to keep learning, deepen their craft, and grow together with the team.

  • You have around 4+ years of experience in data engineering or a closely related role, with a track record of building reliable data solutions in production environments.
  • Strong SQL skills are important, along with a solid understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and how to design data products that are useful, trustworthy, and maintainable.
  • You can write and debug SQL and Python yourself at a strong professional level. AI-assisted tools are welcome, but this role requires solid enough fundamentals to solve everyday engineering problems without depending totally on them.
  • On the Python side, we are looking for good software engineering fundamentals, including the ability to structure maintainable applications and apply object-oriented design principles where appropriate.
  • You have hands-on experience with dbt in production environments and solid working knowledge of the wider toolkit we use, including Airflow, Snowflake, AWS, Terraform, Git, and Python and / or similar tools.
  • You will likely enjoy this role if you are comfortable making pragmatic technical decisions in environments where requirements evolve and not everything is fully defined upfront.
  • You care about engineering quality and can contribute to practices around testing, documentation, observability, governance, and cost-efficient pipeline design.
  • Clear communication matters just as much as technical strength. We value people who can work well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, explain tradeoffs clearly, and contribute positively to team collaboration and knowledge sharing.
What's the job like?

As a Data Engineer, your job is to help us build data as a product, not just pipelines that move data from one place to another. You will create robust data models, improve the reliability and scalability of our pipelines, and help shape the engineering practices that make our data products trusted and reusable across Schibsted Media.

What you will be expected to do
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into pragmatic, well-scoped data solutions.
  • Design, build, and maintain reliable pipelines and transformations in Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, and Python.
  • Develop scalable data models that support analytics, reporting, and future AI use cases.
  • Improve technical quality through testing, documentation, monitoring, and maintainable engineering practices.
  • Contribute to good architectural and implementation decisions across the team.
  • Contribute through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing within the team.
  • Work closely with adjacent platform and Data & AI teams to align on standards, dependencies, and shared ways of working.
What success looks like

Success in this role means growing into a confident contributor who understands our data landscape, ways of working, and stakeholder needs. Over time, that includes contributing across a mix of smaller support tasks through our weekly rotation as well as larger pieces of work, helping build reliable pipelines and data models, and developing the judgment to deliver pragmatic solutions together with the team. Depending on your experience and the needs of the work, that can mean contributing as part of a team or taking the lead on a project.

Why join us?
  • You will join a team that is still shaping its ways of working, which means there is real room to contribute, learn, and grow.
  • You will work on data products with visible impact across Schibsted, supporting both technical and non-technical users in domains such as Product, Subscription, Finance, and HR.
  • You will be part of a company whose work matters in everyday life across the Nordics, helping support trusted media brands through better data, analytics, and AI capabilities.
  • You will work in an international environment with strong trust, autonomy, and good opportunities for learning through engineering communities and collaboration across Data & AI.
Got your attention? Let us hear from you!

The application period closes on 28 September 2026. We review applications on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Customer Care Specialist
jobs.description:
Liittyminen SSAB-perheeseen tarkoittaa, että pääset mukaan matkallemme. Tämä matka on mielestämme elintärkeä planeettamme kestävän kehityksen kannalta. Teräs on ollut yksi tärkeimmistä materiaaleista yhteiskuntiemme kehityksen kannalta ja on sitä myös jatkossa. Sitä on rakennusten katoissa, kaupunkejamme yhdistävissä silloissa ja huomispäivän autoissa. SSAB on ylpeä historiastaan ja asemastaan erikoislujien terästen markkinajohtajana. Tiedämme kuitenkin myös, että teräksen tuotanto on yksi maailman suurimmista kasvihuonekaasujen tuottajista. Sen on muututtava. Sen vuoksi olemme kehittäneet maailman ensimmäisen fossiilivapaan terästuotannon sekä sitoutuneet muuttamaan oman toimintamme suurelta osin fossiilivapaaksi arviolta vuonna 2030. Osana SSAB:tä sinulla on keskeinen asema tämän tavoitteen saavuttamisessa ja koko terästeollisuuden vihreän siirtymän edistämisessä.

Haemme SSAB Europe Raahen terästehtaalle Customer Care tiimiin määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen 1.10.2026 – 30.9.2027 väliselle ajalle Customer Care Specialistia. Tehtävät sisältävät Raahen tehtaan valmistamien kuumavalssattujen tuotteiden tehdastilausten käsittelyä. Tarjoamme hienon mahdollisuuden päästä tutustumaan terästeollisuuden toimitusketjun hallintaan tilaus- ja valmistusvaiheesta aina asiakkaillemme saakka.

**Pääasialliset työtehtävät**

- Tehdastilausten käsittely

- Tuotannon eri järjestelmien käyttö

- Toimitusten seuraaminen ja tukeminen

- Yhteyshenkilönä toiminen asiakkaiden, myynnin ja tuotannon välillä


**Odotamme sinulta**

- Odotamme sinulta kaupallisen tai teknisen alan opintoja

- Hyvää suullista ja kirjallista suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

- Tehokkuutta, huolellisuutta ja tarkkuutta.

- Hyvää yhteistyökykyä ja asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä

- Valmiuksia omaksua tilaustenkäsittelyssämme vaadittavat järjestelmät


**Tarjoamme sinulle**

Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme laajan valikoiman arvostettuja etuja. Tässä on muutamia esimerkkejä:

- Kannustinpalkkio-ohjelmat

- Laajennettu työterveyshuolto

- Virkistysedut


Rekrytointiprosessi

1. Hae

2. Haastattelu

3. Arvioinnit

4. Yhteydenotto suosittelijoihin

Barber wanted for a modern barbershop in Norway. EU and Schengen applicants welcome.

Hva vi ser etter

Nous recherchons une personne qui aime le contact avec la clientèle et qui est fière d'offrir un service de grande qualité.

Vous savez communiquer avec les clients, créer une ambiance chaleureuse et mettre chacun à l'aise dès son arrivée.

Experience as a barber or men's hairdresser is required. English is required. Norwegian is an advantage but not essential.

Provide a wide range of barbering services including classic haircuts, fades, beard trims, traditional hot towel shaves and styling.

You will welcome customers, provide professional advice and help create a relaxed and friendly atmosphere in the shop. Maintaining a high standard of hygiene and contributing to the daily operation of the barbershop are also important parts of the role.

  • Salaire attractif selon l'expérience et les qualifications

  • Prime basée sur les performances

  • Une clientèle fidèle et un poste de travail entièrement équipé

Candidature

Merci d'envoyer votre CV et votre lettre de motivation à theo.sole@wintermark.no

  • Permanent employment in a modern and growing barbershop

  • Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications

  • Performance based bonus opportunities

  • A loyal customer base and a fully equipped workplace

  • Opportunities for professional development

  • A positive international working environment

  • Support with relocation to Norway when relevant

How to apply

Please send your CV and cover letter to theo.sole@wintermark.no

jobs.title: Kombinert Utleierepresentant (heltid)
jobs.description:
Arbeidssted: Kjevik lufthavn, Kristiansand sentrum, Sørlandsparken

Arbeidstid: Rullerende vaktplan (dag, kveld og helg)

Oppstart: Etter avtale

Stillingsprosent: 100%

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som kombinert utleierepresentant er du ansvarlig for å levere våre tjenester på en best mulig måte til våre kunder. Hverdagen består av utstrakt kundekontakt både ansikt til ansikt og pr. telefon og mail. Vi leverer en service hvor kundens behov alltid er i fokus. Videre er du også ansvarlig for at våre leiebiler er klargjort og vasket i henhold til vår standard. Du har også ansvar for produkter (barneseter, skistativ mm), skaderegistrering, oppfølging av servicer og dekkomlegg. Logistikk, klargjøring, salg og kundeservice er kjernen i hverdagen. 

  • Klargjøring av utleiebiler (vask mm)

  • Oversikt og kontroll på skader, servicestatus og dekklager

  • Skifte dekk ved dekk omlegg

  • Yte utmerket kundeservice i alle situasjoner 

  • Presentasjon og innsalg av våre produkter til kunde på en best mulig måte

  • Håndtere telefon og epost henvendelser 

  • Organisere daglige reservasjoner i forhold til tilgjengelig flåte

  • Rapportering og annet forefallende kontorarbeid

Kvalifikasjoner

Som kombinert utleierepresentant er du den våre kunder møter hver dag. Du representerer Sixt Bilutleie og er genuint opptatt av service og trives med kundekontakt. Vi stiller høye krav til våre produkter og hvordan vi presenterer disse, med ett ønske om å overgå kundens forventinger. Du har også ansvar for standarden på produktet vi leverer. Hverdagen styres av kundens behov, og din evne til å arbeide hurtig og nøyaktig er avgjørende for den kvalitet vi leverer. Ved å levere en premium opplevelse, er du med å bygger Norges beste bilutleiekjede.    

  • Minimum førerkort klasse B (manuelt og automatgir)

  • Plettfri vandel (Politiattest)

  • Genuin serviceinnstilling og gode mellommenneskelige ferdigheter

  • Gode salgs ferdigheter

  • Hurtig og nøyaktig med stor arbeidskapasitet (også ved fysisk arbeid)

  • Strukturert og evne til å styre logistikk i en stadig skiftende/hektisk hverdag

  • Flytende norsk / engelsk muntlig og skriftlig

  • Datakunnskaper (Microsoft Office). 

Vi tilbyr

Som ansatt i Sixt Bilutleie vil du være del av en organisasjon med flinke kolleger som alle ønsker å yte det beste for våre kunder. Som del av et team vil din innsats utgjøre en forskjell, og verdsettes deretter. Vi har gode trenings- og utvekslingsprogram som alle våre ansatte følger. For den rette vil det også være utviklingsmuligheter innen organisasjonen. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

We carry out roofing felt installations on new construction projects, renovation projects, and commercial buildings throughout Denmark. You will become part of a professional team where cooperation, craftsmanship, and quality are at the core of everything we do.

We Expect You To:

  • Have experience in the roofing trade and roofing felt installation

  • Deliver high-quality work with attention to detail

  • Be reliable, positive, motivated, and willing to work hard

  • Hold a valid driving licence (Category B)

  • A workplace with skilled and dedicated colleagues

  • A varied and exciting working day with diverse tasks

  • A positive working environment where we support and help each other

  • The opportunity for permanent employment in a well-established company with proper working conditions

Interested?

Please send your application and CV to info@ryslingetag.dk.
Feel free to tell us a little about yourself, your experience, and your qualifications.
We review applications on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidates.

About Us
At Ryslinge Tagdækning A/S, we are passionate about quality craftsmanship and high-quality roofing solutions. We are an experienced team of approximately 70 dedicated employees who work together every day to deliver professional roofing felt solutions throughout Denmark.

We place great importance on a positive working environment, professional development, and an informal company culture where colleagues support one another and work together as a team.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Sac roc-vie - it engineering (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Aircraft Engines conçoit, produit et commercialise, seul ou en coopération, des moteurs aéronautiques civils et militaires aux meilleurs niveaux de performance, fiabilité et respect de l'environnement. La société est notamment, à travers CFM International*, le leader mondial de la propulsion d'avions commerciaux courts et moyen-courriers.

* CFM International est une société commune 50/50 de Safran Aircraft Engines et GE Aerospace.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionThe Engineering VIE will provide support to IT team by performing inventory of all hardware infrastructure and of all software and applications, by putting in place dashboards to track IT tickets internal and external (EPROD, SAP,...), by supporting the upgrade of the servers and switches and by supporting the data team with implementation of new tools to improve Production outputs.



PROJECTS AND DELIVERABLES



(Projects/teams the VIE will work on and what is expected to be completed by the end of the assignment)



o Inventory IT / Data hardware and software. Implementation of tools to track inventory to optimize spare parts management and cost. Plan obsolescence / replacement based on Safran Standards and OEM recommendations.

o Server Room upgrade: replacement of servers, switches, relocation of servers, reduction of overall heat output in the room.

o Data tool implementation : improve drift detection, implement SAE tools in Production with operators training.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Laser-Induced Graphene (LIG) Sensors for Composite Materials
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the position

We have a new vacancy for a 3-year PhD position at ASEMlab, NTNU Gjøvik, funded by Horizon Europe projects. The PhD candidate will work with NTNU's laser-induced graphene (LIG) sensing line developing a LIG sensor system for in-situ process monitoring of fibre reinforced composite systems, and maturing it from lab-scale prototypes to integration in demonstrators. The LIG system will be developed and benchmarked alongside complementary sensing technologies. This is a doctorate at the intersection of functional 2D materials, printed electronics, industrial composites manufacturing and structural health monitoring.

The position is hosted by ASEMlab – the Laboratory of Advanced and Sustainable Engineering Materials (www.asemlab.no) at the Department of Manufacturing and Civil Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, NTNU – Norwegian University of Science and Technology, Gjøvik campus. ASEMlab performs research on polymers and composite materials across their full life cycle: advanced manufacturing, structural health monitoring and sensing, non-destructive evaluation, durability and ageing, recycling and circularity, and sustainability assessment. The laboratory operates extensive infrastructure including manufacturing, sensor development, laser systems, thermal and physico-chemical analysis (DMA, TGA, FTIR, dielectric spectroscopy), mechanical and thermomechanical fatigue testing, accelerated ageing facilities, micro-CT, CMM, ultrasound imaging, etc.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


Duties of the position
  • design and fabricate laser-induced graphene sensors and sensor arrays (temperature, strain, pressure) using ASEMlab's laser-processing infrastructure
  • characterise and calibrate the sensors electromechanically, structurally, thermally, morphologically, etc., using advanced analytical techniques, and benchmark them against complementary sensing technologies (e.g. fibre optics)
  • develop the LIG sensor system for process monitoring and structural health monitoring
  • implement the data-acquisition chain and data-import protocols as well as analyze sensor data for different needs 
  • Work closely with interdisciplinary teams of internal and external researchers specializing in sensor technologies, materials science, data analytics, etc.
  • analyze data and publish results in leading international journals and present at conferences, contribute to project deliverables, training workshops and dissemination activities

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme (link), see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in materials science/engineering, electronics/mechatronics, applied physics, nanotechnology, mechanical/manufacturing engineering or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • demonstrated hands-on experience working in a research laboratory environment, including the safe handling of chemicals and operation of scientific instrumentation
  • strong foundational understanding of solid-state physics/chemistry and materials characterization techniques (such as Raman spectroscopy, SEM, or XRD)
  • hands-on experimental skills within sensors or functional/printed materials
  • very good written and oral English skills (documented per NTNU requirements for non-native speakers)
  • proven ability to work independently, manage a research project timeline, and collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • experience in the design, fabrication, or characterization of electromechanical sensors, printed/flexible sensors, or graphene/2D and carbon-based functional materials 
  • hands-on experience with laser synthesis, laser micromachining, or optical systems, including CO₂ or UV laser platforms commonly used for LIG fabrication
  • experience with electronics prototyping, instrumentation and data acquisition tools (Python, LabVIEW), electrical characterization hardware (e.g., source meters, potentiostats, impedance analyzers) and basic signal processing, while interest in machine-learning-based process control is a plus
  • knowledge of fibre-reinforced polymer composites and their manufacturing processes
  • experience with electrical/electromechanical characterisation techniques (e.g. impedance spectroscopy, DIC-coupled strain sensing)
  • willingness to travel for test and demonstration campaigns for project needs in Europe 

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • proactive, self-driven, structured and rigorous in experimental work
  • collaborative and team-oriented mindset suited to a university lab and a large industrial consortium with firm deadlines
  • strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • curiosity and ambition to publish at a high international level

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

Evaluate and remove/add what is relevant for the position.

  • An exciting job with an important mission in an international, EU-funded project consortium
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 550 800,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering Science Doctoral Programme - PhD - Faculty of Engineering Science - NTNU within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the regulations in force concerning State Employees and Civil Servants, and the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who, by assessment of the application and attachments, are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment to NTNU.

Please note that the candidate holding the announced position is expected to work with critical infrastructure and areas subject to controls on the export of strategic goods, services and technology. Candidates with the potential of not fulfilling the requirements for security clearance, access clearance and authorization as described in the Act Relating to National Security, the Export Control Act and the Act on the Implementation of International Sanctions (Sanctions Act) cannot be considered for the position.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • CV and certificates/diplomas (BSc and MSc) with grade transcripts; diplomas in other languages must be accompanied by certified English translations
  • a motivation letter (max 2 pages) describing your suitability for and interest in the position
  • MSc thesis (or a draft if not yet completed) and any publications or other relevant research output
  • documentation of English language proficiency (e.g. IELTS/TOEFL) where applicable
  • names and contact details of at least two referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Sotirios Grammatikos, Director of ASEMlab, Department of Manufacturing and Civil Engineering, NTNU Gjøvik. E-mail: sotirios.grammatikos@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Advisor Kristine Rognlid Hagaseth kristine.r.hagaseth@ntnu.no 

Application deadline: 11.09.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 
 

Gjøvik, a charming town by the shores of Lake Mjøsa, is known for its beautiful nature and rich cultural offerings. The town boasts a vibrant community with excellent schools, modern healthcare services, and a variety of recreational activities. With its strategic location, just a short drive from Oslo, Gjøvik combines the best of urban life and natural experiences. Here, you'll find a dynamic business environment and exciting career opportunities in a setting that values work-life balance.
