Mekaniker søges til Apex Auto

Apex Auto søger en dygtig og engageret mekaniker til vores team.

Er du passioneret omkring biler, kvalitet og godt håndværk? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Hos Apex Auto arbejder vi med service, reparation og vedligeholdelse af biler, og vi søger en mekaniker, der kan arbejde selvstændigt, tager ansvar og leverer arbejde af høj kvalitet.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Service og reparation af personbiler

  • Fejlfinding og diagnosticering

  • Mekaniske reparationer og vedligeholdelse

  • Bremser, undervogn, motor, transmission m.m.

  • Brug af moderne diagnoseudstyr

  • Sikre høj kvalitet og kundetilfredshed

Vi forventer, at du

  • Er uddannet mekaniker eller har solid praktisk erfaring

  • Har erfaring med fejlfinding og moderne biler

  • Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt

  • Er kvalitetsbevidst og ansvarsfuld

  • Har en positiv indstilling og gode samarbejdsevner

  • Har kørekort til personbil

Vi tilbyder

  • Et godt og professionelt arbejdsmiljø

  • Gode kolleger og en uformel omgangstone

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling

  • Varierende arbejdsopgaver

  • Gode arbejdsforhold og konkurrencedygtig løn

  • Mulighed for at blive en vigtig del af et ambitiøst team

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send din ansøgning og CV til Apex Auto. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og ser frem til at høre fra dig.

Automotive Mechanic Wanted – Apex Auto

Apex Auto is looking for a skilled and motivated Automotive Mechanic to join our team.

Are you passionate about cars, quality and professional workmanship? Then you might be exactly who we are looking for.

At Apex Auto, we provide vehicle servicing, repairs and maintenance, and we are looking for a mechanic who can work independently, take responsibility and consistently deliver high-quality work.

Your responsibilities

  • Vehicle servicing and repairs

  • Fault finding and diagnostics

  • Mechanical repairs and maintenance

  • Brakes, suspension, engine, transmission and more

  • Working with modern diagnostic equipment

  • Ensuring high standards of quality and customer satisfaction

We are looking for someone who

\- vakaan ja pitkään toimineen työnantajan sekä mukavan työnjohdon

\- viihtyisät tilat ja hyvät työvälineet, joiden valintaan saat myös itse vaikuttaa

\- ammattitaitoiset ja mukavat työkaverit

\- rennon ja mutkattoman työilmapiirin ja apua aina tarvittaessa

\- oppimista ja ammattitaidon ylläpitoa myös koulutusten muodossa

Toivomme, että sinulla olisi vähintään pari vuotta työkokemusta alalta sekä rehti ja vastuullinen asenne. Alan koulutusta et välttämättä tarvitse, mikäli olet päässyt keräämään jo useamman vuoden automekaanikon työkokemusta työelämän puolelta.

Tehtävässä noudatetaan autoalan korjaamotoiminnan TES:ä. Palkka sovitaan aina yhdessä osaamistasosi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.

jobs.title: Autolakerer til Silkeborg
jobs.description:
Vil du være med helt fra starten og sætte dit præg på en ny afdeling?

Byens Bilpleje.com søger en dygtig og engageret autolakerer, som har lyst til at være med til at åbne og opbygge vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg.
Her får du ikke bare et almindeligt job som autolakerer. Du bliver en vigtig del af opstarten og får mulighed for at være med til at skabe gode arbejdsgange, høj kvalitet og den rette kultur i afdelingen fra første dag.

Om Byens Bilpleje.com

Byens Bilpleje.com er en af Danmarks største aktører inden for kosmetisk klargøring, autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse og udskiftning af autoglas.
Vi behandler mere end 200.000 biler om året og beskæftiger mere end 450 medarbejdere i Danmark.
Den første afdeling blev grundlagt i Vejle i 1997, og i dag har vi mere end 50 afdelinger i Danmark.
Vores ambition er at være bilejerens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Det gør vi ved at skabe værdi for vores kunder gennem effektivitet, kvalitet og fleksibilitet.

Om jobbet

Som autolakerer i vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg bliver du en central del af opstarten.
Du kommer til at arbejde med autolakering i den daglige produktion og får samtidig mulighed for at bidrage til, hvordan afdelingen skal fungere i praksis. Vi leder derfor efter dig, der både har faglig stolthed og lyst til at tage ansvar.
Du klargør bilerne til lakering ved at spartle, slibe og afdække, inden du sprøjtelakerer dem med fokus på et flot og ensartet resultat. Du er med hele vejen i processen og sikrer den sidste finish, så bilen står skarpt og ser ud som ny.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 
  • Sikring af høj og ensartet kvalitet
  • Bidrage til effektive arbejdsgange og processer
  • Overholde aftalte deadlines
  • Samarbejde tæt med kolleger og ledelse
  • Være med til at skabe struktur og gode rutiner i den nye afdeling
  • Bidrage aktivt til opbygningen og udviklingen af afdelingen

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet autolakerer og har erfaring fra faget.
Det vigtigste er, at du går op i dit håndværk og afleverer et resultat, du kan være stolt af. Samtidig skal du have lyst til at være en del af en ny afdeling, hvor ikke alt nødvendigvis er fastlagt på forhånd.
Du ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger og har lyst til at være med til at bygge noget op sammen med dine nye kolleger.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du

  • Er uddannet autolakerer og har relevant erfaring
  • Har høj faglig stolthed og sans for kvalitet
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret
  • Er løsningsorienteret og tager ansvar
  • Trives i en travl og ordreproducerende hverdag
  • Er en holdspiller og bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • Er fleksibel og klar på de opgaver, der følger med opstarten af en ny afdeling
  • Har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med virksomheden

Vi tilbyder

Du får en særlig mulighed for at komme med helt fra begyndelsen og være med til at sætte dit præg på vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg.
Samtidig bliver du en del af en stor organisation med erfarne kolleger og masser af faglig sparring. Selvom afdelingen er ny, står du derfor ikke alene.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • En central rolle i opstarten af en helt ny afdeling
  • Mulighed for at præge arbejdsgange og den daglige drift
  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab på tværs af Byens Bilpleje.com
  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • En arbejdsplads med højt til loftet og godt humør
  • Grundig introduktion til virksomheden og vores processer
  • Konkurrencedygtig løn og pension
  • Mulighed for at vokse med afdelingen i takt med, at forretningen udvikler sig

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads!

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ønsker stillingen besat snarest muligt – men vi venter gerne på den rette kollega.

Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

Grundet GDPR modtager vi ikke ansøgninger via e-mail, og ansøgninger fremsendt på mail vil derfor ikke blive taget i betragtning.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Leon Clausen på 22 43 31 76.

jobs.title: Autolakerer til Odense
jobs.description:
Autolakerer søges til at få ridser og buler til at forsvinde!  

Har du styr på afdækning, slibning og spartling så bilerne står knivskarpe, før de ruller ind i kabinen? Kan du få selv de mest triste biler til at se ud som nye? Så er det dig, vi leder efter! 

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Hertil håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året..

Hvad skal du lave? 

  • Du bliver en del af et team af lakspecialister, der tryller buler og ridser væk. Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.: 
  • Du fixer buler, spartler, sliber og afdækker (sprøjtelakerer), Så bilerne står som nye 
  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 

Hvem er du? 

  • Du er en frisk type med humor, der elsker en god snak med kollegaerne over en kaffepause – men også en, der går op i kvalitet og finish. Vi leder efter dig, der: 
  • Har uddannelse eller erfaring som autolakerer 
  • Kan holde styr på opgaverne, selv når der er travlt 
  • Du evner at strukturere dine opgaver 
  • Har kørekort (B) – så du ikke behøver skubbe bilerne selv 
  • Elsker tempoet i en virksomhed, hvor ingen dage er helt ens 

Hvad får du? 

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer – vi betaler for talent! 
  • Gode kollegaer, der kan deres kram (og deler værkstedshistorier i pauserne) 
  • Markeds bedste redskaber/produkter at arbejde med 
  • Mulighed for udvikling 
  • En arbejdsplads med humor, godt humør og højt til loftet  

 Hvad gør du nu? 

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads!

jobs.title: Autolakerer til Fredericia
jobs.description:
Autolakerer søges til at få ridser og buler til at forsvinde!  

Har du styr på afdækning, slibning og spartling så bilerne står knivskarpe, før de ruller ind i kabinen? Kan du få selv de mest triste biler til at se ud som nye? Så er det dig, vi leder efter! 

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Hertil håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året..

Hvad skal du lave? 

  • Du bliver en del af et team af lakspecialister, der tryller buler og ridser væk. Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.: 
  • Du fixer buler, spartler, sliber og afdækker (sprøjtelakerer), Så bilerne står som nye 
  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 

Hvem er du? 

  • Du er en frisk type med humor, der elsker en god snak med kollegaerne over en kaffepause – men også en, der går op i kvalitet og finish. Vi leder efter dig, der: 
  • Har uddannelse eller erfaring som autolakerer 
  • Kan holde styr på opgaverne, selv når der er travlt 
  • Du evner at strukturere dine opgaver 
  • Har kørekort (B) – så du ikke behøver skubbe bilerne selv 
  • Elsker tempoet i en virksomhed, hvor ingen dage er helt ens 

Hvad får du? 

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer – vi betaler for talent! 
  • Gode kollegaer, der kan deres kram (og deler værkstedshistorier i pauserne) 
  • Markeds bedste redskaber/produkter at arbejde med 
  • Mulighed for udvikling 
  • En arbejdsplads med humor, godt humør og højt til loftet  
  • Overenskomst, pension og de fordele, du fortjener 

 Hvad gør du nu? 

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads! 

Vi holder samtaler løbende, fordi vi vil have den helt rigtige medarbejder med på holdet hurtigst muligt. Men hey – vi ved, at kvalitet tager tid, så vi venter gerne på den rette.

jobs.title: Associate Professor in Pharmacoepidemiology and Health Data Analytics
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a full time permanent position as Associate Professor in Pharmacoepidemiology and Health Data Analytics at the Section for Pharmaceutics and Social Pharmacy, Department of Pharmacy, University of Oslo.


About the Department and what they are looking for in this position

The Department of Pharmacy at the University of Oslo is seeking a highly motivated, dynamic and innovative researcher with strong scientific, educational and collaborative skills in pharmacoepidemiology, health data analytics and real-world evidence generation. 

The Department has a strong interdisciplinary environment covering key areas of pharmaceutical sciences. Through cutting-edge research, extensive national and international collaborations, and an integrated five-year Master’s programme in Pharmacy, the Department is a leading contributor to pharmaceutical research and education in Norway. We maintain close collaborations with healthcare services, regulatory authorities, public health institutions, and the pharmaceutical and health technology sectors. The successful candidate must be able to teach social pharmacy within the professional pharmacy programme at the Department.

The position will be affiliated with the Pharmacoepidemiology and Drug Safety (PharmaSafe) research group in the Section for Pharmaceutics and Social Pharmacy. The research group has extensive experience in pharmacoepidemiology and real-world evidence generation using nationwide Norwegian health registries and population-based cohorts to study use, effectiveness and safety of medications and vaccines. Combined with access to advanced e-infrastructure, secure analysis platforms and strong national and international collaborations, the research environment offers unique opportunities for high-impact research using linked healthcare data. 
 

The successful candidate is expected to strengthen the Department’s research in pharmacoepidemiology, health data analytics and AI-enabled real-world evidence generation with a particular emphasis on the innovative use of large-scale healthcare datasets.

The Department will relocate to the new Life Science Building (Livsvitenskapsbygningen- UiO:Livsvitenskap) in 2026. This move will provide unique opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration with researchers in epidemiology, biostatistics, informatics, machine learning, artificial intelligence and precision medicine. The Department leads the UiO:Real-World Evidence (UiO:RWE) convergence environment, a strategic interdisciplinary initiative in the Life Science building that promotes innovative use of health data and real-world evidence across the University. The successful candidate will become part of this interdisciplinary environment and contribute to its research, educational and collaborative activities.

Teaching and supervision are important part of the position, and the overall workload is typically balanced between research, teaching and academic leadership. 
The Department is a partner in the national research school in epidemiology, EPINOR, through which PhD candidates gain access to specialized courses, networking opportunities, and a broad national research community. The successful candidate will be expected to contribute to EPINOR's research and training activities and help strengthen the Department's role within the network.


Your main tasks will be
  • Conduct and lead internationally competitive research within pharmacoepidemiology, health data analytics, and the use of machine learning for real-world evidence generation.
  • Develop and apply innovative methods for analysing large-scale healthcare data, including advanced epidemiological, statistical, computational approaches. 
  • Initiate, lead and contribute to externally funded national and international research projects. 
  • Teach and supervise students at bachelor, master, PhD and postdoctoral level at the Department of Pharmacy.  
  • Contribute to the development of courses and educational activities within pharmacoepidemiology and health data science. 
  • Contribute to the Department's strategic initiatives within health data analysis and digital life science, including the UiO:Real-World Evidence (UiO:RWE) convergence environment and the Norwegian Research School in Epidemiology (EPINOR). 
  • Strengthening collaboration with healthcare services, regulatory authorities, public health institutions, industry and national and international research networks. 
  • Participate in academic leadership, including course development, examination duties, and other administrative responsibilities as required.
     

More information about the position

Applicants must document academic qualifications in their field, equivalent to an Associate professor position. The successful applicant must be able to teach at all levels and to supervise Master and PhD students. 

The successful applicant may furthermore be required to take on other teaching duties and administrative tasks, by request from the Department or the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. 


What skills are important in this role?

Required qualifications that must be documented in the application::

  • The successful applicant must have completed a PhD in pharmacoepidemiology, epidemiology, health data science, biostatistics or closely related discipline.
  • A master’s degree in pharmacy, medicine, public health or pharmacoepidemiology or an equivalent relevant field. 
  • Documented knowledge of European therapy guidelines and pharmaceutical traditions is required. Strong candidates familiar only with American therapy guidelines and traditions may also be considered but must demonstrate a clear plan and strong motivation to acquire knowledge of Norwegian and European systems upon appointment.
  • A strong and consistent scientific track record, with publications in high-quality international peer-reviewed journals relevant to the position. Particular emphasis will be placed on scientific output from the past five years.
  • Demonstrated ability and clear potential to attract external research funding.
  • Pedagogical qualifications and teaching and supervision experience at all levels will be an important factor in the evaluation process and should be well documented in a teaching portfolio. The applicant should describe her/his qualifications in view of the Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (SoTL) framework which includes:
    • Focus on student learning
    • A clear development over time
    • A researching approach
    • A collegial attitude and practice
  • The successful candidate who at the time of appointment cannot document sufficient teaching qualifications (minimum formal requirement is a 200 hours pedagogical programme) will be required to obtain such qualifications within a two-year period.
  • Teaching in the pharmacy program is conducted primarily in Norwegian. The successful candidate must demonstrate proficiency in English and a Scandinavian language sufficient for teaching, supervision and administrative duties. Candidates who do not document Scandinavian language proficiency at minimum B2 level at the time of appointment must demonstrate clear prior ability to acquire languages and commit to reaching the required level in Norwegian within three years. Applications that do not convincingly demonstrate both ability and commitment to meeting this requirement will not be prioritised.

Desired qualifications:

  • Strong experience in pharmacoepidemiology, including advanced epidemiological methods and work with large healthcare data sources (e.g. registries, EHRs).
  • Expertise in health data analytics, including advanced statistical modelling, machine learning and/or artificial intelligence applied to healthcare data.
  • Experience in regulatory science, pharmacovigilance or real-world evidence generation. 
  • Strong programming skills and experience using statistical software and programming languages commonly applied in health data research, such as R, Python, SAS, SQL or equivalent.
  • Experience with common data models (e.g. OMOP, EPICORE or similar), large-scale healthcare data infrastructures, and reproducible research practices. 
  • Documented experience in initiating, leading and managing research projects and collaborations. 
  • Experience supervising PhD candidates and postdoctoral researchers.
  • Participation in interdisciplinary research environments and academic leadership roles.
  • Experience with academic administration or institutional responsibilities.
  • An established international research network and active collaboration profile.
     

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

We are seeking a candidate who demonstrates:

  • High motivation, work capacity and commitment to academic excellence, with the ability to independently drive research, teaching and collaborative activities forward.
  • A clear sense of scientific direction and the ability to develop a sustainable and competitive research profile.
  • Strong collaboration and networking skills, combined with the ability to take scientific and organisational leadership.
  • The ability to contribute to a positive, inclusive, and productive research and teaching environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex scientific concepts clearly to students, colleagues and broader audiences.
  • A constructive and collegial working style, with willingness to contribute to shared responsibilities within the Department.
  • A genuine interest in contributing to education in pharmacy and social pharmacy, including professional training programmes.
     

The successful candidate should have an international profile with respect to the above criteria. The candidate for this position will be selected based on excellence and fit with the section’s research profile.


We can offer you
  • An exciting academic position in one of Europe’s most data-rich health research environments, with access to unique national health registries, advanced e-infrastructure and secure data platforms.
  • Modern facilities in the new Life Science Building.
  • Opportunities for academic leadership and career development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Associate Professor (position code 1011) in salary range NOK from 750 000 - to 950 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, two % is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 

We need different perspectives in our work

University of Oslo is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at 
uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us.
 


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Application letter
  • A research position paper (1–4 pages) describing the applicant’s vision and scientific ambitions for the near future, as well as strategies for collaboration and for identifying synergies with the existing group.
  • A detailed CV, including a complete list of education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative management, project acquisition and coordination experience, and other qualifying activities.
  • Copies of educational certificates, PhD diploma, transcript of records and letters of recommendation
  • A complete list of publications and academic merits and awards (if not included in the CV)
  • Full text of up to 10 selected scientific publications the applicant wishes to include in the evaluation
  • A document discussing the importance, interrelation, and relevance of the selected papers for this position
  • Educational portfolio of 3–6 pages documenting educational competence and experience, including a reflection note in which your own teaching practice and view of learning is anchored in the SoTL framework (focus on student learning, development over time, a researching approach and a collegial attitude and practice) 
  • List of reference persons: 2–3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

As a general rule an interview will be used in the appointment process, usually supplemented with a trial teaching session. The basis for assessment will be the scientific production of the applicant, the teaching portfolio, pedagogical and educational qualifications, the applicant’s qualifications within leadership and administration, other qualifications as well as general personal suitability for the position. In ranking the competent applicants, the full range of qualifications will be considered and explicitly assessed.

Rules for appointments to associate professorships. 
https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/rules-appointment-professor.html

Rules for the assessment and weighting of pedagogical competence for appointments to permanent academic posts which include teaching duties: 
https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/rules-basic-pedagogical-competence.html

Guide for applicants for Professor and Associate professor positions - University of Oslo https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/guide-applicants.html

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova), information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results, see: http://www.uio.no/english/for-employees/employment/work-results/


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Pharmacy has 130 employees. We have an active research and innovation environment based on independent research in pharmaceutical topics. The Department of Pharmacy is responsible for the popular master's degree program in pharmacy and has 350 competent and committed students.
Pharmaceutical related research and education forms the base of all activities at the Department of Pharmacy. The science of pharmacy lies in the interface between the natural sciences, pharmaceutical technology, health related topics and social sciences. This interdisciplinarity is reflected both in our study programmes and in our research. 
In the planned life science building at the University of Oslo, closer collaboration with health enterprises, local government and the business sector will enhance quality and relevance in research and education of the future labour force. The building will be the heart of the first innovation district in Norway – Oslo Science City. The Department of Pharmacy will move into the new Life Science building in 2026.

jobs.title: Pædagogisk assistent til vuggestue
jobs.description:
Børnehytten søger en dedikeret pædagogisk assistent til vores vuggestue.

Hvem er vi: 

Vi er en privat integreret daginstitution beliggende i hjertet af Kettinge. Vi er normeret til 12 vuggestuebørn og 29 børnehavebørn. Vi har tæt samarbejde med forældrebestyrelse og det lokale forenings- og forretningsliv.

Huset rummer nærhed, omsorg og sammenhold for børnene såvel som for kollegaerne. Vi har fokus på trivsel og tryghed og vægter derfor bl.a. forældrekontakten højt. Vi er gode til at arbejde sammen og spille hinanden gode i hverdagen. Grundet husets størrelse er der en naturlig god relation til børnene på tværs af stuerne og vi kan hurtigt træde til på alle stuer, hvis behovet opstår. 

Børnehytten støder op til en tidligere grusgrav, der nu fungerer som rekreativt område med bålhytte, naturlegeplads, kunstige søer med fisk og mange andre muligheder for udfoldelser med børnene. Derudover har vi vores egen legeplads der er opdelt i vuggestue og børnehave, hvor vi prioriterer at børnene kommer ud hver dag. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du nyder at være en del af udelivet uanset vind og vejr, da vores børn også elsker at hoppe i vandpytter, kigge på biller og finde regnorme.

I vuggestuen er værdien af tid central for vores pædagogiske arbejde. Tid til nærvær, tid til fordybelse og tid til at skabe små betydningsfulde øjeblikke der danner fundamentet for børnenes læring, udvikling, trivsel og dannelse. Vi har fokus på at skabe udviklende læringsmiljøer, hvor alle børn – uanset behov og forudsætning -har mulighed for at deltage i meningsfulde fællesskaber.

Vi forventer af dig:

Du er uddannet pædagogisk assistent og gerne med erfaring fra dagtilbudsområdet. Du er empatisk, omsorgsfuld og vægter arbejdet med relationer højt. Du er nysgerrig og legende i din tilgang til børnene og vægter tid, tillid og tryghed højt hos både store og små.

Du skal have en naturlig interesse og nysgerrighed på sproglig udvikling og brugen af det i hverdagen.

Du kan i samarbejde med dine kollegaer på stuen, planlægge aktiviteter og evaluere disse med udgangspunkt i den nye styrkede pædagogiske læreplan.

Du kan samarbejde med din kollegaer, om at vurdere børnenes trivsel og udvikling og ved behov iværksætte konkrete tiltag. Du skal kunne se det enkelte barn og bidrage til at udarbejde handleplaner, indstillinger, koordinere tværfagligt samarbejde med mere.

 

Om stillingen:

Vi tilbyder en ansættelse hurtigst mulig eller fra 1/11-26 i en 32 timers stilling efter gld. overenskomst.

Ansøgningsfrist: 23/9-26 Samtaler forventes afholdt i uge 40.

Send din ansøgning og CV til leder@boernehytten.dk

 

Kontakt gerne leder: Tinni eller souschef Stine - 53841514 - Man-Fredag kl. 9-15, for mere information.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Systematic Entomology
jobs.description:
A 4-year position as PhD Research Fellow in Systematic Entomology is available at the Natural History Museum (NHM), University of Oslo

The 4-year fellowship includes 25% career-enhancing duty work.
The project is supervised by Dr. Hallvard Elven (NHM).

The PhD project will focus on the systematics and ecology of selected groups within the Diptera family Cecidomyiidae, specifically within the large subfamily Cecidomyiinae. Most members of this subfamily are gall formers on vascular plants, whereas some are predators, fungivores, saprophages, or non-galling phytophages. Different species are often ecologically connected, e.g. as predator and prey, or as galler and inquiline, but their relationships are often not fully understood. A significant fraction of the North European species still await description.

The candidate will investigate both ecological and phylogenetic relationships and do a taxonomic revision with species descriptions. The tasks will include field work and lab rearing, bioinformatics using Next Generation Sequencing, and traditional taxonomic studies using morphology. 

The PhD will be associated with the species survey project “Gall Midges Phase II” financed by the Norwegian Biodiversity Information Centre. It will use mainly material collected in Norway.

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. The fellowship requires admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. Appointment to a research fellowship is conditional upon admission to the Faculty’s research training programme. A plan for the research training must be submitted no later than two months after taking up the position, and the admission approved within three months. For more information about the programme, see: http://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/  


Qualifications/Requirements 

You must have:
•    An MSc degree in systematic biology. 
•    Excellent written and verbal communication ability in English. 
English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirement, see: https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

•    Experience with DNA-based wet lab work
•    Experience with bioinformatics for biosystematics
•    Experience with microscopy, slide mounting and macro photography

The norm is as follows, according to the Norwegian educational system:

•    The average grade for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better

See: https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc7

•    Ability to give and receive scientific criticism in a constructive manner
•    A positive attitude and drive for learning skills, methods and theory
•    Ability to work in a structured manner, facilitating teamwork
•    Ability to prioritize and complete work tasks

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


The evaluation of applicants will focus on the following:

jobs.title: Mechanical Data Center Operations Technician
jobs.description:
**About Nebius:**

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

**The role**

The Mechanical Operations Technician is responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient operation, inspection, maintenance, and repair of mechanical systems supporting a mission-critical data center in Lappeenranta, Finland. Working as part of a 24/7 Critical Facilities Operations team, the technician ensures maximum equipment availability while supporting the site's commitments to energy efficiency, sustainability, and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Critical Facilities Operations

- Operate and monitor mechanical infrastructure using the Building Management System (BMS) and routine field inspections.

- Respond to alarms, equipment faults, and operational events in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs).

- Record equipment readings, operating parameters, and shift activities.

- Support planned switching operations and maintenance windows.


Mechanical Maintenance

- Perform preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance on mechanical equipment.

- Troubleshoot mechanical failures and carry out repairs or coordinate vendor support.

- Assist with commissioning, recommissioning, and integrated systems testing.

- Maintain accurate maintenance records using the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).


Mechanical Systems

Operate and maintain systems including:

- Chilled water systems

- CRAH and CRAC units

- Chillers

- Air Handling Units (AHUs)

- Pumps and hydronic distribution systems

- Heat exchangers

- HVAC systems

- District cooling and heat recovery systems (where applicable)

- Water treatment systems

- Mechanical valves and piping

- Expansion vessels and pressure systems


Health, Safety & Compliance

- Work in accordance with Finnish occupational safety legislation and EU health and safety requirements.

- Follow Permit to Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and risk assessment procedures.

- Use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

- Participate in emergency response activities and incident investigations.

- Promote a strong safety culture and environmentally responsible work practices.


Qualifications

Education

- Vocational Qualification (Ammatillinen perustutkinto) or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Building Services Engineering, Industrial Maintenance, or a related technical discipline.

- Equivalent technical or military experience may also be considered.


Experience

- 2–5 years of experience maintaining mechanical systems in data centers, industrial facilities, manufacturing, hospitals, power generation, or other critical environments.

- Experience with Building Management Systems (BMS) and CMMS software is preferred.


Technical Skills

Knowledge of:

- HVAC and cooling systems

- Chilled water and hydronic systems

- Pumps, motors, and heat exchangers

- Mechanical fault diagnosis

- Building Management Systems (BMS)

- Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS)

- Mechanical drawings and Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs)

- Energy-efficient building systems


Preferred Qualifications

- Occupational Safety Card (Työturvallisuuskortti)

- Hot Work Card (Tulityökortti)

- First Aid Certificate (EA1 or equivalent)

- Refrigerant handling qualification (where applicable)

- Fluent English (written and spoken)

- Finnish language skills are beneficial but not essential


**Benefits & Perks:**

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams


**What's it like to work at Nebius:**

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

**Equal Opportunity Statement:**

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Taloussihteeri
jobs.description:
Hangon kaupungin sivistystoimi hakee taloussihteeriä vakinaiseen virkasuhteeseen 1.11.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan jo aiemmin.

Hangon sivistystoimen kansliassa taloussihteerinä työskentelet monipuolisten taloushallinnon tehtävien parissa ja saat laajan näkemyksen koko sivistystoimen taloudesta. Hangon kaupungin sivistystoimi vastaa varhaiskasvatuksen, perusopetuksen, lukiokoulutuksen sekä nuoriso- ja liikuntatoimen palveluista. Taloussihteeri työskentelee sivistystoimen yhteisessä hallinnossa ja tukee toimialan taloushallintoa tiiviissä yhteistyössä eri yksiköiden kanssa.

Etsimme henkilöä, joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti ja jolla on ystävällinen, joustava sekä palveluhenkinen työote.

Taloussihteerin tehtäviin kuuluvat muun muassa:
- osallistuminen talousarvion valmisteluun ja tilinpäätöstyöhön
- laskutus (mm. asiakaslaskutus, kotikuntakorvausten laskutus sekä varhaiskasvatuksen asiakasmaksujen laskutus)
- varhaiskasvatuksen ja iltapäivätoiminnan maksupäätösten valmistelu
- ostolaskujen tarkastaminen ja hyväksyminen
- valtionavustusten, valtionosuuksien ja muiden myönnettyjen avustusten seuranta
- talouteen liittyvä raportointi ja tilastointi.

Taloussihteerin päivittäisessä työssä käytetään muun muassa seuraavia ohjelmia: Pro Economica Premium: ostolaskujen käsittely, kirjanpidon seuranta ja laskutus, Opiferus: taloussuunnittelu, CGI Vesa: varhaiskasvatuksen tietojärjestelmä ja Dynasty: esim. asioiden kirjaaminen ja diariointi. Taloussihteeri toimii Vesa-järjestelmän sekä varhaiskasvatuksen valtakunnallisen tietovarannon Vardan pääkäyttäjänä. Aiempi kokemus näiden järjestelmien käytöstä katsotaan eduksi.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on merkonomin, tradenomin tai vastaava tutkinto sekä erinomaiset taidot toisessa kotimaisessa kielessä ja hyvät taidot toisessa kotimaisessa kielessä.

Aiempi kokemus taloushallinnon tehtävistä katsotaan eduksi.

Virka täytetään sopimuksen mukaan, ja siinä noudatetaan kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa.

Lisätietoja: sivistystoimen johtaja Karl-Erik Gustafsson, 040 596 3249, karl-erik.gustafsson@hanko.fi

Kannustamme ja tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia oman osaamisen kehittämiseen. Tuemme työhyvinvointia tarjoamalla toimivat työterveyshuollon palvelut (Mehiläinen) sekä ePassi-lounas- ja henkilöstöedut.

Yhdenvertaisuuden edistämiseksi rekrytoinneissa kaikki Hangon kaupungin rekrytoinnit tehdään anonyymisti. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa sitä, että rekrytoija tekee haastatteluvalinnat näkemättä hakijan henkilötietoja (esim. nimi, syntymäaika, äidinkieli, sukupuoli tai yhteystiedot).
Näin ollen on tärkeää, että kerrot hakemuslomakkeessa riittävän kattavasti tehtävän kannalta olennaisesta osaamisestasi ja kokemuksestasi. Anonymiteetin säilyttämiseksi on tärkeää, ettet kirjoita mitään henkilötietoja hakemuslomakkeen vapaisiin tekstikenttiin.

Hakuaika päättyy 14.9.2026 klo 15.00. Hakemukset vastaanotetaan sähköisesti osoitteessa www.kuntarekry.fi.
Hakemuksen liitteeksi tulee toimittaa tutkintotodistus.

Palkkaus KVTES mukaan.

Lain lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä (504/2002) 6 §:n 2 momentin mukaisesti palvelukseen tai tehtävään valitun henkilön on ennen palvelussuhteen alkamista esitettävä rikosrekisteriote. Lisäksi hänen on toimitettava lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan yhden (1) kuukauden kuluessa palvelussuhteen alkamisesta, jotta valinta voidaan vahvistaa lainvoimaiseksi.

jobs.title: Skyriaus vadovas (-ė)
jobs.description:
Ieškome patyrusio ir lyderystės savybėmis pasižyminčio Transporto priemonių techninės priežiūros ir aptarnavimo skyriaus vadovo (-ės), kuris (-i) perimtų įvairiapusės technikos parko priežiūros vairą, optimizuotų procesus ir kartu su komanda užtikrintų sklandžią įmonės veiklą.
Vadovas kasdieninėje veikloje atlieka:
Planuoja skyriui pavestus darbus, užduotis, organizuoja ir koordinuoja jų vykdymą, terminus, kokybę, veda atliekamų (atliktų) darbų, užduočių apskaitą ir teikia informaciją ir ataskaitas vadovybei;
Nustato skyriaus veiklos plėtojimo ir tobulinimo kryptis, perspektyvas, strategiją, organizuoja ir ją įgyvendina;
Užtikrina efektyvų ir kokybišką pavaldžių darbuotojų darbo organizavimą, vykdo darbuotojų funkcijų atlikimo kontrolę, sprendimų priėmimą ir veiksmų įgyvendinimą darbų vykdymo ir darbuotojų valdymo klausimais;
Organizuoja transporto priemonių (lengvųjų automobilių, traktorių, šiukšliavežių ir komunalinės technikos) techninę priežiūrą ir remontą;
Bendradarbiauja su servisais bei tiekėjais;
Planuoja remonto darbus, koordinuoja ir kontroliuoja;
Paskirsto remonto komandos darbus;
Kontroliuoja remonto sąnaudas ir efektyvų valdymą;
Inicijuoja ir organizuoja atsarginių dalių ir įrankių užsakymą, apskaitą bei užtikrina tikslingo panaudojimo kontrolę;
Prižiūri atsarginių detalių atsargas įmonės sandėlyje, optimizuoja pagal poreikį;
Organizuoja ir administruoja garantinį remontą ir garantinį aptarnavimą pagal gamintojo reikalavimus;
Bendradarbiauja su tiekėjais pagal sutartinius įsipareigojimus užtikrinant paslaugų ir dalių kokybę bei terminus;
Prižiūriu degalų normų nustatymą, taikymą ir kontrolę;
Koordinuoja informacijos ir duomenų teikimą viešųjų pirkimų dokumentacijai.

jobs.title: Ajoneuvoasentaja / mekaanikko Ouluun (palkka alkaen 3000€/kk)
jobs.description:
Oletko kokenut mekaanikko, joka arvostaa siistejä työolosuhteita, hyviä työkaluja ja sitä, että töitä tehdään ammattitaidolla?

Etsimme asiakkaallemme kokenutta ajoneuvomekaanikkoa / ajoneuvoasentajaa vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Ouluun.

Tässä tehtävässä pääset osaksi tunnettua valtakunnallista autoalan toimijaa, jossa arvostetaan ammattitaitoa ja halutaan rakentaa pitkäaikaisia työsuhteita. Tarjolla on monipuolinen työnkuva, nykyaikaiset työvälineet sekä osaava tiimi ympärillesi.


MITÄ TYÖ PITÄÄ SISÄLLÄÄN?

Työpäiväsi koostuvat monipuolisista henkilö- ja pakettiautojen huolto-, korjaus- ja vianetsintätöistä.

Työ sopii erityisesti sinulle, joka nautit siitä, että saat käyttää omaa osaamistasi ja ratkaista erilaisia teknisiä haasteita. Työskentelet itsenäisesti, mutta et yksin – ympärilläsi on ammattitaitoinen tiimi, jonka kanssa asioita voidaan tarvittaessa pohtia yhdessä.


MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

* Vähintään 5 vuoden kokemusta mekaanikon / ajoneuvoasentajan tehtävistä

* Vankkaa kokemusta autojen huolto- ja korjaustöistä

* Hyvää teknistä osaamista ja ongelmanratkaisukykyä

* Valmiutta itsenäiseen työskentelyyn

* Huolellista ja vastuullista työotetta

* B-ajokorttia

* Suomen kielen taitoa

Etsimme ennen kaikkea ammattitaitoista tekijää, joka tuntee auton tekniikan ja pystyy tarttumaan erilaisiin työtehtäviin itsenäisesti.


MITÄ TARJOAMME?

* Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työsuhteen

* Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan

* Nykyaikaiset työvälineet ja siistit työtilat

* Ammattitaitoisen ja mukavan työyhteisön

* Tunnetun ja vakaan työnantajan

* Monipuolisen työn, jossa pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi

* Mahdollisuuden aloittaa mahdollisimman pian

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan, kuitenkin mahdollisimman pian.


KUULOSTAAKO OMALTA PAIKALTA?

Jos olet kokenut mekaanikko ja etsit pitkäaikaista työpaikkaa, jossa ammattitaitoasi arvostetaan, haluamme kuulla sinusta!

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi jo tänään. Käsittelemme hakemuksia heti niiden saapuessa ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Huomaathan, että pelkästään sähköpostiin tai WhatsAppiin lähetettyjä hakemuksia ei huomioida.



Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa: Heidi Korhonen, 045 8521 969, heidi.korhonen@goodstaff.fi [heidi.korhonen@goodstaff.fi]


MIKSI TÖIHIN GOOD STAFFIN KAUTTA?

Good Staff Henkilöstöpalvelut yhdistää osaavat työntekijät ja tekijää vailla olevat työt – inhimillisesti ja reilusti. Olemme moderni henkilöstöpalveluyritys, jossa työntekijä on aidosti keskiössä. Meillä saat joustavia työmahdollisuuksia, reilun palkan ja oman yhteyshenkilön, joka tukee sinua koko työsuhteen ajan.

Good Staffin kautta saat mahdollisuuden työllistyä monipuolisiin kohteisiin, kartuttaa osaamistasi ja löytää juuri sinulle sopivan työn – olitpa urasi alussa tai jo kokenut ammattilainen.

jobs.description:
Kotimainen Hyvinvointitukku är ett inhemskt vitamin försäljningshus. Vi säljer hälsoprodukter som möjliggör en hälsosammare och bättre livsstil. Vi rekryterar nu nya heltids arbetare till vårt försäljningsteam.

Du behöver ingen tidigare arbetserfarenhet, vi utbildar var och en med vår 30-åriga arbetserfarenhet och yrkeskunnighet. För oss är ålder bara en siffra och i vårt arbetsteam erbjuds bra arbetsro för såväl ungdomar som seniorer.

Heltidsarbetare arbetar 7 timmar varje dag antingen morgon- eller kvällsskift. Till arbetsskiften tar vi hänsyn till varje arbetares personliga behov och du får också själv vara med och påverka dina skift.

Vi skolar varje arbetare enskilt och du får personlig rådgivning under hela din arbetstid. Vår personals trivsel och välbefinnande är viktig för oss så vi försäkrar oss om att alla arbetstagare trivs arbeta hos oss.

Om du söker en ny riktning i livet och vill lära dig ett nytt yrke, så erbjuder vi också möjlighet för läroavtalsutbildning. Du får både lön och arbetserfarenhet, under merkonom-utbildningen.

Kotimainen Hyvinvointitukku är en del av HL-Family Oy. HL-Family Oy belönades med Platinum AAA-certifikatet, vilket betyder att vi har AAA-klassats 10 år i rad. Sama certifikatet har bara delats ut till mindre av en tusendel av finländska företag.

Vi ringer upp alla som skickar in en ansökan. Om du tar kontakt per telefon tar kontorets förman gärna emot ditt samtal. Du kan skicka en friformad ansökan direkt till vår e-post eller fylla i ansöknings-formuläret på vår webbplats https://hyvinvointitukku.fi/rekrytointi/.

jobs.title: Senior Level Designer
jobs.description:
Blackbird Interactive is a creative-fueled, future-driven, independent game studio where the best talent in the industry can find long-term careers to help grow their abilities while working on a wide range of projects, which encompass world-class IPs as well as our own creations across multiple genres.

 

Our studio operates as a remote-first workplace, offering flexible work arrangements.

 

PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are legally eligible to work in Canada and reside within Canada.


Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

  • Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

  • Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

  • Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression

  • Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine

  • Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability


Requirements

  • A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

  • Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

  • Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

  • Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

  • Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

  • Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities


Pluses

  • Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration

  • Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition

  • Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs

  • Appreciation for systemic combat and how level geometry, enemy composition, hazards, and interactive elements combine to create varied encounters

  • Experience designing dungeons, interconnected environments, procedural or modular level content, or other repeatable gameplay spaces

  • Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration


\n
$115,000 - $149,500 a year
\n

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.



This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.



You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.



The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption.

 - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale.

 - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation.

 - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value.

 - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback.

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path.

 - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements.

 - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

 - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

 - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

 - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

 - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively.

 - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

 - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences.

 - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward.

 - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers.

 - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows.

 - Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up.

 - Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements.

 - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.
   
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is $165,000 - $205,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: System Engineer
jobs.description:
Full-time, primarily onsite position in Tallinn. We welcome applications from both strong junior and mid-level Systems Engineers. Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

Work tasks: The Systems Engineer will support the definition, coordination, integration, verification and delivery of Golbriak Space’s optical communication systems.
Main responsibilities: * Capture, analyse, define and maintain system and subsystem requirements * Translate product and mission objectives into clear technical requirements, actions and deliverables * Allocate requirements across subsystems and maintain traceability throughout the product-development lifecycle * Coordinate interfaces between mechanical, optical, electronic, software, thermal, manufacturing and testing activities * Identify technical dependencies, assumptions, constraints, conflicts and risks * Develop system-level verification and validation plans and define appropriate acceptance criteria * Support system integration, testing, troubleshooting and qualification activities * Review test results and verification evidence against defined requirements * Coordinate the resolution of technical issues involving multiple engineering disciplines * Track technical activities, dependencies, risks, decisions and milestones * Prepare and support technical and design reviews * Maintain requirements specifications, interface documentation, verification plans, technical reports and engineering decision records * Support configuration management and the controlled implementation of engineering changes * Collaborate closely with founders, engineering leads, technical teams, suppliers, partners and customers * Contribute to the improvement of systems-engineering processes, documentation and development workflows

We offer: * A central engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication systems
* Meaningful technical ownership across requirements management, system integration, verification and engineering coordination * The opportunity to work across mechanical, optical, electronic, software, manufacturing and testing disciplines * Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team * The opportunity to develop your expertise in systems engineering, optical communications, telecommunications and aerospace * The ability to contribute to technical decisions, engineering processes and ways of working as the company grows * A gross monthly salary of €2100–€3000, depending on experience, skills and expected level of responsibility * Relocation support to Estonia if required * Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex systems as a whole. The person should be able to identify dependencies, constraints and potential conflicts between different engineering disciplines.
The successful candidate will be organised, reliable and willing to take ownership. They should be able to coordinate multiple technical activities and priorities simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills are required, together with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly. The company’s working language is English, so professional working proficiency in English is required. The candidate must be willing to work primarily onsite in Tallinn and be comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Haapsalu Linnavalitsus otsib kommunikatsiooni- ja turundusspetsialisti
Kas soovid kujundada ühe Eesti armastatuima väikelinna kuvandit ning viia Haapsalu info õigete inimesteni? Kommunikatsiooni keskmes on linnaelanik ning Sinu roll on planeerida ja ellu viia linna sise- ja väliskommunikatsiooni ning kasvatada Haapsalu tuntust ja mainet kaasaegse elu-, töö- ja külastuskohana. - Haapsalu linnavalitsuse sise- ja väliskommunikatsiooni planeerimine ning elluviimine; - Haapsalu linna veebilehe, sotsiaalmeediakanalite ja teiste kommunikatsioonikanalite haldamine, arendamine ning sisu loomine; - pressiteadete, artiklite, memode, arvamuslugude ja muude kommunikatsioonimaterjalide initsieerimine ja koostamine; - Haapsalu kui atraktiivse elu- ja töökeskkonna turunduskampaaniate planeerimine ja läbiviimine koostöös partneritega; - foto- ja videomaterjalide loomine ja haldamine; - kriisikommunikatsiooni tegevuste ettevalmistamine ning korraldamine; - koostöö meedia, ettevõtjate, linna allasutuste, külaseltside ja teiste partneritega Haapsalu maine, nähtavuse ning turundus- ja kommunikatsioonitegevuste teadlikuks võimendamiseks; - linna sündmustel ja avalikel üritustel osalemine ja nende kajastamine.

Omalt poolt pakume: - võimalust kujundada Haapsalu kommunikatsiooni ja turundust ning kaasa rääkida linna arengus ja tuleviku kujundamises;
- 35 kalendripäeva põhipuhkust ja 3 tervisepäeva aastas, spordikompensatsiooni.

Muud nõuded: Edukal kandidaadil on:
- varasem töökogemus meedia, avalike suhete, kommunikatsiooni, brändi juhtimise või turunduse valdkonnas; - väga hea eesti keel, oskus sõnu seada ja väljendada mõtteid selgelt ja sihtrühmadele sobivalt; - tööks vajalikul tasemel inglise keel; - teadmised tänapäevastest kommunikatsiooni-, turundus- ja digikanalitest; - kogemus veebi administreerimises ning foto- ja videoloomes, oskus kasutada kujundus- ja sisuloometööriistu. Eeliseks on: - kogemus projektijuhtimises ja turunduskampaaniate läbiviimises, sh sotsiaalmeedias; - teadmised kriisikommunikatsioonist; - hea kaasamis- ja suhtlemisoskus ning korrektsus asjaajamises; - kohaliku elu-, ettevõtlus-, kultuuri- ja turismikeskkonna tundmine; - Haapsalu on või on saamas Sinu kodulinnaks. Haridustase: kõrgharidus (soovitavalt kas turunduse, kommunikatsiooni, meedia, avalike suhete või avaliku halduse alal);

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei
